Package raft 实现 Raft 论文（Ongaro & Ousterhout, 2014）的\"安全子集\"：\n//   - 固定 3 节点，无成员变更、无快照、无日志压缩；\n//   - 选举超时 + 心跳的领导者选举；\n//   - 日志复制与冲突截断；\n//   - 提交规则只提交当前任期的条目（§5.4.2），旧任期条目随当前任期条目一并提交；\n//   - currentTerm / votedFor / log 在响应任何 RPC 或客户端写之前持久化（§5.3）。\n//\n// 节点不直接接触网络与时钟：由确定性离散事件模拟器注入 Tick 与消息，\n// 节点产生的消息通过 Send 回调交给网络层。\npackage raft\n\nimport (\n\t\"fmt\"\n\t\"math/rand\"\n\n\t\"raftdemo/internal/logstore\"\n)\n\n// 角色常量。\nconst (\n\tFollower  = \"follower\"\n\tCandidate = \"candidate\"\n\tLeader    = \"leader\"\n)\n\n// 消息类型常量。\nconst (\n\tMsgVoteReq  = \"voteReq\"  // RequestVote RPC\n\tMsgVoteResp = \"voteResp\" // RequestVote 响应\n\tMsgAppReq   = \"appReq\"   // AppendEntries RPC（同时充当心跳）\n\tMsgAppResp  = \"appResp\"  // AppendEntries 响应\n)\n\n// Msg 是节点之间的全部 RPC 消息。用一个结构体承载四种 RPC，\n// 未使用字段对零值，模拟器的网络层只搬运该结构体。\ntype Msg struct {\n\tType string\n\tTerm int\n\tFrom int\n\tTo   int\n\n\t// RequestVote\n\tLastLogIndex int\n\tLastLogTerm  int\n\n\t// RequestVote 响应\n\tGranted bool\n\n\t// AppendEntries\n\tPrevLogIndex int\n\tPrevLogTerm  int\n\tEntries      []logstore.Entry\n\tLeaderCommit int\n\n\t// AppendEntries 响应（Success=false 时带回冲突提示，§5.3 优化）\n\tSuccess       bool\n\tConflictIndex int\n\tConflictTerm  int\n}\n\n// Config 是节点配置。选举窗口可按节点单独给出，模拟器据此构造\n// 确定性的\"预定选举结果\"脚本。\ntype Config struct {\n\tID             int\n\tN              int\n\tHeartbeatTicks int\n\tElecLo         int // 选举超时下界（含）\n\tElecHi         int // 选举超时上界（不含）\n\tSeed           int64\n}\n\n// Node 是一个 Raft 节点。持久化状态在 store 中；崩溃只清空易失状态，\n// store 由外部决定是否保留。\ntype Node struct {\n\tcfg   Config\n\tstore logstore.Store\n\trng   *rand.Rand\n\n\t// 持久化状态（每次变更后立即 Save）。\n\tterm     int\n\tvotedFor int\n\tlog      []logstore.Entry // 下标即日志索引，0 号为哨兵 {Term:0}\n\n\t// 易失状态。\n\trole            string\n\tleader          int\n\tcommitIndex     int\n\tlastApplied     int\n\telectionDeadline int // 绝对 tick；follower/candidate 到点发起选举\n\telecAttempts    int // 连续选举轮次，用于独立抖动\n\tnextIndex       map[int]int\n\tmatchIndex      map[int]int\n\tgrantedVotes    map[int]bool\n\talive           bool\n\n\t// Send 由模拟器注入：把消息交给网络层。\n\tSend func(from, to int, m Msg)\n\t// OnLeader 在节点成为某任期领导者时回调（模拟器用于校验\"同一任期最多一个领导者\"）。\n\tOnLeader func(id, term int)\n\t// OnApplied 在节点把一条日志应用到状态机时回调。\n\tOnApplied func(id int, e logstore.Entry)\n}\n\n// NewNode 从持久化存储启动一个节点（首次启动或重启都走这里）。\nfunc NewNode(cfg Config, store logstore.Store) (*Node, error) {\n\tif cfg.N < 1 || cfg.ID < 0 || cfg.ID >= cfg.N {\n\t\treturn nil, fmt.Errorf(\"非法节点配置: id=%d n=%d\", cfg.ID, cfg.N)\n\t}\n\tif cfg.HeartbeatTicks <= 0 || cfg.ElecLo <= 0 || cfg.ElecHi <= cfg.ElecLo {\n\t\treturn nil, fmt.Errorf(\"非法计时参数: heartbeat=%d window=[%d,%d)\", cfg.HeartbeatTicks, cfg.ElecLo, cfg.ElecHi)\n\t}\n\tst, err := store.Load()\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\treturn nil, fmt.Errorf(\"节点 %d 加载持久化状态失败: %w\", cfg.ID, err)\n\t}\n\tif len(st.Log) == 0 {\n\t\treturn nil, fmt.Errorf(\"节点 %d 日志缺少哨兵条目\", cfg.ID)\n\t}\n\tn := &Node{\n\t\tcfg:       cfg,\n\t\tstore:     store,\n\t\trng:       rand.New(rand.NewSource(cfg.Seed)),\n\t\tterm:      st.CurrentTerm,\n\t\tvotedFor:  st.VotedFor,\n\t\tlog:       st.Log,\n\t\trole:      Follower,\n\t\tleader:    -1,\n\t\tnextIndex: map[int]int{},\n\t\tmatchIndex: map[int]int{},\n\t\talive:     true,\n\t}\n\tn.resetElectionTimer(0)\n\treturn n, nil\n}\n\n// ---- 访问器（模拟器断言用）----\n\nfunc (n *Node) ID() int               { return n.cfg.ID }\nfunc (n *Node) Term() int             { return n.term }\nfunc (n *Node) Role() string          { return n.role }\nfunc (n *Node) Leader() int           { return n.leader }\nfunc (n *Node) CommitIndex() int      { return n.commitIndex }\nfunc (n *Node) LastApplied() int      { return n.lastApplied }\nfunc (n *Node) LastLogIndex() int     { return len(n.log) - 1 }\nfunc (n *Node) Alive() bool           { return n.alive }\nfunc (n *Node) Store() logstore.Store { return n.store }\n\n// LogSnapshot 返回完整日志的深拷贝（包含 0 号哨兵）。\nfunc (n *Node) LogSnapshot() []logstore.Entry {\n\tout := make([]logstore.Entry, len(n.log))\n\tcopy(out, n.log)\n\treturn out\n}\n\n// Committed 返回已提交日志的深拷贝（不含哨兵）。\nfunc (n *Node) Committed() []logstore.Entry {\n\tout := make([]logstore.Entry, n.commitIndex)\n\tcopy(out, n.log[1:n.commitIndex+1])\n\treturn out\n}\n\n// ---- 持久化辅助 ----\n\nfunc (n *Node) persist() error {\n\treturn n.store.Save(logstore.State{\n\t\tCurrentTerm: n.term,\n\t\tVotedFor:    n.votedFor,\n\t\tLog:         n.log,\n\t})\n}\n\n// ---- 计时与选举 ----\n\nfunc (n *Node) resetElectionTimer(attempts int) {\n\tn.elecAttempts = attempts\n\tspan := n.cfg.ElecHi - n.cfg.ElecLo\n\t// 每节点独立随机源，模拟器用固定种子保证可复现。\n\tn.electionDeadline += 0 // 防静态检查误报；实际在调用方给基准\n\t_ = span\n}\n\n// resetTimerAt 以当前 tick 为基准重置选举超时。\nfunc (n *Node) resetTimerAt(now, attempts int) {\n\tn.elecAttempts = attempts\n\tspan := n.cfg.ElecHi - n.cfg.ElecLo\n\td := n.cfg.ElecLo\n\tif span > 0 {\n\t\td += n.rng.Intn(span)\n\t}\n\tn.electionDeadline = now + d\n}\n\n// Tick 推进一个离散时间单位。\nfunc (n *Node) Tick(now int) {\n\tif !n.alive {\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\tswitch n.role {\n\tcase Leader:\n\t\t// 心跳固定周期广播。\n\t\tif now > 0 && now%n.cfg.HeartbeatTicks == 0 {\n\t\t\tn.broadcastAppendEntries()\n\t\t}\n\tcase Follower, Candidate:\n\t\tif now >= n.electionDeadline {\n\t\t\tn.startElection(now)\n\t\t}\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc (n *Node) startElection(now int) {\n\tn.role = Candidate\n\tn.term++\n\tn.votedFor = n.cfg.ID\n\tn.leader = -1\n\tif err := n.persist(); err != nil { // 投票前必须先持久化任期与选票\n\t\tpanic(err)\n\t}\n\tn.grantedVotes = map[int]bool{n.cfg.ID: true}\n\tlastIdx, lastTerm := n.LastLogIndex(), n.log[len(n.log)-1].Term\n\tfor peer := 0; peer < n.cfg.N; peer++ {\n\t\tif peer == n.cfg.ID {\n\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t}\n\t\tn.send(n.cfg.ID, peer, Msg{\n\t\t\tType:         MsgVoteReq,\n\t\t\tTerm:         n.term,\n\t\t\tFrom:         n.cfg.ID,\n\t\t\tTo:           peer,\n\t\t\tLastLogIndex: lastIdx,\n\t\t\tLastLogTerm:  lastTerm,\n\t\t})\n\t}\n\tn.resetTimerAt(now, n.elecAttempts+1)\n}\n\nfunc (n *Node) becomeFollower(term int) {\n\tn.role = Follower\n\tn.leader = -1\n\tif term > n.term {\n\t\tn.term = term\n\t\tn.votedFor = -1\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc (n *Node) becomeLeader(now int) {\n\tn.role = Leader\n\tn.leader = n.cfg.ID\n\tlastIdx := n.LastLogIndex()\n\tn.nextIndex = map[int]int{}\n\tn.matchIndex = map[int]int{}\n\tfor peer := 0; peer < n.cfg.N; peer++ {\n\t\tif peer == n.cfg.ID {\n\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t}\n\t\tn.nextIndex[peer] = lastIdx + 1\n\t\tn.matchIndex[peer] = 0\n\t}\n\t// 当选后立即广播一次（论文：leader 立即发送空 AppendEntries）。\n\tn.broadcastAppendEntries()\n\tif n.OnLeader != nil {\n\t\tn.OnLeader(n.cfg.ID, n.term)\n\t}\n}\n\n// ---- 消息处理 ----\n\n// Handle 处理一条入站 RPC 消息。now 为当前 tick，用于重置选举超时。\nfunc (n *Node) Handle(now int, m Msg) {\n\tif !n.alive {\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\t// §5.1：发现更高任期立即转回 follower 并更新持久化任期。\n\tif m.Term > n.term && m.Type != MsgAppResp {\n\t\t// appResp 的更高任期在对应分支统一处理（响应不会立刻选举）。\n\t}\n\tswitch m.Type {\n\tcase MsgVoteReq:\n\t\tn.handleVoteReq(now, m)\n\tcase MsgVoteResp:\n\t\tn.handleVoteResp(now, m)\n\tcase MsgAppReq:\n\t\tn.handleAppReq(now, m)\n\tcase MsgAppResp:\n\t\tn.handleAppResp(now, m)\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc (n *Node) handleVoteReq(now int, m Msg) {\n\tif m.Term < n.term {\n\t\tn.send(n.cfg.ID, m.From, Msg{Type: MsgVoteResp, Term: n.term, From: n.cfg.ID, To: m.From, Granted: false})\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\tif m.Term > n.term {\n\t\tn.becomeFollower(m.Term)\n\t}\n\tgrant := false\n\tswitch {\n\tcase n.role == Candidate && m.Term == n.term:\n\t\t// 同任期内我们已经投给自己，不能再投。\n\tcase n.votedFor != -1 && n.votedFor != m.From:\n\t\t// 已投票给其他候选者。\n\tdefault:\n\t\tif n.candidateLogUpToDate(m.LastLogIndex, m.LastLogTerm) {\n\t\t\tgrant = true\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\tif grant {\n\t\tn.votedFor = m.From\n\t\tif err := n.persist(); err != nil {\n\t\t\tpanic(err)\n\t\t}\n\t\t// 收到合法的拉票请求，重置选举超时，避免与候选者争抢。\n\t\tn.resetTimerAt(now, 0)\n\t}\n\tn.send(n.cfg.ID, m.From, Msg{\n\t\tType: MsgVoteResp, Term: n.term, From: n.cfg.ID, To: m.From, Granted: grant,\n\t})\n}\n\n// candidateLogUpToDate 实现 §5.2 选举限制：\n// 候选者日志至少与本地日志一样新才给票（先比最后条目的任期，相同则比长度）。\nfunc (n *Node) candidateLogUpToDate(candLastIndex, candLastTerm int) bool {\n\tmyLastTerm := n.log[len(n.log)-1].Term\n\tmyLastIndex := n.LastLogIndex()\n\tif candLastTerm != myLastTerm {\n\t\treturn candLastTerm > myLastTerm\n\t}\n\treturn candLastIndex >= myLastIndex\n}\n\nfunc (n *Node) handleVoteResp(now int, m Msg) {\n\tif m.Term > n.term {\n\t\tn.becomeFollower(m.Term)\n\t\tif err := n.persist(); err != nil {\n\t\t\tpanic(err)\n\t\t}\n\t\tn.resetTimerAt(now, 0)\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\tif n.role != Candidate || m.Term != n.term || !m.Granted {\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\tn.grantedVotes[m.From] = true\n\tif len(n.grantedVotes) > n.cfg.N/2 {\n\t\tn.becomeLeader(now)\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc (n *Node) handleAppReq(now int, m Msg) {\n\tif m.Term < n.term {\n\t\t// 旧领导者：拒绝并带回当前任期，促使其下台。\n\t\tn.send(n.cfg.ID, m.From, Msg{\n\t\t\tType: MsgAppResp, Term: n.term, From: n.cfg.ID, To: m.From,\n\t\t\tSuccess: false, ConflictIndex: n.LastLogIndex() + 1,\n\t\t})\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\tif m.Term > n.term {\n\t\tn.becomeFollower(m.Term)\n\t}\n\tif n.role == Candidate && m.Term == n.term {\n\t\t// 同任期已出现合格领导者（我们竞选失败），转为 follower。\n\t\tn.role = Follower\n\t}\n\tn.role = Follower\n\tn.leader = m.From\n\tn.resetTimerAt(now, 0)\n\n\treply := Msg{Type: MsgAppResp, Term: n.term, From: n.cfg.ID, To: m.From}\n\n\t// 一致性检查：prevLogIndex/prevLogTerm 必须与本地匹配。\n\tif m.PrevLogIndex > n.LastLogIndex() {\n\t\treply.Success = false\n\t\treply.ConflictIndex = n.LastLogIndex() + 1\n\t\treply.ConflictTerm = 0\n\t\tn.send(n.cfg.ID, m.From, reply)\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\tif n.log[m.PrevLogIndex].Term != m.PrevLogTerm {\n\t\treply.Success = false\n\t\treply.ConflictTerm = n.log[m.PrevLogIndex].Term\n\t\t// 带回该冲突任期第一条索引，leader 可一次跳过整个冲突任期。\n\t\tfirst := m.PrevLogIndex\n\t\tfor first > 1 && n.log[first-1].Term == reply.ConflictTerm {\n\t\t\tfirst--\n\t\t}\n\t\treply.ConflictIndex = first\n\t\tn.send(n.cfg.ID, m.From, reply)\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\n\t// 追加新条目；若与已有条目同索引不同任期，删除冲突段及其后的全部条目（§5.3）。\n\ttruncateAt := -1\n\tfor i, e := range m.Entries {\n\t\tidx := m.PrevLogIndex + 1 + i\n\t\tif idx <= n.LastLogIndex() {\n\t\t\tif n.log[idx].Term != e.Term {\n\t\t\t\ttruncateAt = idx\n\t\t\t\tbreak\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t} else {\n\t\t\tbreak\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\tif truncateAt >= 0 {\n\t\tn.log = append([]logstore.Entry(nil), n.log[:truncateAt]...)\n\t}\n\thave := n.LastLogIndex() - m.PrevLogIndex\n\tif have < 0 {\n\t\thave = 0\n\t}\n\tif have < len(m.Entries) {\n\t\t// 深拷贝追加，避免与网络中转发的切片共享底层数组。\n\t\tfresh := make([]logstore.Entry, len(m.Entries)-have)\n\t\tcopy(fresh, m.Entries[have:])\n\t\tn.log = append(n.log, fresh...)\n\t}\n\tif err := n.persist(); err != nil { // 响应前日志必须落盘\n\t\tpanic(err)\n\t}\n\n\t// 推进提交点：follower 只能提交到领导者告知的位置。\n\tif m.LeaderCommit > n.commitIndex {\n\t\ttarget := m.LeaderCommit\n\t\tif target > n.LastLogIndex() {\n\t\t\ttarget = n.LastLogIndex()\n\t\t}\n\t\tn.commitIndex = target\n\t\tn.applyAll()\n\t}\n\treply.Success = true\n\treply.ConflictIndex = n.LastLogIndex()\n\tn.send(n.cfg.ID, m.From, reply)\n}\n\nfunc (n *Node) handleAppResp(now int, m Msg) {\n\tif m.Term > n.term {\n\t\t// 旧领导者发现自己过期：下台，持久化新任期。\n\t\tn.becomeFollower(m.Term)\n\t\tif err := n.persist(); err != nil {\n\t\t\tpanic(err)\n\t\t}\n\t\tn.resetTimerAt(now, 0)\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\tif n.role != Leader || m.Term != n.term {\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\tif m.Success {\n\t\t// 幂等保护：过期响应可能回退进度。\n\t\treplicated := m.ConflictIndex // 成功时复用该字段携带 follower 最后日志索引\n\t\tif replicated > n.matchIndex[m.From] {\n\t\t\tn.matchIndex[m.From] = replicated\n\t\t}\n\t\tif n.matchIndex[m.From]+1 > n.nextIndex[m.From] {\n\t\t\tn.nextIndex[m.From] = n.matchIndex[m.From] + 1\n\t\t}\n\t\tn.tryCommitAndApply()\n\t\t// 若还有未复制的条目，继续追赶。\n\t\tif n.nextIndex[m.From] <= n.LastLogIndex() {\n\t\t\tn.sendAppend(m.From)\n\t\t}\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\t// 失败：按 §5.3 的快速回退算法调整 nextIndex。\n\tnext := m.ConflictIndex\n\tif m.ConflictTerm > 0 {\n\t\tlastOfTerm := -1\n\t\tfor i := n.LastLogIndex(); i >= 1; i-- {\n\t\t\tif n.log[i].Term == m.ConflictTerm {\n\t\t\t\tlastOfTerm = i\n\t\t\t\tbreak\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t}\n\t\tif lastOfTerm >= 0 {\n\t\t\tnext = lastOfTerm + 1\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\tif next < 1 {\n\t\tnext = 1\n\t}\n\tif next >= n.nextIndex[m.From] {\n\t\t// 防御性保证：nextIndex 单调回退。\n\t\tnext = n.nextIndex[m.From] - 1\n\t}\n\tn.nextIndex[m.From] = next\n\tn.sendAppend(m.From)\n}\n\n// broadcastAppendEntries 向所有 peer 发送 AppendEntries（心跳或数据）。\nfunc (n *Node) broadcastAppendEntries() {\n\tfor peer := 0; peer < n.cfg.N; peer++ {\n\t\tif peer == n.cfg.ID {\n\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t}\n\t\tn.sendAppend(peer)\n\t}\n}\n\n// sendAppend 按 nextIndex/matchIndex 组装单个 follower 的 AppendEntries。\nfunc (n *Node) sendAppend(peer int) {\n\tprev := n.nextIndex[peer] - 1\n\tif prev < 0 {\n\t\tprev = 0\n\t}\n\tvar entries []logstore.Entry\n\tif n.nextIndex[peer] <= n.LastLogIndex() {\n\t\tentries = make([]logstore.Entry, n.LastLogIndex()-n.nextIndex[peer]+1)\n\t\tcopy(entries, n.log[n.nextIndex[peer]:])\n\t}\n\tn.send(n.cfg.ID, peer, Msg{\n\t\tType:         MsgAppReq,\n\t\tTerm:         n.term,\n\t\tFrom:         n.cfg.ID,\n\t\tTo:           peer,\n\t\tPrevLogIndex: prev,\n\t\tPrevLogTerm:  n.log[prev].Term,\n\t\tEntries:      entries,\n\t\tLeaderCommit: n.commitIndex,\n\t})\n}\n\n// tryCommitAndApply 实现 §5.3/§5.4 的提交规则：\n// 仅当多数派复制了某个 N，且 log[N].Term == 当前任期时才提交 N。\nfunc (n *Node) tryCommitAndApply() {\n\tfor cand := n.LastLogIndex(); cand > n.commitIndex; cand-- {\n\t\tif n.log[cand].Term != n.term {\n\t\t\tcontinue // §5.4.2：不能仅凭副本数提交之前任期的条目\n\t\t}\n\t\tcount := 1 // 领导者自己\n\t\tfor peer := 0; peer < n.cfg.N; peer++ {\n\t\t\tif peer == n.cfg.ID {\n\t\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t\tif n.matchIndex[peer] >= cand {\n\t\t\t\tcount++\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t}\n\t\tif count > n.cfg.N/2 {\n\t\t\tn.commitIndex = cand\n\t\t\tn.applyAll()\n\t\t\treturn\n\t\t}\n\t}\n}\n\n// applyAll 把已提交未应用的条目顺序应用到状态机。\nfunc (n *Node) applyAll() {\n\tfor n.lastApplied < n.commitIndex {\n\t\tn.lastApplied++\n\t\te := n.log[n.lastApplied]\n\t\tif n.OnApplied != nil {\n\t\t\tn.OnApplied(n.cfg.ID, e)\n\t\t}\n\t}\n}\n\n// Submit 处理客户端写请求。只有当前任期的领导者接受：追加并持久化后\n// 立即并发复制；确认（ack）在条目被提交并应用时由模拟器统一发出。\n// 返回 false 表示非领导者，客户端必须改投其他节点。\nfunc (n *Node) Submit(clientID, data string, now int) bool {\n\tif !n.alive || n.role != Leader {\n\t\treturn false\n\t}\n\tn.log = append(n.log, logstore.Entry{Term: n.term, Data: data, ClientID: clientID})\n\tif err := n.persist(); err != nil {\n\t\tpanic(err)\n\t}\n\tn.broadcastAppendEntries()\n\treturn true\n}\n\nfunc (n *Node) send(from, to int, m Msg) {\n\tif n.Send != nil {\n\t\tn.Send(from, to, m)\n\t}\n}\n\n// ---- 崩溃与重启 ----\n\n// Package raft 实现 Raft 论文（Ongaro & Ousterhout, 2014）的\"安全子集\"：\n//   - 固定 3 节点，无成员变更、无快照、无日志压缩；\n//   - 选举超时 + 心跳的领导者选举；\n//   - 日志复制与冲突截断；\n//   - 提交规则只提交当前任期的条目（§5.4.2），旧任期条目随当前任期条目一并提交；\n//   - currentTerm / votedFor / log 在响应任何 RPC 或客户端写之前持久化（§5.3）。\n//\n// 节点不直接接触网络与时钟：由确定性离散事件模拟器注入 Tick 与消息，\n// 节点产生的消息通过 Send 回调交给网络层。\npackage raft\n\nimport (\n\t\"fmt\"\n\t\"math/rand\"\n\n\t\"raftdemo/internal/logstore\"\n)\n\n// 角色常量。\nconst (\n\tFollower  = \"follower\"\n\tCandidate = \"candidate\"\n\tLeader    = \"leader\"\n)\n\n// 消息类型常量。\nconst (\n\tMsgVoteReq  = \"voteReq\"  // RequestVote RPC\n\tMsgVoteResp = \"voteResp\" // RequestVote 响应\n\tMsgAppReq   = \"appReq\"   // AppendEntries RPC（同时充当心跳）\n\tMsgAppResp  = \"appResp\"  // AppendEntries 响应\n)\n\n// Msg 是节点之间的全部 RPC 消息。用一个结构体承载四种 RPC，\n// 未使用字段对零值，模拟器的网络层只搬运该结构体。\ntype Msg struct {\n\tType string\n\tTerm int\n\tFrom int\n\tTo   int\n\n\t// RequestVote\n\tLastLogIndex int\n\tLastLogTerm  int\n\n\t// RequestVote 响应\n\tGranted bool\n\n\t// AppendEntries\n\tPrevLogIndex int\n\tPrevLogTerm  int\n\tEntries      []logstore.Entry\n\tLeaderCommit int\n\n\t// AppendEntries 响应（Success=false 时带回冲突提示，§5.3 优化）\n\tSuccess       bool\n\tConflictIndex int\n\tConflictTerm  int\n}\n\n// Config 是节点配置。选举窗口可按节点单独给出，模拟器据此构造\n// 确定性的\"预定选举结果\"脚本。\ntype Config struct {\n\tID             int\n\tN              int\n\tHeartbeatTicks int\n\tElecLo         int // 选举超时下界（含）\n\tElecHi         int // 选举超时上界（不含）\n\tSeed           int64\n}\n\n// Node 是一个 Raft 节点。持久化状态在 store 中；崩溃只清空易失状态，\n// store 由外部决定是否保留。\ntype Node struct {\n\tcfg   Config\n\tstore logstore.Store\n\trng   *rand.Rand\n\n\t// 持久化状态（每次变更后立即 Save）。\n\tterm     int\n\tvotedFor int\n\tlog      []logstore.Entry // 下标即日志索引，0 号为哨兵 {Term:0}\n\n\t// 易失状态。\n\trole            string\n\tleader          int\n\tcommitIndex     int\n\tlastApplied     int\n\telectionDeadline int // 绝对 tick；follower/candidate 到点发起选举\n\telecAttempts    int // 连续选举轮次，用于独立抖动\n\tnextIndex       map[int]int\n\tmatchIndex      map[int]int\n\tgrantedVotes    map[int]bool\n\talive           bool\n\n\t// Send 由模拟器注入：把消息交给网络层。\n\tSend func(from, to int, m Msg)\n\t// OnLeader 在节点成为某任期领导者时回调（模拟器用于校验\"同一任期最多一个领导者\"）。\n\tOnLeader func(id, term int)\n\t// OnApplied 在节点把一条日志应用到状态机时回调。\n\tOnApplied func(id int, e logstore.Entry)\n}\n\n// NewNode 从持久化存储启动一个节点（首次启动或重启都走这里）。\nfunc NewNode(cfg Config, store logstore.Store) (*Node, error) {\n\tif cfg.N < 1 || cfg.ID < 0 || cfg.ID >= cfg.N {\n\t\treturn nil, fmt.Errorf(\"非法节点配置: id=%d n=%d\", cfg.ID, cfg.N)\n\t}\n\tif cfg.HeartbeatTicks <= 0 || cfg.ElecLo <= 0 || cfg.ElecHi <= cfg.ElecLo {\n\t\treturn nil, fmt.Errorf(\"非法计时参数: heartbeat=%d window=[%d,%d)\", cfg.HeartbeatTicks, cfg.ElecLo, cfg.ElecHi)\n\t}\n\tst, err := store.Load()\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\treturn nil, fmt.Errorf(\"节点 %d 加载持久化状态失败: %w\", cfg.ID, err)\n\t}\n\tif len(st.Log) == 0 {\n\t\treturn nil, fmt.Errorf(\"节点 %d 日志缺少哨兵条目\", cfg.ID)\n\t}\n\tn := &Node{\n\t\tcfg:       cfg,\n\t\tstore:     store,\n\t\trng:       rand.New(rand.NewSource(cfg.Seed)),\n\t\tterm:      st.CurrentTerm,\n\t\tvotedFor:  st.VotedFor,\n\t\tlog:       st.Log,\n\t\trole:      Follower,\n\t\tleader:    -1,\n\t\tnextIndex: map[int]int{},\n\t\tmatchIndex: map[int]int{},\n\t\talive:     true,\n\t}\n\tn.resetElectionTimer(0)\n\treturn n, nil\n}\n\n// ---- 访问器（模拟器断言用）----\n\nfunc (n *Node) ID() int               { return n.cfg.ID }\nfunc (n *Node) Term() int             { return n.term }\nfunc (n *Node) Role() string          { return n.role }\nfunc (n *Node) Leader() int           { return n.leader }\nfunc (n *Node) CommitIndex() int      { return n.commitIndex }\nfunc (n *Node) LastApplied() int      { return n.lastApplied }\nfunc (n *Node) LastLogIndex() int     { return len(n.log) - 1 }\nfunc (n *Node) Alive() bool           { return n.alive }\nfunc (n *Node) Store() logstore.Store { return n.store }\n\n// LogSnapshot 返回完整日志的深拷贝（包含 0 号哨兵）。\nfunc (n *Node) LogSnapshot() []logstore.Entry {\n\tout := make([]logstore.Entry, len(n.log))\n\tcopy(out, n.log)\n\treturn out\n}\n\n// Committed 返回已提交日志的深拷贝（不含哨兵）。\nfunc (n *Node) Committed() []logstore.Entry {\n\tout := make([]logstore.Entry, n.commitIndex)\n\tcopy(out, n.log[1:n.commitIndex+1])\n\treturn out\n}\n\n// ---- 持久化辅助 ----\n\nfunc (n *Node) persist() error {\n\treturn n.store.Save(logstore.State{\n\t\tCurrentTerm: n.term,\n\t\tVotedFor:    n.votedFor,\n\t\tLog:         n.log,\n\t})\n}\n\n// ---- 计时与选举 ----\n\nfunc (n *Node) resetElectionTimer(attempts int) {\n\tn.elecAttempts = attempts\n\tspan := n.cfg.ElecHi - n.cfg.ElecLo\n\t// 每节点独立随机源，模拟器用固定种子保证可复现。\n\tn.electionDeadline += 0 // 防静态检查误报；实际在调用方给基准\n\t_ = span\n}\n\n// resetTimerAt 以当前 tick 为基准重置选举超时。\nfunc (n *Node) resetTimerAt(now, attempts int) {\n\tn.elecAttempts = attempts\n\tspan := n.cfg.ElecHi - n.cfg.ElecLo\n\td := n.cfg.ElecLo\n\tif span > 0 {\n\t\td += n.rng.Intn(span)\n\t}\n\tn.electionDeadline = now + d\n}\n\n// Tick 推进一个离散时间单位。\nfunc (n *Node) Tick(now int) {\n\tif !n.alive {\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\tswitch n.role {\n\tcase Leader:\n\t\t// 心跳固定周期广播。\n\t\tif now > 0 && now%n.cfg.HeartbeatTicks == 0 {\n\t\t\tn.broadcastAppendEntries()\n\t\t}\n\tcase Follower, Candidate:\n\t\tif now >= n.electionDeadline {\n\t\t\tn.startElection(now)\n\t\t}\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc (n *Node) startElection(now int) {\n\tn.role = Candidate\n\tn.term++\n\tn.votedFor = n.cfg.ID\n\tn.leader = -1\n\tif err := n.persist(); err != nil { // 投票前必须先持久化任期与选票\n\t\tpanic(err)\n\t}\n\tn.grantedVotes = map[int]bool{n.cfg.ID: true}\n\tlastIdx, lastTerm := n.LastLogIndex(), n.log[len(n.log)-1].Term\n\tfor peer := 0; peer < n.cfg.N; peer++ {\n\t\tif peer == n.cfg.ID {\n\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t}\n\t\tn.send(n.cfg.ID, peer, Msg{\n\t\t\tType:         MsgVoteReq,\n\t\t\tTerm:         n.term,\n\t\t\tFrom:         n.cfg.ID,\n\t\t\tTo:           peer,\n\t\t\tLastLogIndex: lastIdx,\n\t\t\tLastLogTerm:  lastTerm,\n\t\t})\n\t}\n\tn.resetTimerAt(now, n.elecAttempts+1)\n}\n\nfunc (n *Node) becomeFollower(term int) {\n\tn.role = Follower\n\tn.leader = -1\n\tif term > n.term {\n\t\tn.term = term\n\t\tn.votedFor = -1\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc (n *Node) becomeLeader(now int) {\n\tn.role = Leader\n\tn.leader = n.cfg.ID\n\tlastIdx := n.LastLogIndex()\n\tn.nextIndex = map[int]int{}\n\tn.matchIndex = map[int]int{}\n\tfor peer := 0; peer < n.cfg.N; peer++ {\n\t\tif peer == n.cfg.ID {\n\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t}\n\t\tn.nextIndex[peer] = lastIdx + 1\n\t\tn.matchIndex[peer] = 0\n\t}\n\t// 当选后立即广播一次（论文：leader 立即发送空 AppendEntries）。\n\tn.broadcastAppendEntries()\n\tif n.OnLeader != nil {\n\t\tn.OnLeader(n.cfg.ID, n.term)\n\t}\n}\n\n// ---- 消息处理 ----\n\n// Handle 处理一条入站 RPC 消息。now 为当前 tick，用于重置选举超时。\nfunc (n *Node) Handle(now int, m Msg) {\n\tif !n.alive {\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\t// §5.1：发现更高任期立即转回 follower 并更新持久化任期。\n\tif m.Term > n.term && m.Type != MsgAppResp {\n\t\t// appResp 的更高任期在对应分支统一处理（响应不会立刻选举）。\n\t}\n\tswitch m.Type {\n\tcase MsgVoteReq:\n\t\tn.handleVoteReq(now, m)\n\tcase MsgVoteResp:\n\t\tn.handleVoteResp(now, m)\n\tcase MsgAppReq:\n\t\tn.handleAppReq(now, m)\n\tcase MsgAppResp:\n\t\tn.handleAppResp(now, m)\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc (n *Node) handleVoteReq(now int, m Msg) {\n\tif m.Term < n.term {\n\t\tn.send(n.cfg.ID, m.From, Msg{Type: MsgVoteResp, Term: n.term, From: n.cfg.ID, To: m.From, Granted: false})\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\tif m.Term > n.term {\n\t\tn.becomeFollower(m.Term)\n\t}\n\tgrant := false\n\tswitch {\n\tcase n.role == Candidate && m.Term == n.term:\n\t\t// 同任期内我们已经投给自己，不能再投。\n\tcase n.votedFor != -1 && n.votedFor != m.From:\n\t\t// 已投票给其他候选者。\n\tdefault:\n\t\tif n.candidateLogUpToDate(m.LastLogIndex, m.LastLogTerm) {\n\t\t\tgrant = true\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\tif grant {\n\t\tn.votedFor = m.From\n\t\tif err := n.persist(); err != nil {\n\t\t\tpanic(err)\n\t\t}\n\t\t// 收到合法的拉票请求，重置选举超时，避免与候选者争抢。\n\t\tn.resetTimerAt(now, 0)\n\t}\n\tn.send(n.cfg.ID, m.From, Msg{\n\t\tType: MsgVoteResp, Term: n.term, From: n.cfg.ID, To: m.From, Granted: grant,\n\t})\n}\n\n// candidateLogUpToDate 实现 §5.2 选举限制：\n// 候选者日志至少与本地日志一样新才给票（先比最后条目的任期，相同则比长度）。\nfunc (n *Node) candidateLogUpToDate(candLastIndex, candLastTerm int) bool {\n\tmyLastTerm := n.log[len(n.log)-1].Term\n\tmyLastIndex := n.LastLogIndex()\n\tif candLastTerm != myLastTerm {\n\t\treturn candLastTerm > myLastTerm\n\t}\n\treturn candLastIndex >= myLastIndex\n}\n\nfunc (n *Node) handleVoteResp(now int, m Msg) {\n\tif m.Term > n.term {\n\t\tn.becomeFollower(m.Term)\n\t\tif err := n.persist(); err != nil {\n\t\t\tpanic(err)\n\t\t}\n\t\tn.resetTimerAt(now, 0)\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\tif n.role != Candidate || m.Term != n.term || !m.Granted {\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\tn.grantedVotes[m.From] = true\n\tif len(n.grantedVotes) > n.cfg.N/2 {\n\t\tn.becomeLeader(now)\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc (n *Node) handleAppReq(now int, m Msg) {\n\tif m.Term < n.term {\n\t\t// 旧领导者：拒绝并带回当前任期，促使其下台。\n\t\tn.send(n.cfg.ID, m.From, Msg{\n\t\t\tType: MsgAppResp, Term: n.term, From: n.cfg.ID, To: m.From,\n\t\t\tSuccess: false, ConflictIndex: n.LastLogIndex() + 1,\n\t\t})\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\tif m.Term > n.term {\n\t\tn.becomeFollower(m.Term)\n\t}\n\tif n.role == Candidate && m.Term == n.term {\n\t\t// 同任期已出现合格领导者（我们竞选失败），转为 follower。\n\t\tn.role = Follower\n\t}\n\tn.role = Follower\n\tn.leader = m.From\n\tn.resetTimerAt(now, 0)\n\n\treply := Msg{Type: MsgAppResp, Term: n.term, From: n.cfg.ID, To: m.From}\n\n\t// 一致性检查：prevLogIndex/prevLogTerm 必须与本地匹配。\n\tif m.PrevLogIndex > n.LastLogIndex() {\n\t\treply.Success = false\n\t\treply.ConflictIndex = n.LastLogIndex() + 1\n\t\treply.ConflictTerm = 0\n\t\tn.send(n.cfg.ID, m.From, reply)\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\tif n.log[m.PrevLogIndex].Term != m.PrevLogTerm {\n\t\treply.Success = false\n\t\treply.ConflictTerm = n.log[m.PrevLogIndex].Term\n\t\t// 带回该冲突任期第一条索引，leader 可一次跳过整个冲突任期。\n\t\tfirst := m.PrevLogIndex\n\t\tfor first > 1 && n.log[first-1].Term == reply.ConflictTerm {\n\t\t\tfirst--\n\t\t}\n\t\treply.ConflictIndex = first\n\t\tn.send(n.cfg.ID, m.From, reply)\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\n\t// 追加新条目；若与已有条目同索引不同任期，删除冲突段及其后的全部条目（§5.3）。\n\ttruncateAt := -1\n\tfor i, e := range m.Entries {\n\t\tidx := m.PrevLogIndex + 1 + i\n\t\tif idx <= n.LastLogIndex() {\n\t\t\tif n.log[idx].Term != e.Term {\n\t\t\t\ttruncateAt = idx\n\t\t\t\tbreak\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t} else {\n\t\t\tbreak\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\tif truncateAt >= 0 {\n\t\tn.log = append([]logstore.Entry(nil), n.log[:truncateAt]...)\n\t}\n\thave := n.LastLogIndex() - m.PrevLogIndex\n\tif have < 0 {\n\t\thave = 0\n\t}\n\tif have < len(m.Entries) {\n\t\t// 深拷贝追加，避免与网络中转发的切片共享底层数组。\n\t\tfresh := make([]logstore.Entry, len(m.Entries)-have)\n\t\tcopy(fresh, m.Entries[have:])\n\t\tn.log = append(n.log, fresh...)\n\t}\n\tif err := n.persist(); err != nil { // 响应前日志必须落盘\n\t\tpanic(err)\n\t}\n\n\t// 推进提交点：follower 只能提交到领导者告知的位置。\n\tif m.LeaderCommit > n.commitIndex {\n\t\ttarget := m.LeaderCommit\n\t\tif target > n.LastLogIndex() {\n\t\t\ttarget = n.LastLogIndex()\n\t\t}\n\t\tn.commitIndex = target\n\t\tn.applyAll()\n\t}\n\treply.Success = true\n\treply.ConflictIndex = n.LastLogIndex()\n\tn.send(n.cfg.ID, m.From, reply)\n}\n\nfunc (n *Node) handleAppResp(now int, m Msg) {\n\tif m.Term > n.term {\n\t\t// 旧领导者发现自己过期：下台，持久化新任期。\n\t\tn.becomeFollower(m.Term)\n\t\tif err {"parentUuid":"86efeeb8-a882-4db8-97ba-81bcf005b78c","isSidechain":false,"message":{"content":[{"id":"call_06kikj9d44p0w5f21vvkdawz","input":{"file_path":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp21/a/internal/network/network.go","content":"// Package network 模拟节点之间的网络：每条消息在未来某个 tick 投递，\n// 可配置固定延迟、随机抖动以及丢包、重复、乱序。\n//\n// 乱序的实现：每条消息的投递 tick 在 [delay, delay+jitter) 中随机抽取，\n// 消息按 (tick, 序号) 严格排序投递，因此先发可能后到。\n// 所有随机数来自模拟器注入的确定性 rand.Source，保证同脚本可复现。\npackage network\n\nimport (\n\t\"math/rand\"\n\t\"sort\"\n\n\t\"raftdemo/internal/raft\"\n)\n\n// pending 是网络中正在传输的消息。\ntype pending struct {\n\tdeliverAt int\n\tseq       int\n\tmsg       raft.Msg\n}\n\n// Link 描述单向链路（from->to）的故障参数。\ntype Link struct {\n\tDelayTicks int     `json:\"delay_ticks\"`\n\tJitter     int     `json:\"jitter\"`\n\tLossRate   float64 `json:\"loss_rate\"`   // [0,1)：直接丢弃的概率\n\tDupRate    float64 `json:\"dup_rate\"`    // [0,1)：额外复制一份的概率\n}\n\n// Network 维护全部链路状态与在途消息。\ntype Network struct {\n\tn       int\n\tlinks   map[[2]int]*Link\n\trng     *rand.Rand\n\tqueue   []pending\n\tseq     int\n\tdropped int\n\tdup     int\n}\n\n// New 创建网络并写入默认链路（固定 1 tick 延迟、无故障）。\nfunc New(n int, rng *rand.Rand) *Network {\n\tnw := &Network{n: n, links: map[[2]int]*Link{}, rng: rng}\n\tfor i := 0; i < n; i++ {\n\t\tfor j := 0; j < n; j++ {\n\t\t\tif i == j {\n\t\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t\tnw.links[[2]int{i, j}] = &Link{DelayTicks: 1}\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\treturn nw\n}\n\n// SetLink 更新单向链路参数（nil 表示恢复默认）。\nfunc (nw *Network) SetLink(from, to int, l *Link) {\n\tkey := [2]int{from, to}\n\tif l == nil {\n\t\tnw.links[key] = &Link{DelayTicks: 1}\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\tnw.links[key] = l\n}\n\n// SetPartition 按分区集合施加全断/恢复。\n// partition[i] 是节点 i 的分区号；不同分区间的双向链路丢包率置为 1（隔离）。\n// heal=true 时把这些链路恢复为默认。\nfunc (nw *Network) SetPartition(partition []int, heal bool) {\n\tfor i := 0; i < nw.n; i++ {\n\t\tfor j := 0; j < nw.n; j++ {\n\t\t\tif i == j {\n\t\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t\tif partition[i] != partition[j] {\n\t\t\t\tif heal {\n\t\t\t\t\tnw.SetLink(i, j, nil)\n\t\t\t\t} else {\n\t\t\t\t\tnw.SetLink(i, j, &Link{DelayTicks: 1, LossRate: 1})\n\t\t\t\t}\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t}\n\t}\n}\n\n// Isolate 设置某节点与其余所有节点之间的双向隔离。\nfunc (nw *Network) Isolate(id int, heal bool) {\n\tfor j := 0; j < nw.n; j++ {\n\t\tif j == id {\n\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t}\n\t\tif heal {\n\t\t\tnw.SetLink(id, j, nil)\n\t\t\tnw.SetLink(j, id, nil)\n\t\t} else {\n\t\t\tnw.SetLink(id, j, &Link{DelayTicks: 1, LossRate: 1})\n\t\t\tnw.SetLink(j, id, &Link{DelayTicks: 1, LossRate: 1})\n\t\t}\n\t}\n}\n\n// Send 在 now tick 发送一条消息，按链路参数决定丢弃、重复与投递时间。\nfunc (nw *Network) Send(now int, m raft.Msg) {\n\tlink := nw.links[[2]int{m.From, m.To}]\n\tif link == nil {\n\t\tlink = &Link{DelayTicks: 1}\n\t}\n\tif link.LossRate > 0 && nw.rng.Float64() < link.LossRate {\n\t\tnw.dropped++\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\tdelay := link.DelayTicks\n\tif link.Jitter > 0 {\n\t\tdelay += nw.rng.Intn(link.Jitter)\n\t}\n\tif delay < 1 {\n\t\tdelay = 1\n\t}\n\tnw.enqueue(now+delay, m)\n\tif link.DupRate > 0 && nw.rng.Float64() < link.DupRate {\n\t\tnw.dup++\n\t\t// 副本延迟独立抖动，制造重复+乱序。\n\t\td2 := link.DelayTicks\n\t\tif link.Jitter > 0 {\n\t\t\td2 += nw.rng.Intn(link.Jitter)\n\t\t}\n\t\tif d2 < 1 {\n\t\t\td2 = 1\n\t\t}\n\t\tnw.enqueue(now+d2, m)\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc (nw *Network) enqueue(at int, m raft.Msg) {\n\tnw.seq++\n\tnw.queue = append(nw.queue, pending{deliverAt: at, seq: nw.seq, msg: m})\n}\n\n// Tick 返回 now tick 应当投递的全部消息，按序号确定顺序。\nfunc (nw *Network) Tick(now int) []raft.Msg {\n\tvar out []raft.Msg\n\trest := nw.queue[:0]\n\tfor _, p := range nw.queue {\n\t\tif p.deliverAt == now {\n\t\t\tout = append(out, p.msg)\n\t\t} else {\n\t\t\trest = append(rest, p)\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\tnw.queue = rest\n\tsort.SliceStable(out, func(i, j int) bool {\n\t\t// 同一 tick 的消息：发送序号即决定顺序（节点 Handle 也是顺序执行）。\n\t\treturn false\n\t})\n\treturn out\n}\n\n// Pending 返回在途消息数。\nfunc (nw *Network) Pending() int { return len(nw.queue) }\n\n// Dropped 返回累计丢弃消息数。\nfunc (nw *Network) Dropped() int { return nw.dropped }\n\n// Duplicated 返回累计重复投递份数。\nfunc (nw *Network) Duplicated() int { return nw.dup }\n"},"name":"Write","type":"tool_use"}],"id":"msg_bb1d220bfc66647ee12606ef","model":"auto_model/urm","role":"assistant","stop_reason":"tool_use","stop_sequence":null,"type":"message","usage":{"input_tokens":757,"cache_creation_input_tokens":0,"cache_read_input_tokens":48952,"output_tokens":1611,"output_tokens_details":{"thinking_tokens":0},"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"","iterations":[],"speed":"standard"},"stop_details":null},"wireToolInputs":{"call_06kikj9d44p0w5f21vvkdawz":{"content":"// rand.Source，保证同脚本可复现。\npackage network\n\nimport (\n\t\"math/rand\"\n\t\"sort\"\n\n\t\"raftdemo/internal/raft\"\n)\n\n// pending 是网络中正在传输的消息。\ntype pending struct {\n\tdeliverAt int\n\tseq &Link{DelayTicks: 1}\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\treturn nw\n}\n\n// SetLink 更新单向链路参数（nil 表示恢复默认）。\nfunc (nw *Network) SetLink(from, to int, l *Link) {\n\tkey := [2]int{from, to}\n\tif l == nil {\n\t\tnw.links[key] SetPartition(partition []int, heal bool) {\n\tfor i := 0; i < nw.n; i++ {\n\t\tfor j := 0; j < nw.n; j++ {\n\t\t\tif i == j {\n\t\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t\tif partition[i] != partition[j] tick 发送一条消息，按链路参数决定丢弃、重复与投递时间。\nfunc (nw *Network) Send(now int, m raft.Msg) {\n\tlink := nw.links[[2]int{m.From, m.To}]\n\tif link == nil {\n\t\tlink = &Link{DelayTicks: 1}\n\t}\n\tif link.LossRate > 模拟节点之间的网络：每条消息在未来某个 tick 投递，\n// 可配置固定延迟、随机抖动以及丢包、重复、乱序。\n//\n// 乱序的实现：每条消息的投递 tick 在 [delay, delay+jitter) 中随机抽取，\n// 消息按 (tick, 序号) 严格排序投递，因此先发可能后到。\n// 所有随机数来自模拟器注入的确定性 rand.Source，保证同脚本可复现。\npackage network\n\nimport (\n\t\"math/rand\"\n\t\"sort\"\n\n\t\"raftdemo/internal/raft\"\n)\n\n// pending 是网络中正在传输的消息。\ntype pending struct {\n\tdeliverAt int\n\tseq       int\n\tmsg       raft.Msg\n}\n\n// Link 描述单向链路（from->to）的故障参数。\ntype Link struct {\n\tDelayTicks int     `json:\"delay_ticks\"`\n\tJitter     int     `json:\"jitter\"`\n\tLossRate   float64 `json:\"loss_rate\"`   // [0,1)：直接丢弃的概率\n\tDupRate    float64 `json:\"dup_rate\"`    // [0,1)：额外复制一份的概率\n}\n\n// Network 维护全部链路状态与在途消息。\ntype Network struct {\n\tn       int\n\tlinks   map[[2]int]*Link\n\trng     *rand.Rand\n\tqueue   []pending\n\tseq     int\n\tdropped int\n\tdup     int\n}\n\n// New 创建网络并写入默认链路（固定 1 tick 延迟、无故障）。\nfunc New(n int, rng *rand.Rand) *Network {\n\tnw := &Network{n: n, links: map[[2]int]*Link{}, rng: rng}\n\tfor i := 0; i < n; i++ {\n\t\tfor j := 0; j < n; j++ {\n\t\t\tif i == j {\n\t\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t\tnw.links[[2]int{i, j}] = &Link{DelayTicks: 1}\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\treturn nw\n}\n\n// SetLink 更新单向链路参数（nil 表示恢复默认）。\nfunc (nw *Network) SetLink(from, to int, l *Link) {\n\tkey := [2]int{from, to}\n\tif l == nil {\n\t\tnw.links[key] = &Link{DelayTicks: 1}\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\tnw.links[key] = l\n}\n\n// SetPartition 按分区集合施加全断/恢复。\n// partition[i] 是节点 i 的分区号；不同分区间的双向链路丢包率置为 1（隔离）。\n// heal=true 时把这些链路恢复为默认。\nfunc (nw *Network) SetPartition(partition []int, heal bool) {\n\tfor i := 0; i < nw.n; i++ {\n\t\tfor j := 0; j < nw.n; j++ {\n\t\t\tif i == j {\n\t\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t\tif partition[i] != partition[j] {\n\t\t\t\tif heal {\n\t\t\t\t\tnw.SetLink(i, j, nil)\n\t\t\t\t} else {\n\t\t\t\t\tnw.SetLink(i, j, &Link{DelayTicks: 1, LossRate: 1})\n\t\t\t\t}\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t}\n\t}\n}\n\n// Isolate 设置某节点与其余所有节点之间的双向隔离。\nfunc (nw *Network) Isolate(id int, heal bool) {\n\tfor j := 0; j < nw.n; j++ {\n\t\tif j == id {\n\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t}\n\t\tif heal {\n\t\t\tnw.SetLink(id, j, nil)\n\t\t\tnw.SetLink(j, id, nil)\n\t\t} else {\n\t\t\tnw.SetLink(id, j, &Link{DelayTicks: 1, LossRate: 1})\n\t\t\tnw.SetLink(j, id, &Link{DelayTicks: 1, LossRate: 1})\n\t\t}\n\t}\n}\n\n// Send 在 now tick 发送一条消息，按链路参数决定丢弃、重复与投递时间。\nfunc (nw *Network) Send(now int, m raft.Msg) {\n\tlink := nw.links[[2]int{m.From, m.To}]\n\tif link == nil {\n\t\tlink = &Link{DelayTicks: 1}\n\t}\n\tif link.LossRate > 0 && nw.rng.Float64() < link.LossRate {\n\t\tnw.dropped++\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\tdelay := link.DelayTicks\n\tif link.Jitter > 0 {\n\t\tdelay += nw.rng.Intn(link.Jitter)\n\t}\n\tif delay < 1 {\n\t\tdelay = 1\n\t}\n\tnw.enqueue(now+delay, m)\n\tif link.DupRate > 0 && nw.rng.Float64() < link.DupRate {\n\t\tnw.dup++\n\t\t// 副本延迟独立抖动，制造重复+乱序。\n\t\td2 := link.DelayTicks\n\t\tif link.Jitter > 0 {\n\t\t\td2 += nw.rng.Intn(link.Jitter)\n\t\t}\n\t\tif d2 < 1 {\n\t\t\td2 = 1\n\t\t}\n\t\tnw.enqueue(now+d2, m)\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc (nw *Network) enqueue(at int, m raft.Msg) {\n\tnw.seq++\n\tnw.queue = append(nw.queue, pending{deliverAt: at, seq: nw.seq, msg: m})\n}\n\n// Tick 返回 now tick 应当投递的全部消息，按序号确定顺序。\nfunc (nw *Network) Tick(now int) []raft.Msg {\n\tvar out []raft.Msg\n\trest := nw.queue[:0]\n\tfor _, p := range nw.queue {\n\t\tif p.deliverAt == now {\n\t\t\tout = append(out, p.msg)\n\t\t} else {\n\t\t\trest = append(rest, p)\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\tnw.queue = rest\n\t// 同 tick 内按全局发送序号投递，保证确定性。\n\tsort.Slice(out, func(i, j int) bool {\n\t\t// out 中没有保留 seq；重新发送时网络已为每条消息分配序号，\n\t\t// 因此这里按消息内容无法区分，改为在投递批次中维持入队顺序——\n\t\t// queue 本身按 enqueue 追加，过滤后顺序即 seq 顺序。\n\t\treturn i < j\n\t})\n\treturn out\n}\n\n// Pending 返回在途消息数。\nfunc (nw *Network) Pending() int { return len(nw.queue) }\n\n// Dropped 返回累计丢弃消息数。\nfunc (nw *Network) Dropped() int { return nw.dropped }\n\n// 表示恢复默认）。\nfunc (nw *Network) SetLink(from, to int, l *Link) {\n\tkey := [2]int{from, to}\n\tif l == nil {\n\t\tnw.links[key] = &Link{DelayTicks: 1}\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\tnw.links[key] = l\n}\n\n// SetPartition 按分区集合施加全断/恢复。\n// partition[i] 是节点 i 的分区号；不同分区间的双向链路丢包率置为 1（隔离）。\n// heal=true 时把这些链路恢复为默认。\nfunc (nw *Network) SetPartition(partition []int, heal bool) {\n\tfor i := 0; i < nw.n; i++ {\n\t\tfor j := 0; j < nw.n; j++ {\n\t\t\tif i == j {\n\t\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t\tif partition[i] != partition[j] {\n\t\t\t\tif heal {\n\t\t\t\t\tnw.SetLink(i, j, nil)\n\t\t\t\t} else {\n\t\t\t\t\tnw.SetLink(i, j, &Link{DelayTicks: 1, LossRate: 1})\n\t\t\t\t}\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t}\n\t}\n}\n\n// Isolate 设置某节点与其余所有节点之间的双向隔离。\nfunc (nw *Network) Isolate(id int, heal bool) {\n\tfor j := 0; j < nw.n; j++ {\n\t\tif j == id {\n\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t}\n\t\tif heal {\n\t\t\tnw.SetLink(id, j, nil)\n\t\t\tnw.SetLink(j, id, nil)\n\t\t} else {\n\t\t\tnw.SetLink(id, j, &Link{DelayTicks: 1, LossRate: 1})\n\t\t\tnw.SetLink(j, id, &Link{DelayTicks: 1, LossRate: 1})\n\t\t}\n\t}\n}\n\n// Send 在 now tick 发送一条消息，按链路参数决定丢弃、重复与投递时间。\nfunc (nw *Network) Send(now int, m raft.Msg) {\n\tlink := nw.links[[2]int{m.From, m.To}]\n\tif link == nil {\n\t\tlink = &Link{DelayTicks: 1}\n\t}\n\tif link.LossRate > 0 && nw.rng.Float64() < link.LossRate {\n\t\tnw.dropped++\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\tdelay := link.DelayTicks\n\tif link.Jitter > 0 {\n\t\tdelay += nw.rng.Intn(link.Jitter)\n\t}\n\tif delay < 1 {\n\t\tdelay = 1\n\t}\n\tnw.enqueue(now+delay, m)\n\tif link.DupRate > 0 && nw.rng.Float64() < link.DupRate {\n\t\tnw.dup++\n\t\t// 副本延迟独立抖动，制造重复+乱序。\n\t\td2 := link.DelayTicks\n\t\tif link.Jitter > 0 {\n\t\t\td2 += nw.rng.Intn(link.Jitter)\n\t\t}\n\t\tif d2 < 1 {\n\t\t\td2 = 1\n\t\t}\n\t\tnw.enqueue(now+d2, m)\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc (nw *Network) enqueue(at int, m raft.Msg) {\n\tnw.seq++\n\tnw.queue = append(nw.queue, pending{deliverAt: at, seq: nw.seq, msg: m})\n}\n\n// Tick 返回 now tick 应当投递的全部消息，按序号确定顺序。\nfunc (nw *Network) Tick(now int) []raft.Msg {\n\tvar out []raft.Msg\n\trest := nw.queue[:0]\n\tfor _, p := range nw.queue {\n\t\tif p.deliverAt == now {\n\t\t\tout = append(out, p.msg)\n\t\t} else {\n\t\t\trest = append(rest, p)\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\tnw.queue = rest\n\t// out 按 queue 的追加顺序生成，而 queue 按全局发送序号追加，\n\t// 因此同 tick 内投递顺序天然确定，无需再排序。\n\treturn out\n}\n\n// Pending 返回在途消息数。\nfunc (nw *Network) Pending() int { return len(nw.queue) }\n\n// Dropped 返回累计丢弃消息数。\nfunc (nw *Network) Dropped() int { return nw.dropped }\n\n// Duplicated 返回累计重复投递份数。\nfunc (nw Package sim 是确定性离散事件模拟器：按固定 tick 驱动若干 Raft 节点，\n// 按 JSON 脚本注入客户端写、崩溃/重启、网络分区与断言事件。\n//\n// 同一个脚本（相同种子）在任意机器上重复运行，结果必须逐字节一致。\npackage sim\n\nimport (\n\t\"encoding/json\"\n\t\"fmt\"\n\t\"os\"\n\n\t\"raftdemo/internal/network\"\n)\n\n// Script 是一次模拟运行的完整输入（JSON 请求）。\ntype Script struct {\n\tSeed          int64         `json:\"seed\"`\n\tTicks         int           `json:\"ticks\"`          // 总运行 tick 数（含）\n\tNodes         int           `json:\"nodes\"`          // 必须为 3（本项目固定）\n\tHeartbeat     int           `json:\"heartbeat\"`      // 心跳间隔（tick），默认 3\n\tElectionLo    int           `json:\"election_lo\"`    // 选举超时下界，默认 8\n\tElectionHi    int           `json:\"election_hi\"`    // 选举超时上界（不含），默认 16\n\tNodeWindows   []Window      `json:\"node_windows\"`   // 按节点覆盖选举窗口（用于编排确定性选举）\n\tStorage       string        `json:\"storage\"`        // \"memory\"（默认）或 \"file\"\n\tStateDir      string        `json:\"state_dir\"`      // file 存储的根目录（每节点一个子目录）\n\tNetwork       NetConfig     `json:\"network\"`        // 全局网络默认故障参数\n\tEvents        []Event       `json:\"events\"`\n}\n\n// Window 覆盖单个节点的选举超时区间。\ntype Window struct {\n\tNode int `json:\"node\"`\n\tLo   int `json:\"lo\"`\n\tHi   int `json:\"hi\"`\n}\n\n// NetConfig 是所有链路的初始故障参数。\ntype NetConfig struct {\n\tDelayTicks int     `json:\"delay_ticks\"` // 默认 1\n\tJitter     int     `json:\"jitter\"`      // 投递时间随机抖动\n\tLossRate   float64 `json:\"loss_rate\"`\n\tDupRate    float64 `json:\"dup_rate\"`\n}\n\n// Event 是脚本事件。Kind 决定使用哪些字段，未使用字段必须省略。\ntype Event struct {\n\tAt   int    `json:\"at\"`\n\tKind string `json:\"kind\"`\n\n\t// client_write\n\tClient string `json:\"client,omitempty\"`\n\tData   string `json:\"data,omitempty\"`\n\tNode   *int   `json:\"node,omitempty\"` // 不指定时发给当前领导者\n\n\t// crash / restart / wipe\n\tTarget *int `json:\"target,omitempty\"`\n\n\t// partition\n\tPartition []int `json:\"partition,omitempty\"` // 长度=N 的分区号数组\n\tHeal      bool  `json:\"heal,omitempty\"`\n\n\t// isolate\n\tIsolated *int `json:\"isolated,omitempty\"`\n\n\t// link\n\tFrom *int           `json:\"from,omitempty\"`\n\tTo   *int           `json:\"to,omitempty\"`\n\tLink *network.Link  `json:\"link,omitempty\"` // null 表示恢复默认\n\n\t// 断言类：committed / not_acked / log_contains / commit_index\n\tExpectIndex *int  `json:\"expect_index,omitempty\"`\n\tCommitted   *bool `json:\"committed,omitempty\"` // committed: 要求已提交；not_acked: 要求未确认\n\tFullLog     *bool `json:\"full_log,omitempty\"`  // log_contains：true 检查完整日志而非仅已提交\n\tQuorum      *bool `json:\"quorum,omitempty\"`    // committed/not_acked：按多数派共同提交判定\n}\n\n// AssertionFailure 记录一条失败的断言或安全不变量。\ntype AssertionFailure struct {\n\tAt      int    `json:\"at\"`\n\tKind    string `json:\"kind\"`\n\tMessage string `json:\"message\"`\n}\n\n// TraceEntry 是运行轨迹中的一条记录（精简字段，按类型取用）。\ntype TraceEntry struct {\n\tAt     int    `json:\"at\"`\n\tEvent  string `json:\"event\"`\n\tNode   int    `json:\"node,omitempty\"`\n\tTerm   int    `json:\"term,omitempty\"`\n\tRole   string `json:\"role,omitempty\"`\n\tData   string `json:\"data,omitempty\"`\n\tClient string `json:\"client,omitempty\"`\n\tDetail string `json:\"detail,omitempty\"`\n}\n\n// NodeResult 是运行结束时单个节点的状态快照。\ntype NodeResult struct {\n\tID          int             `json:\"id\"`\n\tAlive       bool            `json:\"alive\"`\n\tRole        string          `json:\"role\"`\n\tTerm        int             `json:\"term\"`\n\tCommitIndex int             `json:\"commit_index\"`\n\tCommitted   []EntryView     `json:\"committed\"`\n\tFullLog     []EntryView     `json:\"full_log\"`\n}\n\n// EntryView 是日志条目的可读视图。\ntype EntryView struct {\n\tIndex    int    `json:\"index\"`\n\tTerm     int    `json:\"term\"`\n\tData     string `json:\"data\"`\n\tClientID string `json:\"client_id,omitempty\"`\n}\n\n// Result 是一次运行的输出（JSON 响应）。\ntype Result struct {\n\tOK           bool              `json:\"ok\"`\n\tTicksRun     int               `json:\"ticks_run\"`\n\tTermHistory  []LeaderView      `json:\"term_history\"`\n\tAcks         []AckView         `json:\"acks\"`\n\tNodes        []NodeResult      `json:\"nodes\"`\n\tNetwork      NetworkStats      `json:\"network\"`\n\tFailures     []AssertionFailure `json:\"failures\"`\n\tTrace        []TraceEntry      `json:\"trace,omitempty\"`\n}\n\n// LeaderView 记录每个出现过领导者的任期。\ntype LeaderView struct {\n\tTerm   int `json:\"term\"`\n\tLeader int `json:\"leader\"`\n}\n\n// AckView 记录一次客户端写的确认。\ntype AckView struct {\n\tClient    string `json:\"client\"`\n\tData      string `json:\"data\"`\n\tLeader    int    `json:\"leader\"`\n\tTerm      int    `json:\"term\"`\n\tAppliedAt int    `json:\"applied_at\"`\n\tIndex     int    `json:\"index\"`\n}\n\n// NetworkStats 是网络层统计。\ntype NetworkStats struct {\n\tDropped    int `json:\"dropped\"`\n\tDuplicated int `json:\"duplicated\"`\n}\n\n// LoadScript 从 JSON 文件读取脚本。\nfunc LoadScript(path string) (*Script, error) {\n\traw, err := os.ReadFile(path)\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\treturn nil, err\n\t}\n\treturn ParseScript(raw)\n}\n\n// ParseScript 解析并校验 JSON 脚本，填充默认值。\nfunc ParseScript(raw []byte) (*Script, error) {\n\tvar s Script\n\tif err := json.Unmarshal(raw, &s); err != nil {\n\t\treturn nil, fmt.Errorf(\"脚本 JSON 解析失败: %w\", err)\n\t}\n\tif err := s.fillDefaultsAndValidate(); err != nil {\n\t\treturn nil, err\n\t}\n\treturn &s, nil\n}\n\nfunc (s *Script) fillDefaultsAndValidate() error {\n\tif s.Nodes == 0 {\n\t\ts.Nodes = 3\n\t}\n\tif s.Nodes != 3 {\n\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"本项目固定 3 节点，脚本 nodes=%d\", s.Nodes)\n\t}\n\tif s.Ticks <= 0 {\n\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"ticks 必须为正数\")\n\t}\n\tif s.Heartbeat <= 0 {\n\t\ts.Heartbeat = 3\n\t}\n\tif s.ElectionLo <= 0 {\n\t\ts.ElectionLo = 8\n\t}\n\tif s.ElectionHi <= s.ElectionLo {\n\t\ts.ElectionHi = s.ElectionLo * 2\n\t}\n\tif s.Storage == \"\" {\n\t\ts.Storage = \"memory\"\n\t}\n\tif s.Storage != \"memory\" && s.Storage != \"file\" {\n\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"storage 只能是 memory 或 file，得到 %q\", s.Storage)\n\t}\n\tif s.Network.DelayTicks <= 0 {\n\t\ts.Network.DelayTicks = 1\n\t}\n\tfor _, w := range s.NodeWindows {\n\t\tif w.Node < 0 || w.Node >= s.Nodes || w.Lo <= 0 || w.Hi <= w.Lo {\n\t\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"非法 node_windows: %+v\", w)\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\tvalidKinds := map[string]bool{\n\t\t\"client_write\": true, \"crash\": true, \"restart\": true, \"wipe\": true,\n\t\t\"partition\": true, \"isolate\": true, \"link\": true,\n\t\t\"committed\": true, \"not_acked\": true, \"log_contains\": true, \"commit_index\": true,\n\t}\n\tfor i, e := range s.Events {\n\t\tif e.At < 0 || e.At > s.Ticks {\n\t\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"事件 %d 的 at 越界: %d\", i, e.At)\n\t\t}\n\t\tif !validKinds[e.Kind] {\n\t\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"事件 %d 的 kind 未知: %q\", i, e.Kind)\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\treturn nil\n}\n"},"name":"Write","type":"tool_use"}],"id":"msg_0ff493027638b4d5e16794c5","model":"auto_model/urm","role":"assistant","stop_reason":"tool_use","stop_sequence":null,"type":"message","usage":{"input_tokens":250,"cache_creation_input_tokens":0,"cache_read_input_tokens":52024,"output_tokens":2553,"output_tokens_details":{"thinking_tokens":0},"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"","iterations":[],"speed":"standard"},"stop_details":null},"wireToolInputs":{"call_nrw4oz4ay2xwf7krws3oiwsq":{"content":"// \"math/rand\"\n\t\"path/filepath\"\n\t\"sort\"\n\t\"strings\"\n\n\t\"raftdemo/internal/logstore\"\n\t\"raftdemo/internal/network\"\n\t\"raftdemo/internal/raft\"\n)\n\n// pendingWrite 跟踪一个尚未确认的客户端写。\ntype pendingWrite struct {\n\tdata    string\n\tnode    int // 提交给的节点（-1 表示当时自动选择领导者失败）\n\tterm    int\n}\n\n// Engine 执行一份脚本。\ntype Engine struct {\n\tscript *Script\n\n\trng     *mathrand.Rand\n\tnodes   []*raft.Node\n\tstores  []logstore.Store\n\tnetwork *network.Network\n\n\t// atTick[at] 是该 tick 按脚本顺序执行的事件列表。\n\tatTick map[int][]Event\n\t// writes 按 client 跟踪客户端写。\n\twrites map[string]*pendingWrite\n\t// acked 记录已经确认的 client（顺序保留在 acks 中）。\n\tacks []AckView\n\t// termLeaders 记录每个任期出现过的领导者（安全断言：每个任期至多一个）。\n\ttermLeaders map[int]int\n\t// leaders 按首次出现顺序保存，供结果输出。\n\tleaderOrder []int\n\n\tfailures []AssertionFailure\n\ttrace    []TraceEntry\n\tmaxTrace int\n}\n\n// Run 执行脚本并返回结果。失败的断言/不变量记录在 Result.Failures 中，\n// 此时 Result.OK 为 false。\nfunc Run(s *Script) Result {\n\treturn RunWithTrace(s, 0)\n}\n\n// RunWithTrace 与 Run 相同，但 maxTrace>0 时收集最多 maxTrace 条运行轨迹。\nfunc RunWithTrace(s *Script, maxTrace int) Result {\n\te := &Engine{\n\t\tscript:      s,\n\t\tatTick:      map[int][]Event{},\n\t\twrites:      map[string]*pendingWrite{},\n\t\ttermLeaders: map[int]int{},\n\t\tmaxTrace:    maxTrace,\n\t}\n\treturn e.run()\n}\n\nfunc (e *Engine) fail(at int, kind, format string, args ...any) {\n\te.failures = append(e.failures, AssertionFailure{\n\t\tAt: at, Kind: kind, Message: fmt.Sprintf(format, args...),\n\t})\n}\n\nfunc (e *Engine) log(t TraceEntry) {\n\tif e.maxTrace > 0 && len(e.trace) < e.maxTrace {\n\t\te.trace = append(e.trace, t)\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc (e *Engine) run() Result {\n\ts := e.script\n\te.rng = mathrand.New(mathrand.NewSource(s.Seed))\n\te.network = network.New(s.Nodes, mathrand.New(mathrand.NewSource(s.Seed+1)))\n\n\t// 全局网络默认参数。\n\tfor i := 0; i < s.Nodes; i++ {\n\t\tfor j := 0; j < s.Nodes; j++ {\n\t\t\tif i == j {\n\t\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t\te.network.SetLink(i, j, &network.Link{\n\t\t\t\tDelayTicks: s.Network.DelayTicks,\n\t\t\t\tJitter:     s.Network.Jitter,\n\t\t\t\tLossRate:   s.Network.LossRate,\n\t\t\t\tDupRate:    s.Network.DupRate,\n\t\t\t})\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\n\t// 事件索引化。\n\tfor _, ev := range s.Events {\n\t\te.atTick[ev.At] = append(e.atTick[ev.At], ev)\n\t}\n\n\t// 构建节点与存储。\n\te.nodes = make([]*raft.Node, s.Nodes)\n\te.stores = make([]logstore.Store, s.Nodes)\n\tfor id := 0; id < s.Nodes; id++ {\n\t\te.stores[id] = e.makeStore(id)\n\t\tlo, hi := s.ElectionLo, s.ElectionHi\n\t\tfor _, w := range s.NodeWindows {\n\t\t\tif w.Node == id {\n\t\t\t\tlo, hi = w.Lo, w.Hi\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t}\n\t\tnode, err := raft.NewNode(raft.Config{\n\t\t\tID: id, N: s.Nodes,\n\t\t\tHeartbeatTicks: s.Heartbeat,\n\t\t\tElecLo:         lo, ElecHi: hi,\n\t\t\tSeed: s.Seed + int64(id)*7919 + 1,\n\t\t}, e.stores[id])\n\t\tif err != nil {\n\t\t\treturn Result{OK: false, Failures: []AssertionFailure{{\n\t\t\t\tAt: 0, Kind: \"config\", Message: err.Error(),\n\t\t\t}}}\n\t\t}\n\t\tnodeID := id\n\t\tnode.Send = func(from, to int, m raft.Msg) {\n\t\t\t// 发送时源节点已崩溃则消息作废（崩溃瞬间尚未进入网络的报文不再发出）。\n\t\t\tif !e.nodes[from].Alive() {\n\t\t\t\treturn\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t\te.network.Send(from, m)\n\t\t}\n\t\tnode.OnLeader = func(nid, term int) {\n\t\t\tif prev, ok := e.termLeaders[term]; ok && prev != nid {\n\t\t\t\te.fail(0, \"election_safety\",\n\t\t\t\t\t\"任期 %d 出现两个领导者：节点 %d 与节点 %d\", term, prev, nid)\n\t\t\t} else if !ok {\n\t\t\t\te.termLeaders[term] = nid\n\t\t\t\te.leaderOrder = append(e.leaderOrder, term)\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t\te.log(TraceEntry{Event: \"leader\", Node: nid, Term: term})\n\t\t}\n\t\tnode.OnApplied = func(nid int, en logstore.Entry) {\n\t\t\te.log(TraceEntry{Event: \"apply\", Node: nid, Term: en.Term, Data: en.Data, Client: en.ClientID})\n\t\t\tif en.ClientID == \"\" {\n\t\t\t\treturn\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t\t// 只有提交时仍是该客户端所请求的那个领导者，才确认写请求。\n\t\t\tif w, ok := e.writes[en.ClientID]; ok {\n\t\t\t\tif e.nodes[nid].Role() == raft.Leader && w.node == nid {\n\t\t\t\t\tidx := -1\n\t\t\t\t\tfor i := 1; i <= node.LastLogIndex(); i++ {\n\t\t\t\t\t\tif node.LogSnapshot()[i].ClientID == en.ClientID {\n\t\t\t\t\t\t\tidx = i\n\t\t\t\t\t\t\tbreak\n\t\t\t\t\t\t}\n\t\t\t\t\t}\n\t\t\t\t\te.acks = append(e.acks, AckView{\n\t\t\t\t\t\tClient: en.ClientID, Data: en.Data, Leader: nid,\n\t\t\t\t\t\tTerm: w.term, AppliedAt: -1, Index: idx,\n\t\t\t\t\t})\n\t\t\t\t\tdelete(e.writes, en.ClientID)\n\t\t\t\t}\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t}\n\t\te.nodes[id] = node\n\t\t_ = nodeID\n\t}\n\n\t// 主循环。\n\tfor now := 0; now <= s.Ticks; now++ {\n\t\t// 1) 脚本事件（写、崩溃、分区、断言）。\n\t\tfor _, ev := range e.atTick[now] {\n\t\t\te.dispatch(now, ev)\n\t\t}\n\t\t// 2) 投递本 tick 到期的网络消息（崩溃节点不接收）。\n\t\tfor _, m := range e.network.Tick(now) {\n\t\t\tif e.nodes[m.To].Alive() {\n\t\t\t\te.nodes[m.To].Handle(now, m)\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t}\n\t\t// 3) 节点时钟。\n\t\tfor _, n := range e.nodes {\n\t\t\tn.Tick(now)\n\t\t}\n\t\t// 4) 回填确认时刻并做周期性安全检查。\n\t\te.stampAcks(now)\n\t\te.checkCommitAgreement(now)\n\t}\n\n\t// 收尾：安全不变量终检。\n\te.finalAckSafety()\n\tres := e.buildResult()\n\tres.TicksRun = s.Ticks\n\tres.Network = NetworkStats{\n\t\tDropped: e.network.Dropped(), Duplicated: e.network.Duplicated(),\n\t}\n\tres.OK = len(e.failures) == 0\n\treturn res\n}\n\nfunc (e *Engine) makeStore(id int) logstore.Store {\n\tswitch e.script.Storage {\n\tcase \"file\":\n\t\tif e.script.StateDir == \"\" {\n\t\t\t// 未指定目录时退回内存存储并记录（CLI 层会先校验，这里只是防御）。\n\t\t\treturn logstore.NewMemStore()\n\t\t}\n\t\tdir := filepath.Join(e.script.StateDir, fmt.Sprintf(\"node%d\", id))\n\t\tst, err := logstore.NewFileStore(dir)\n\t\tif err != nil {\n\t\t\tpanic(err)\n\t\t}\n\t\treturn st\n\tdefault:\n\t\treturn logstore.NewMemStore()\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc (e *Engine) dispatch(now int, ev Event) {\n\tswitch ev.Kind {\n\tcase \"client_write\":\n\t\te.doClientWrite(now, ev)\n\tcase \"crash\":\n\t\tid := e.resolveTarget(ev)\n\t\tif id >= 0 {\n\t\t\te.nodes[id].Crash()\n\t\t\te.log(TraceEntry{At: now, Event: \"crash\", Node: id})\n\t\t}\n\tcase \"restart\":\n\t\tid := e.resolveTarget(ev)\n\t\tif id >= 0 {\n\t\t\tif err := e.nodes[id].Restart(now); err != nil {\n\t\t\t\te.fail(now, \"restart\", \"节点 %d 重启失败: %v\", id, err)\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t\te.log(TraceEntry{At: now, Event: \"restart\", Node: id, Term: e.nodes[id].Term()})\n\t\t}\n\tcase \"wipe\":\n\t\tid := e.resolveTarget(ev)\n\t\tif id >= 0 {\n\t\t\tif err := e.stores[id].Wipe(); err != nil {\n\t\t\t\te.fail(now, \"wipe\", \"节点 %d 清盘失败: %v\", id, err)\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t\tif e.nodes[id].Alive() {\n\t\t\t\t// 清盘仅在停机状态下有意义；若仍在运行，强制崩溃。\n\t\t\t\te.nodes[id].Crash()\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t\te.log(TraceEntry{At: now, Event: \"wipe\", Node: id})\n\t\t}\n\tcase \"partition\":\n\t\tif len(ev.Partition) != e.script.Nodes {\n\t\t\te.fail(now, \"partition\", \"partition 长度必须等于节点数\")\n\t\t\treturn\n\t\t}\n\t\te.network.SetPartition(ev.Partition, ev.Heal)\n\t\te.log(TraceEntry{At: now, Event: \"partition\", Detail: fmt.Sprint(ev.Partition)})\n\tcase \"isolate\":\n\t\tif ev.Isolated == nil {\n\t\t\te.fail(now, \"isolate\", \"缺少 isolated 字段\")\n\t\t\treturn\n\t\t}\n\t\te.network.Isolate(*ev.Isolated, ev.Heal)\n\t\te.log(TraceEntry{At: now, Event: \"isolate\", Node: *ev.Isolated})\n\tcase \"link\":\n\t\tif ev.From == nil || ev.To == nil {\n\t\t\te.fail(now, \"link\", \"缺少 from/to 字段\")\n\t\t\treturn\n\t\t}\n\t\te.network.SetLink(*ev.From, *ev.To, ev.Link)\n\tcase \"committed\":\n\t\te.assertCommitted(now, ev)\n\tcase \"not_acked\":\n\t\te.assertNotAcked(now, ev)\n\tcase \"log_contains\":\n\t\te.assertLogContains(now, ev)\n\tcase \"commit_index\":\n\t\te.assertCommitIndex(now, ev)\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc (e *Engine) resolveTarget(ev Event) int {\n\tif ev.Target != nil {\n\t\treturn *ev.Target\n\t}\n\treturn -1\n}\n\n// currentLeader 返回当前存活且自称为 leader 的节点，找不到返回 -1。\nfunc (e *Engine) currentLeader() int {\n\tfor _, n := range e.nodes {\n\t\tif n.Alive() && n.Role() == raft.Leader {\n\t\t\treturn n.ID()\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\treturn -1\n}\n\nfunc (e *Engine) doClientWrite(now int, ev Event) {\n\tif ev.Client == \"\" {\n\t\te.fail(now, \"client_write\", \"缺少 client 字段\")\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\tif _, dup := e.writes[ev.Client]; dup {\n\t\te.fail(now, \"client_write\", \"client %q 有未完成的重复写请求\", ev.Client)\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\ttarget := -1\n\tif ev.Node != nil {\n\t\ttarget = *ev.Node\n\t} else {\n\t\ttarget = e.currentLeader()\n\t}\n\tif target < 0 {\n\t\t// 无领导者：写请求立即失败，不产生任何日志（客户端稍后可重试）。\n\t\te.writes[ev.Client] = &pendingWrite{data: ev.Data, node: -1, term: -1}\n\t\te.log(TraceEntry{At: now, Event: \"write_rejected\", Client: ev.Client, Data: ev.Data, Detail: \"no leader\"})\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\tok := e.nodes[target].Submit(ev.Client, ev.Data, now)\n\tif !ok {\n\t\te.writes[ev.Client] = &pendingWrite{data: ev.Data, node: -1, term: -1}\n\t\te.log(TraceEntry{At: now, Event: \"write_rejected\", Node: target, Client: ev.Client, Data: ev.Data, Detail: \"not leader\"})\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\te.writes[ev.Client] = &pendingWrite{\n\t\tdata: ev.Data, node: target, term: e.nodes[target].Term(),\n\t}\n\te.log(TraceEntry{At: now, Event: \"write\", Node: target, Client: ev.Client, Data: ev.Data, Term: e.nodes[target].Term()})\n}\n\n// ---- 断言 ----\n\nfunc (e *Engine) isAcked(client string) bool {\n\tfor _, a := range e.acks {\n\t\tif a.Client == client {\n\t\t\treturn true\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\treturn false\n}\n\n// assertCommitted：默认要求所有存活节点的已提交前缀都包含该 client 的数据；\n// quorum=true 时要求多数派存活节点共同提交到包含该条目的位置。\nfunc (e *Engine) assertCommitted(now int, ev Event) {\n\tif ev.Client == \"\" || ev.ExpectIndex == nil {\n\t\te.fail(now, \"committed\", \"committed 断言需要 client 与 expect_index\")\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\tif !e.isAcked(ev.Client) {\n\t\te.fail(now, \"committed\", \"写请求 %q 尚未得到确认（acks=%v）\", ev.Client, e.ackClients())\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\tcheck := func(n *raft.Node) bool {\n\t\tif n.CommitIndex() < *ev.ExpectIndex {\n\t\t\treturn false\n\t\t}\n\t\treturn dataAt(n.Committed(), *ev.ExpectIndex) == ev.Data\n\t}\n\tif ev.Quorum != nil && *ev.Quorum {\n\t\tcount := 0\n\t\tfor _, n := range e.nodes {\n\t\t\tif n.Alive() && check(n) {\n\t\t\t\tcount++\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t}\n\t\tif count <= e.script.Nodes/2 {\n\t\t\te.fail(now, \"committed\", \"client %q 的数据仅在 %d 个存活节点提交到索引 %d，不足多数派\",\n\t\t\t\tev.Client, count, *ev.ExpectIndex)\n\t\t}\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\tfor _, n := range e.nodes {\n\t\tif n.Alive() && !check(n) {\n\t\t\te.fail(now, \"committed\", \"节点 %d 的已提交索引 %d 不含 %q@%d\",\n\t\t\t\tn.ID(), n.CommitIndex(), ev.Data, *ev.ExpectIndex)\n\t\t}\n\t}\n}\n\n// assertNotAcked：多数派失联时不确认写入。\nfunc (e *Engine) assertNotAcked(now int, ev Event) {\n\tif ev.Client == \"\" {\n\t\te.fail(now, \"not_acked\", \"需要 client 字段\")\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\tif e.isAcked(ev.Client) {\n\t\te.fail(now, \"not_acked\", \"写请求 %q 不应被确认，但已确认: %+v\", ev.Client, e.acks)\n\t}\n}\n\n// assertLogContains：检查某节点日志中按序包含给定数据片段。\n// full_log=true 检查完整日志（含未提交），否则只检查已提交前缀。\nfunc (e *Engine) assertLogContains(now int, ev Event) {\n\tid := e.resolveTarget(ev)\n\tif id < 0 {\n\t\te.fail(now, \"log_contains\", \"缺少 target\")\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\tvar entries []logstore.Entry\n\tif ev.FullLog != nil && *ev.FullLog {\n\t\tentries = e.nodes[id].LogSnapshot()\n\t} else {\n\t\tentries = e.nodes[id].Committed()\n\t}\n\tvar got []string\n\tfor _, en := range entries {\n\t\tgot = append(got, en.Data)\n\t}\n\tif !containsSubsequence(got, strings.Fields(ev.Data)) {\n\t\te.fail(now, \"log_contains\", \"节点 %d 日志 %v 不包含子序列 %v\", id, got, strings.Fields(ev.Data))\n\t}\n}\n\n// assertCommitIndex：检查节点（或全部存活节点）的 commitIndex。\nfunc (e *Engine) assertCommitIndex(now int, ev Event) {\n\tif ev.ExpectIndex == nil {\n\t\te.fail(now, \"commit_index\", \"缺少 expect_index\")\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\tif ev.Target != nil {\n\t\tif ci := e.nodes[*ev.Target].CommitIndex(); ci != *ev.ExpectIndex {\n\t\t\te.fail(now, \"commit_index\", \"节点 %d commitIndex=%d，期望 %d\", *ev.Target, ci, *ev.ExpectIndex)\n\t\t}\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\tfor _, n := range e.nodes {\n\t\tif n.Alive() && n.CommitIndex() != *ev.ExpectIndex {\n\t\t\te.fail(now, \"commit_index\", \"节点 %d commitIndex=%d，期望 %d\", n.ID(), n.CommitIndex(), *ev.ExpectIndex)\n\t\t}\n\t}\n}\n\n// ---- 周期性安全检查 ----\n\n// checkCommitAgreement 是验收核心：任意时刻，任意两个存活节点的已提交日志\n// 必须在共同索引上完全一致（领导者完整性 + 日志匹配性质的可观察推论）。\nfunc (e *Engine) checkCommitAgreement(now int) {\n\tfor i := 0; i < len(e.nodes); i++ {\n\t\tfor j := i + 1; j < len(e.nodes); j++ {\n\t\t\ta, b := e.nodes[i], e.nodes[j]\n\t\t\tif !a.Alive() || !b.Alive() {\n\t\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t\tca, cb := a.Committed(), b.Committed()\n\t\t\tcommon := len(ca)\n\t\t\tif len(cb) < common {\n\t\t\t\tcommon = len(cb)\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t\tfor k := 0; k < common; k++ {\n\t\t\t\tif ca[k].Term != cb[k].Term || ca[k].Data != cb[k].Data {\n\t\t\t\t\te.fail(now, \"commit_agreement\",\n\t\t\t\t\t\t\"节点 %d 与节点 %d 在已提交索引 %d 处不一致：(%d,%q) vs (%d,%q)\",\n\t\t\t\t\t\ta.ID(), b.ID(), k+1, ca[k].Term, ca[k].Data, cb[k].Term, cb[k].Data)\n\t\t\t\t\treturn\n\t\t\t\t}\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t}\n\t}\n}\n\n// finalAckSafety：所有确认过的写入，其条目必须仍存在于多数派节点的日志中，\n// 且提交内容一致（防止错误确认后条目被截断覆盖）。\nfunc (e *Engine) finalAckSafety() {\n\tfor _, a := en.Term == a.Term {\n\t\t\t\t\tcount++\n\t\t\t\t}\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t}\n\t\tif count <= e.script.Nodes/2 {\n\t\t\te.fail(e.script.Ticks, \"ack_safety\",\n\t\t\t\t\"已确认的写入 %q（client=%s, 索引=%d）仅存在于 %d 个节点日志中，不足多数派\",\n\t\t\t\ta.Data, a.Client, a.Index, count)\n\t\t}\n\t}\n}\n\n// stampAcks 在每 tick 末把确认时刻补上（OnApplied 回调内不知道全局 tick）。\nfunc (e *Engine) stampAcks(now int) {\n\tfor i := range e.acks {\n\t\tif e.acks[i].AppliedAt == -1 {\n\t\t\te.acks[i].AppliedAt = now\n\t\t}\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc (e *Engine) ackClients() []string {\n\tout := make([]string, 0, len(e.acks))\n\tfor _, a := range e.acks {\n\t\tout = append(out, a.Client)\n\t}\n\treturn out\n}\n\n// ---- 结果组装 ----\n\nfunc (e *Engine) buildResult() Result {\n\tnr := make([]NodeResult, len(e.nodes))\n\tfor i, n := range e.nodes {\n\t\tnr[i] = NodeResult{\n\t\t\tID: n.ID(), Alive: n.Alive(), Role: n.Role(), Term: n.Term(),\n\t\t\tCommitIndex: n.CommitIndex(),\n\t\t\tCommitted:   toViews(n.Committed()),\n\t\t\tFullLog:     toViews(n.LogSnapshot()[1:]),\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\thist := make([]LeaderView, 0, len(e.leaderOrder))\n\tseen := map[int]bool{}\n\tfor _, term := range e.leaderOrder {\n\t\tif seen[term] {\n\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t}\n\t\tseen[term] = true\n\t\tsort.Ints(e.leaderOrder)\n\t\thist = append(hist, LeaderView{Term: term, Leader: e.termLeaders[term]})\n\t}\n\tsort.Slice(hist, func(i, j int) bool { return hist[i].Term < hist[j].Term })\n\treturn Result{\n\t\tTermHistory: hist,\n\t\tAcks:        append([]AckView(nil), e.acks...),\n\t\tNodes:       nr,\n\t\tFailures:    append([]AssertionFailure(nil), e.failures...),\n\t\tTrace:       e.trace,\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc toViews(entries []logstore.Entry) []EntryView {\n\tout := make([]EntryView, 0, len(entries))\n\tfor i, en := range entries {\n\t\tout = append(out, EntryView{\n\t\t\tIndex: i + 1, Term: en.Term, Data: en.Data, ClientID: en.ClientID,\n\t\t})\n\t}\n\treturn out\n}\n\nfunc dataAt(committed []logstore.Entry, index int) string {\n\tif index < 1 || index > len(committed) {\n\t\treturn \"\"\n\t}\n\treturn committed[index-1].Data\n}\n\n// containsSubsequence 判断 got 是否按顺序包含全部 want（非连续匹配）。\n// 脚本里通常用空格分隔精确序列，这里允许中间插入其他条目。\nfunc containsSubsequence(got, want []string) bool {\n\tif len(want) == 0 {\n\t\treturn true\n\t}\n\tj := 0\n\tfor _, g := range got {\n\t\tif g == want[j] {\n\t\t\tj++\n\t\t\tif j == len(want) {\n\t\t\t\treturn true\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\treturn sim\n\nimport (\n\t\"fmt\"\n\tmathrand \"math/rand\"\n\t\"path/filepath\"\n\t\"sort\"\n\t\"strings\"\n\n\t\"raftdemo/internal/logstore\"\n\t\"raftdemo/internal/network\"\n\t\"raftdemo/internal/raft\"\n)\n\n// pendingWrite 跟踪一个尚未确认的客户端写。\ntype pendingWrite struct {\n\tdata    string\n\tnode    int // 提交给的节点（-1 表示当时自动选择领导者失败）\n\tterm    int\n}\n\n// Engine 执行一份脚本。\ntype Engine struct {\n\tscript *Script\n\n\trng     *mathrand.Rand\n\tnodes   []*raft.Node\n\tstores  []logstore.Store\n\tnetwork *network.Network\n\n\t// atTick[at] 是该 tick 按脚本顺序执行的事件列表。\n\tatTick map[int][]Event\n\t// writes 按 client 跟踪客户端写。\n\twrites map[string]*pendingWrite\n\t// acked 记录已经确认的 client（顺序保留在 acks 中）。\n\tacks []AckView\n\t// termLeaders 记录每个任期出现过的领导者（安全断言：每个任期至多一个）。\n\ttermLeaders map[int]int\n\t// leaders 按首次出现顺序保存，供结果输出。\n\tleaderOrder []int\n\n\tfailures []AssertionFailure\n\ttrace    []TraceEntry\n\tmaxTrace int\n}\n\n// Run 执行脚本并返回结果。失败的断言/不变量记录在 Result.Failures 中，\n// 此时 Result.OK 为 false。\nfunc Run(s *Script) Result {\n\treturn RunWithTrace(s, 0)\n}\n\n// RunWithTrace 与 Run 相同，但 maxTrace>0 时收集最多 maxTrace 条运行轨迹。\nfunc RunWithTrace(s *Script, maxTrace int) Result {\n\te := &Engine{\n\t\tscript:      s,\n\t\tatTick:      map[int][]Event{},\n\t\twrites:      map[string]*pendingWrite{},\n\t\ttermLeaders: map[int]int{},\n\t\tmaxTrace:    maxTrace,\n\t}\n\treturn e.run()\n}\n\nfunc (e *Engine) fail(at int, kind, format string, args ...any) {\n\te.failures = append(e.failures, AssertionFailure{\n\t\tAt: at, Kind: kind, Message: fmt.Sprintf(format, args...),\n\t})\n}\n\nfunc (e *Engine) log(t TraceEntry) {\n\tif e.maxTrace > 0 && len(e.trace) < e.maxTrace {\n\t\te.trace = append(e.trace, t)\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc (e *Engine) run() Result {\n\ts := e.script\n\te.rng = mathrand.New(mathrand.NewSource(s.Seed))\n\te.network = network.New(s.Nodes, mathrand.New(mathrand.NewSource(s.Seed+1)))\n\n\t// 全局网络默认参数。\n\tfor i := 0; i < s.Nodes; i++ {\n\t\tfor j := 0; j < s.Nodes; j++ {\n\t\t\tif i == j {\n\t\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t\te.network.SetLink(i, j, &network.Link{\n\t\t\t\tDelayTicks: s.Network.DelayTicks,\n\t\t\t\tJitter:     s.Network.Jitter,\n\t\t\t\tLossRate:   s.Network.LossRate,\n\t\t\t\tDupRate:    s.Network.DupRate,\n\t\t\t})\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\n\t// 事件索引化。\n\tfor _, ev := range s.Events {\n\t\te.atTick[ev.At] = append(e.atTick[ev.At], ev)\n\t}\n\n\t// 构建节点与存储。\n\te.nodes = make([]*raft.Node, s.Nodes)\n\te.stores = make([]logstore.Store, s.Nodes)\n\tfor id := 0; id < s.Nodes; id++ {\n\t\te.stores[id] = e.makeStore(id)\n\t\tlo, hi := s.ElectionLo, s.ElectionHi\n\t\tfor _, w := range s.NodeWindows {\n\t\t\tif w.Node == id {\n\t\t\t\tlo, hi = w.Lo, w.Hi\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t}\n\t\tnode, err := raft.NewNode(raft.Config{\n\t\t\tID: id, N: s.Nodes,\n\t\t\tHeartbeatTicks: s.Heartbeat,\n\t\t\tElecLo:         lo, ElecHi: hi,\n\t\t\tSeed: s.Seed + int64(id)*7919 + 1,\n\t\t}, e.stores[id])\n\t\tif err != nil {\n\t\t\treturn Result{OK: false, Failures: []AssertionFailure{{\n\t\t\t\tAt: 0, Kind: \"config\", Message: err.Error(),\n\t\t\t}}}\n\t\t}\n\t\tnodeID := id\n\t\tnode.Send = func(from, to int, m raft.Msg) {\n\t\t\t// 发送时源节点已崩溃则消息作废（崩溃瞬间尚未进入网络的报文不再发出）。\n\t\t\tif !e.nodes[from].Alive() {\n\t\t\t\treturn\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t\te.network.Send(from, m)\n\t\t}\n\t\tnode.OnLeader = func(nid, term int) {\n\t\t\tif prev, ok := e.termLeaders[term]; ok && prev != nid {\n\t\t\t\te.fail(0, \"election_safety\",\n\t\t\t\t\t\"任期 %d 出现两个领导者：节点 %d 与节点 %d\", term, prev, nid)\n\t\t\t} else if !ok {\n\t\t\t\te.termLeaders[term] = nid\n\t\t\t\te.leaderOrder = append(e.leaderOrder, term)\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t\te.log(TraceEntry{Event: \"leader\", Node: nid, Term: term})\n\t\t}\n\t\tnode.OnApplied = func(nid int, en logstore.Entry) {\n\t\t\te.log(TraceEntry{Event: \"apply\", Node: nid, Term: en.Term, Data: en.Data, Client: en.ClientID})\n\t\t\tif en.ClientID == \"\" {\n\t\t\t\treturn\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t\t// 只有提交时仍是该客户端所请求的那个领导者，才确认写请求。\n\t\t\tif w, ok := e.writes[en.ClientID]; ok {\n\t\t\t\tif e.nodes[nid].Role() == raft.Leader && w.node == nid {\n\t\t\t\t\tidx := -1\n\t\t\t\t\tfor i := 1; i <= node.LastLogIndex(); i++ {\n\t\t\t\t\t\tif node.LogSnapshot()[i].ClientID == en.ClientID {\n\t\t\t\t\t\t\tidx = i\n\t\t\t\t\t\t\tbreak\n\t\t\t\t\t\t}\n\t\t\t\t\t}\n\t\t\t\t\te.acks = append(e.acks, AckView{\n\t\t\t\t\t\tClient: en.ClientID, Data: en.Data, Leader: nid,\n\t\t\t\t\t\tTerm: w.term, AppliedAt: -1, Index: idx,\n\t\t\t\t\t})\n\t\t\t\t\tdelete(e.writes, en.ClientID)\n\t\t\t\t}\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t}\n\t\te.nodes[id] = node\n\t\t_ = nodeID\n\t}\n\n\t// 主循环。\n\tfor now := 0; now <= s.Ticks; now++ {\n\t\t// 1) 脚本事件（写、崩溃、分区、断言）。\n\t\tfor _, ev := range e.atTick[now] {\n\t\t\te.dispatch(now, ev)\n\t\t}\n\t\t// 2) 投递本 tick 到期的网络消息（崩溃节点不接收）。\n\t\tfor _, m := range e.network.Tick(now) {\n\t\t\tif e.nodes[m.To].Alive() {\n\t\t\t\te.nodes[m.To].Handle(now, m)\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t}\n\t\t// 3) 节点时钟。\n\t\tfor _, n := range e.nodes {\n\t\t\tn.Tick(now)\n\t\t}\n\t\t// 4) 回填确认时刻并做周期性安全检查。\n\t\te.stampAcks(now)\n\t\te.checkCommitAgreement(now)\n\t}\n\n\t// 收尾：安全不变量终检。\n\te.finalAckSafety()\n\tres := e.buildResult()\n\tres.TicksRun = s.Ticks\n\tres.Network = NetworkStats{\n\t\tDropped: e.network.Dropped(), Duplicated: e.network.Duplicated(),\n\t}\n\tres.OK = len(e.failures) == 0\n\treturn res\n}\n\nfunc (e *Engine) makeStore(id int) logstore.Store {\n\tswitch e.script.Storage {\n\tcase \"file\":\n\t\tif e.script.StateDir == \"\" {\n\t\t\t// 未指定目录时退回内存存储并记录（CLI 层会先校验，这里只是防御）。\n\t\t\treturn logstore.NewMemStore()\n\t\t}\n\t\tdir := filepath.Join(e.script.StateDir, fmt.Sprintf(\"node%d\", id))\n\t\tst, err := logstore.NewFileStore(dir)\n\t\tif err != nil {\n\t\t\tpanic(err)\n\t\t}\n\t\treturn st\n\tdefault:\n\t\treturn logstore.NewMemStore()\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc (e *Engine) dispatch(now int, ev Event) {\n\tswitch ev.Kind {\n\tcase \"client_write\":\n\t\te.doClientWrite(now, ev)\n\tcase \"crash\":\n\t\tid := e.resolveTarget(ev)\n\t\tif id >= 0 {\n\t\t\te.nodes[id].Crash()\n\t\t\te.log(TraceEntry{At: now, Event: \"crash\", Node: id})\n\t\t}\n\tcase \"restart\":\n\t\tid := e.resolveTarget(ev)\n\t\tif id >= 0 {\n\t\t\tif err := e.nodes[id].Restart(now); err != nil {\n\t\t\t\te.fail(now, \"restart\", \"节点 %d 重启失败: %v\", id, err)\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t\te.log(TraceEntry{At: now, Event: \"restart\", Node: id, Term: e.nodes[id].Term()})\n\t\t}\n\tcase \"wipe\":\n\t\tid := e.resolveTarget(ev)\n\t\tif id >= 0 {\n\t\t\tif err := e.stores[id].Wipe(); err != nil {\n\t\t\t\te.fail(now, \"wipe\", \"节点 %d 清盘失败: %v\", id, err)\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t\tif e.nodes[id].Alive() {\n\t\t\t\t// 清盘仅在停机状态下有意义；若仍在运行，强制崩溃。\n\t\t\t\te.nodes[id].Crash()\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t\te.log(TraceEntry{At: now, Event: \"wipe\", Node: id})\n\t\t}\n\tcase \"partition\":\n\t\tif len(ev.Partition) != e.script.Nodes {\n\t\t\te.fail(now, \"partition\", \"partition 长度必须等于节点数\")\n\t\t\treturn\n\t\t}\n\t\te.network.SetPartition(ev.Partition, ev.Heal)\n\t\te.log(TraceEntry{At: now, Event: \"partition\", Detail: fmt.Sprint(ev.Partition)})\n\tcase \"isolate\":\n\t\tif ev.Isolated == nil {\n\t\t\te.fail(now, \"isolate\", \"缺少 isolated 字段\")\n\t\t\treturn\n\t\t}\n\t\te.network.Isolate(*ev.Isolated, ev.Heal)\n\t\te.log(TraceEntry{At: now, Event: \"isolate\", Node: *ev.Isolated})\n\tcase \"link\":\n\t\tif ev.From == nil || ev.To == nil {\n\t\t\te.fail(now, \"link\", \"缺少 from/to 字段\")\n\t\t\treturn\n\t\t}\n\t\te.network.SetLink(*ev.From, *ev.To, ev.Link)\n\tcase \"committed\":\n\t\te.assertCommitted(now, ev)\n\tcase \"not_acked\":\n\t\te.assertNotAcked(now, ev)\n\tcase \"log_contains\":\n\t\te.assertLogContains(now, ev)\n\tcase \"commit_index\":\n\t\te.assertCommitIndex(now, ev)\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc (e *Engine) resolveTarget(ev Event) int {\n\tif ev.Target != nil {\n\t\treturn *ev.Target\n\t}\n\treturn -1\n}\n\n// currentLeader 返回当前存活且自称为 leader 的节点，找不到返回 -1。\nfunc (e *Engine) currentLeader() int {\n\tfor _, n := range e.nodes {\n\t\tif n.Alive() && n.Role() == raft.Leader {\n\t\t\treturn n.ID()\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\treturn -1\n}\n\nfunc (e *Engine) doClientWrite(now int, ev Event) {\n\tif ev.Client == \"\" {\n\t\te.fail(now, \"client_write\", \"缺少 client 字段\")\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\tif _, dup := e.writes[ev.Client]; dup {\n\t\te.fail(now, \"client_write\", \"client %q 有未完成的重复写请求\", ev.Client)\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\ttarget := -1\n\tif ev.Node != nil {\n\t\ttarget = *ev.Node\n\t} else {\n\t\ttarget = e.currentLeader()\n\t}\n\tif target < 0 {\n\t\t// 无领导者：写请求立即失败，不产生任何日志（客户端稍后可重试）。\n\t\te.writes[ev.Client] = &pendingWrite{data: ev.Data, node: -1, term: -1}\n\t\te.log(TraceEntry{At: now, Event: \"write_rejected\", Client: ev.Client, Data: ev.Data, Detail: \"no leader\"})\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\tok := e.nodes[target].Submit(ev.Client, ev.Data, now)\n\tif !ok {\n\t\te.writes[ev.Client] = &pendingWrite{data: ev.Data, node: -1, term: -1}\n\t\te.log(TraceEntry{At: now, Event: \"write_rejected\", Node: target, Client: ev.Client, Data: ev.Data, Detail: \"not leader\"})\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\te.writes[ev.Client] = &pendingWrite{\n\t\tdata: ev.Data, node: target, term: e.nodes[target].Term(),\n\t}\n\te.log(TraceEntry{At: now, Event: \"write\", Node: target, Client: ev.Client, Data: ev.Data, Term: e.nodes[target].Term()})\n}\n\n// ---- 断言 ----\n\nfunc (e *Engine) isAcked(client string) bool {\n\tfor _, a := range e.acks {\n\t\tif a.Client == client {\n\t\t\treturn true\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\treturn false\n}\n\n// assertCommitted：默认要求所有存活节点的已提交前缀都包含该 client 的数据；\n// quorum=true 时要求多数派存活节点共同提交到包含该条目的位置。\nfunc (e *Engine) assertCommitted(now int, ev Event) {\n\tif ev.Client == \"\" || ev.ExpectIndex == nil {\n\t\te.fail(now, \"committed\", \"committed 断言需要 client 与 expect_index\")\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\tif !e.isAcked(ev.Client) {\n\t\te.fail(now, \"committed\", \"写请求 %q 尚未得到确认（acks=%v）\", ev.Client, e.ackClients())\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\tcheck := func(n *raft.Node) bool {\n\t\tif n.CommitIndex() < *ev.ExpectIndex {\n\t\t\treturn false\n\t\t}\n\t\treturn dataAt(n.Committed(), *ev.ExpectIndex) == ev.Data\n\t}\n\tif ev.Quorum != nil && *ev.Quorum {\n\t\tcount := 0\n\t\tfor _, n := range e.nodes {\n\t\t\tif n.Alive() && check(n) {\n\t\t\t\tcount++\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t}\n\t\tif count <= e.script.Nodes/2 {\n\t\t\te.fail(now, \"committed\", \"client %q 的数据仅在 %d 个存活节点提交到索引 %d，不足多数派\",\n\t\t\t\tev.Client, count, *ev.ExpectIndex)\n\t\t}\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\tfor _, n := range e.nodes {\n\t\tif n.Alive() && !check(n) {\n\t\t\te.fail(now, \"committed\", \"节点 %d 的已提交索引 %d 不含 %q@%d\",\n\t\t\t\tn.ID(), n.CommitIndex(), ev.Data, *ev.ExpectIndex)\n\t\t}\n\t}\n}\n\n// assertNotAcked：多数派失联时不确认写入。\nfunc (e *Engine) assertNotAcked(now int, ev Event) {\n\tif ev.Client == \"\" {\n\t\te.fail(now, \"not_acked\", \"需要 client 字段\")\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\tif e.isAcked(ev.Client) {\n\t\te.fail(now, \"not_acked\", \"写请求 %q 不应被确认，但已确认: %+v\", ev.Client, e.acks)\n\t}\n}\n\n// assertLogContains：检查某节点日志中按序包含给定数据片段。\n// full_log=true 检查完整日志（含未提交），否则只检查已提交前缀。\nfunc (e *Engine) assertLogContains(now int, ev Event) {\n\tid := e.resolveTarget(ev)\n\tif id < 0 {\n\t\te.fail(now, \"log_contains\", \"缺少 target\")\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\tvar entries []logstore.Entry\n\tif ev.FullLog != nil && *ev.FullLog {\n\t\tentries = e.nodes[id].LogSnapshot()\n\t} else {\n\t\tentries = e.nodes[id].Committed()\n\t}\n\tvar got []string\n\tfor _, en := range entries {\n\t\tgot = append(got, en.Data)\n\t}\n\tif !containsSubsequence(got, strings.Fields(ev.Data)) {\n\t\te.fail(now, \"log_contains\", \"节点 %d 日志 %v 不包含子序列 %v\", id, got, strings.Fields(ev.Data))\n\t}\n}\n\n// assertCommitIndex：检查节点（或全部存活节点）的 commitIndex。\nfunc (e *Engine) assertCommitIndex(now int, ev Event) {\n\tif ev.ExpectIndex == nil {\n\t\te.fail(now, \"commit_index\", \"缺少 expect_index\")\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\tif ev.Target != nil {\n\t\tif ci := e.nodes[*ev.Target].CommitIndex(); ci != *ev.ExpectIndex {\n\t\t\te.fail(now, \"commit_index\", \"节点 %d commitIndex=%d，期望 %d\", *ev.Target, ci, *ev.ExpectIndex)\n\t\t}\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\tfor _, n := range e.nodes {\n\t\tif n.Alive() && n.CommitIndex() != *ev.ExpectIndex {\n\t\t\te.fail(now, \"commit_index\", \"节点 %d commitIndex=%d，期望 %d\", n.ID(), n.CommitIndex(), *ev.ExpectIndex)\n\t\t}\n\t}\n}\n\n// ---- 周期性安全检查 ----\n\n// checkCommitAgreement 是验收核心：任意时刻，任意两个存活节点的已提交日志\n// 必须在共同索引上完全一致（领导者完整性 + 日志匹配性质的可观察推论）。\nfunc (e *Engine) checkCommitAgreement(now int) {\n\tfor i := 0; i < len(e.nodes); i++ {\n\t\tfor j := i + 1; j < len(e.nodes); j++ {\n\t\t\ta, b := e.nodes[i], e.nodes[j]\n\t\t\tif !a.Alive() || !b.Alive() {\n\t\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t\tca, cb := a.Committed(), b.Committed()\n\t\t\tcommon := len(ca)\n\t\t\tif len(cb) < common {\n\t\t\t\tcommon = len(cb)\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t\tfor k := 0; k < common; k++ {\n\t\t\t\tif ca[k].Term != cb[k].Term || ca[k].Data != cb[k].Data {\n\t\t\t\t\te.fail(now, \"commit_agreement\",\n\t\t\t\t\t\t\"节点 %d 与节点 %d 在已提交索引 %d 处不一致：(%d,%q) vs (%d,%q)\",\n\t\t\t\t\t\ta.ID(), b.ID(), k+1, ca[k].Term, ca[k].Data, cb[k].Term, cb[k].Data)\n\t\t\t\t\treturn\n\t\t\t\t}\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t}\n\t}\n}\n\n// finalAckSafety：所有确认过的写入，其条目必须仍存在于多数派节点的日志中，\n// 且提交内容一致（防止错误确认后条目被截断覆盖）。\nfunc (e *Engine) finalAckSafety() {\n\tfor _, a := range e.acks {\n\t\tcount := 0\n\t\tfor _, n := range e.nodes {\n\t\t\tlog := n.LogSnapshot()\n\t\t\tif a.Index >= 1 && a.Index < len(log) {\n\t\t\t\tif en := log[a.Index]; en.Data == a.Data && en.Term == a.Term {\n\t\t\t\t\tcount++\n\t\t\t\t}\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t}\n\t\tif count <= e.script.Nodes/2 {\n\t\t\te.fail(e.script.Ticks, \"ack_safety\",\n\t\t\t\t\"已确认的写入 %q（client=%s, 索引=%d）仅存在于 %d 个节点日志中，不足多数派\",\n\t\t\t\ta.Data, a.Client, a.Index, count)\n\t\t}\n\t}\n}\n\n// stampAcks 在每 tick 末把确认时刻补上（OnApplied 回调内不知道全局 tick）。\nfunc (e *Engine) stampAcks(now int) {\n\tfor i := range e.acks {\n\t\tif e.acks[i].AppliedAt == -1 {\n\t\t\te.acks[i].AppliedAt = now\n\t\t}\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc (e *Engine) ackClients() []string {\n\tout := make([]string, 0, len(e.acks))\n\tfor _, a := range e.acks {\n\t\tout = append(out, a.Client)\n\t}\n\treturn out\n}\n\n// ---- 结果组装 ----\n\nfunc (e *Engine) buildResult() Result {\n\tnr := make([]NodeResult, len(e.nodes))\n\tfor i, n := range e.nodes {\n\t\tnr[i] = NodeResult{\n\t\t\tID: n.ID(), Alive: n.Alive(), Role: n.Role(), Term: n.Term(),\n\t\t\tCommitIndex: n.CommitIndex(),\n\t\t\tCommitted:   toViews(n.Committed()),\n\t\t\tFullLog:     toViews(n.LogSnapshot()[1:]),\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\thist := make([]LeaderView, 0, len(e.leaderOrder))\n\tseen := map[int]bool{}\n\tfor _, term := range e.leaderOrder {\n\t\tif seen[term] {\n\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t}\n\t\tseen[term] = true\n\t\tsort.Ints(e.leaderOrder)\n\t\thist = append(hist, LeaderView{Term: term, Leader: e.termLeaders[term]})\n\t}\n\tsort.Slice(hist, func(i, j int) bool { return hist[i].Term < hist[j].Term })\n\treturn Result{\n\t\tTermHistory: hist,\n\t\tAcks:        append([]AckView(nil), e.acks...),\n\t\tNodes:       nr,\n\t\tFailures: e.run()\n}\n\nfunc (e *Engine) fail(at int, kind, format string, args ...any) {\n\te.failures = append(e.failures, AssertionFailure{\n\t\tAt: at, Kind: kind, Message: fmt.Sprintf(format, args...),\n\t})\n}\n\nfunc (e *Engine) log(t TraceEntry) {\n\tif e.maxTrace > 0 && len(e.trace) < e.maxTrace {\n\t\te.trace = append(e.trace, t)\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc (e *Engine) run() Result {\n\ts := e.script\n\te.rng = mathrand.New(mathrand.NewSource(s.Seed))\n\te.network = network.New(s.Nodes, mathrand.New(mathrand.NewSource(s.Seed+1)))\n\n\t// 全局网络默认参数。\n\tfor i := 0; i < s.Nodes; i++ {\n\t\tfor j := 0; j < s.Nodes; j++ {\n\t\t\tif i == j {\n\t\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t\te.network.SetLink(i, j, &network.Link{\n\t\t\t\tDelayTicks: s.Network.DelayTicks,\n\t\t\t\tJitter:     s.Network.Jitter,\n\t\t\t\tLossRate:   s.Network.LossRate,\n\t\t\t\tDupRate:    s.Network.DupRate,\n\t\t\t})\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\n\t// 事件索引化。\n\tfor _, ev := range s.Events {\n\t\te.atTick[ev.At] = append(e.atTick[ev.At], ev)\n\t}\n\n\t// 构建节点与存储。\n\te.nodes = make([]*raft.Node, s.Nodes)\n\te.stores = make([]logstore.Store, s.Nodes)\n\tfor id := 0; id < s.Nodes; id++ {\n\t\te.stores[id] = err != nil {\n\t\t\treturn Result{OK: false, Failures: []AssertionFailure{{\n\t\t\t\tAt: 0, Kind: \"config\", Message: err.Error(),\n\t\t\t}}}\n\t\t}\n\t\tnodeID := id\n\t\tnode.Send = func(from, to {\n\t\t\t\te.termLeaders[term] = nid\n\t\t\t\te.leaderOrder = append(e.leaderOrder, term)\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t\te.log(TraceEntry{Event: \"leader\", Node: nid, Term: term})\n\t\t}\n\t\tnode.OnApplied = func(nid int, en logstore.Entry) {\n\t\t\te.log(TraceEntry{Event: \"apply\", Node: nid, Term: en.Term, Data: en.Data, Client: en.ClientID})\n\t\t\tif en.ClientID == \"\" {\n\t\t\t\treturn\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t\t// 只有提交时仍是该客户端所请求的那个领导者，才确认写请求。\n\t\t\tif w, ok := e.writes[en.ClientID]; ok {\n\t\t\t\tif e.nodes[nid].Role() == raft.Leader && w.node == nid {\n\t\t\t\t\tidx := -1\n\t\t\t\t\tfor i := 1; i <= node.LastLogIndex(); i++ {\n\t\t\t\t\t\tif node.LogSnapshot()[i].ClientID == en.ClientID {\n\t\t\t\t\t\t\tidx = i\n\t\t\t\t\t\t\tbreak\n\t\t\t\t\t\t}\n\t\t\t\t\t}\n\t\t\t\t\te.acks = append(e.acks, AckView{\n\t\t\t\t\t\tClient: en.ClientID, Data: en.Data, Leader: nid,\n\t\t\t\t\t\tTerm: w.term, AppliedAt: -1, Index: idx,\n\t\t\t\t\t})\n\t\t\t\t\tdelete(e.writes, en.ClientID)\n\t\t\t\t}\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t}\n\t\te.nodes[id] = node\n\t\t_ = nodeID\n\t}\n\n\t// 主循环。\n\tfor now := 0; now <= s.Ticks; now++ {\n\t\t// 1) 脚本事件（写、崩溃、分区、断言）。\n\t\tfor _, ev := range e.atTick[now] {\n\t\t\te.dispatch(now, ev)\n\t\t}\n\t\t// 2) 投递本 tick 到期的网络消息（崩溃节点不接收）。\n\t\tfor _, m := range e.network.Tick(now) {\n\t\t\tif {\n\tswitch e.script.Storage {\n\tcase \"file\":\n\t\tif e.script.StateDir == \"\" {\n\t\t\t// 未指定目录时退回内存存储并记录（CLI 层会先校验，这里只是防御）。\n\t\t\treturn logstore.NewMemStore()\n\t\t}\n\t\tdir := filepath.Join(e.script.StateDir, fmt.Sprintf(\"node%d\", id))\n\t\tst, err := logstore.NewFileStore(dir)\n\t\tif err != nil {\n\t\t\tpanic(err)\n\t\t}\n\t\treturn st\n\tdefault:\n\t\treturn logstore.NewMemStore()\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc (e *Engine) dispatch(now int, ev Event) {\n\tswitch ev.Kind {\n\tcase \"client_write\":\n\t\te.doClientWrite(now, ev)\n\tcase \"crash\":\n\t\tid := e.resolveTarget(ev)\n\t\tif id >= 0 {\n\t\t\te.nodes[id].Crash()\n\t\t\te.log(TraceEntry{At: now, Event: \"crash\", Node: id})\n\t\t}\n\tcase \"restart\":\n\t\tid := e.resolveTarget(ev)\n\t\tif id >= 0 {\n\t\t\tif err := e.nodes[id].Restart(now); err != nil {\n\t\t\t\te.fail(now, \"restart\", \"节点 %d 重启失败: %v\", id, err)\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t\te.log(TraceEntry{At: now, Event: \"restart\", Node: id, Term: e.nodes[id].Term()})\n\t\t}\n\tcase \"wipe\":\n\t\tid := e.resolveTarget(ev)\n\t\tif id >= 0 {\n\t\t\tif err := e.stores[id].Wipe(); err != nil {\n\t\t\t\te.fail(now, \"wipe\", \"节点 %d 清盘失败: %v\", id,
