\"partition\":\n\t\tif len(ev.Partition) != e.script.Nodes {\n\t\t\te.fail(now, \"partition\", \"partition 长度必须等于节点数\")\n\t\t\treturn\n\t\t}\n\t\te.network.SetPartition(ev.Partition, ev.Heal)\n\t\te.log(TraceEntry{At: now, Event: \"partition\", Detail: fmt.Sprint(ev.Partition)})\n\tcase \"isolate\":\n\t\tif ev.Isolated == nil {\n\t\t\te.fail(now, \"isolate\", \"缺少 isolated 字段\")\n\t\t\treturn\n\t\t}\n\t\te.network.Isolate(*ev.Isolated, ev.Heal)\n\t\te.log(TraceEntry{At: now, Event: \"isolate\", Node: *ev.Isolated})\n\tcase \"link\":\n\t\tif ev.From == nil || ev.To == nil {\n\t\t\te.fail(now, \"link\", \"缺少 from/to 字段\")\n\t\t\treturn\n\t\t}\n\t\te.network.SetLink(*ev.From, *ev.To, ev.Link)\n\tcase \"committed\":\n\t\te.assertCommitted(now, ev)\n\tcase \"not_acked\":\n\t\te.assertNotAcked(now, ev)\n\tcase \"log_contains\":\n\t\te.assertLogContains(now, ev)\n\tcase \"commit_index\":\n\t\te.assertCommitIndex(now, ev)\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc (e *Engine) resolveTarget(ev Event) int {\n\tif ev.Target != nil {\n\t\treturn *ev.Target\n\t}\n\treturn -1\n}\n\n// currentLeader 返回当前存活且自称为 leader 的节点，找不到返回 -1。\nfunc (e *Engine) currentLeader() int {\n\tfor _, n := range e.nodes {\n\t\tif n.Alive() && n.Role() == raft.Leader {\n\t\t\treturn n.ID()\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\treturn -1\n}\n\nfunc (e *Engine) doClientWrite(now int, ev Event) {\n\tif ev.Client == \"\" {\n\t\te.fail(now, \"client_write\", \"缺少 client 字段\")\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\tif _, dup := e.writes[ev.Client]; dup {\n\t\te.fail(now, \"client_write\", \"client %q 有未完成的重复写请求\", 无领导者：写请求立即失败，不产生任何日志（客户端稍后可重试）。\n\t\te.writes[ev.Client] = &pendingWrite{data: ev.Data, node: -1, term: -1}\n\t\te.log(TraceEntry{At: now, Event: \"write_rejected\", Client: ev.Client, Data: ev.Data, -1}\n\t\te.log(TraceEntry{At: now, Event: \"write_rejected\", Node: target, Client: ev.Client, Data: ev.Data, Detail: \"not leader\"})\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\te.writes[ev.Client] = &pendingWrite{\n\t\tdata: ev.Data, node: target, term: e.nodes[target].Term(),\n\t}\n\te.log(TraceEntry{At: now, Event: \"write\", Node: target, Client: ev.Client, Data: ev.Data, Term: e.nodes[target].Term()})\n}\n\n// ---- 断言 ----\n\nfunc (e *Engine) isAcked(client string) bool {\n\tfor _, a := range e.acks {\n\t\tif a.Client == client {\n\t\t\treturn true\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\treturn false\n}\n\n// assertCommitted：默认要求所有存活节点的已提交前缀都包含该 client 的数据；\n// quorum=true 时要求多数派存活节点共同提交到包含该条目的位置。\nfunc (e *Engine) assertCommitted(now int, ev Event) {\n\tif ev.Client == \"\" || ev.ExpectIndex == nil {\n\t\te.fail(now, \"committed\", \"committed 断言需要 client 与 expect_index\")\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\tif !e.isAcked(ev.Client) {\n\t\te.fail(now, \"committed\", \"写请求 %q 尚未得到确认（acks=%v）\", ev.Client, e.ackClients())\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\tcheck := func(n *raft.Node) bool {\n\t\tif n.CommitIndex() < *ev.ExpectIndex {\n\t\t\treturn false\n\t\t}\n\t\treturn dataAt(n.Committed(), *ev.ExpectIndex) == ev.Data\n\t}\n\tif ev.Quorum != nil && *ev.Quorum {\n\t\tcount := 0\n\t\tfor _, n := range e.nodes {\n\t\t\tif n.Alive() && check(n) {\n\t\t\t\tcount++\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t}\n\t\tif count <= e.script.Nodes/2 {\n\t\t\te.fail(now, \"committed\", \"client %q 的数据仅在 %d 个存活节点提交到索引 %d，不足多数派\",\n\t\t\t\tev.Client, count, *ev.ExpectIndex)\n\t\t}\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\tfor _, n := range e.nodes {\n\t\tif n.Alive() && !check(n) {\n\t\t\te.fail(now, \"committed\", \"节点 %d 的已提交索引 %d 不含 %q@%d\",\n\t\t\t\tn.ID(), n.CommitIndex(), ev.Data, *ev.ExpectIndex)\n\t\t}\n\t}\n}\n\n// assertNotAcked：多数派失联时不确认写入。\nfunc (e *Engine) assertNotAcked(now int, ev Event) {\n\tif ev.Client == \"\" {\n\t\te.fail(now, \"not_acked\", \"需要 client 字段\")\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\tif e.isAcked(ev.Client) {\n\t\te.fail(now, \"not_acked\", \"写请求 %q 不应被确认，但已确认: %+v\", ev.Client, e.acks)\n\t}\n}\n\n// assertLogContains：检查某节点日志中按序包含给定数据片段。\n// full_log=true 检查完整日志（含未提交），否则只检查已提交前缀。\nfunc (e *Engine) assertLogContains(now int, ev Event) {\n\tid := e.resolveTarget(ev)\n\tif id < 0 {\n\t\te.fail(now, \"log_contains\", \"缺少 target\")\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\tvar entries []logstore.Entry\n\tif ev.FullLog != nil && *ev.FullLog {\n\t\tentries = e.nodes[id].LogSnapshot()\n\t} else {\n\t\tentries = e.nodes[id].Committed()\n\t}\n\tvar got []string\n\tfor _, en := range entries {\n\t\tgot = append(got, en.Data)\n\t}\n\tif !containsSubsequence(got, strings.Fields(ev.Data)) {\n\t\te.fail(now, \"log_contains\", \"节点 %d 日志 %v 不包含子序列 %v\", id, got, strings.Fields(ev.Data))\n\t}\n}\n\n// assertCommitIndex：检查节点（或全部存活节点）的 commitIndex。\nfunc (e *Engine) assertCommitIndex(now int, ev Event) {\n\tif ev.ExpectIndex == nil {\n\t\te.fail(now, \"commit_index\", \"缺少 expect_index\")\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\tif ev.Target != nil {\n\t\tif ci := e.nodes[*ev.Target].CommitIndex(); ci != *ev.ExpectIndex {\n\t\t\te.fail(now, \"commit_index\", \"节点 %d commitIndex=%d，期望 %d\", *ev.Target, ci, *ev.ExpectIndex)\n\t\t}\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\tfor _, n := range e.nodes {\n\t\tif n.Alive() && n.CommitIndex() != *ev.ExpectIndex {\n\t\t\te.fail(now, \"commit_index\", \"节点 %d commitIndex=%d，期望 %d\", n.ID(), n.CommitIndex(), *ev.ExpectIndex)\n\t\t}\n\t}\n}\n\n// ---- 周期性安全检查 ----\n\n// checkCommitAgreement 是验收核心：任意时刻，任意两个存活节点的已提交日志\n// 必须在共同索引上完全一致（领导者完整性 + 日志匹配性质的可观察推论）。\nfunc (e *Engine) checkCommitAgreement(now int) {\n\tfor i := 0; i < len(e.nodes); i++ {\n\t\tfor j := i + 1; j < len(e.nodes); j++ {\n\t\t\ta, b := e.nodes[i], e.nodes[j]\n\t\t\tif !a.Alive() || !b.Alive() {\n\t\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t\tca, cb := a.Committed(), b.Committed()\n\t\t\tcommon := len(ca)\n\t\t\tif len(cb) < common {\n\t\t\t\tcommon = len(cb)\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t\tfor k := 0; k < common; k++ {\n\t\t\t\tif ca[k].Term != cb[k].Term || ca[k].Data != cb[k].Data {\n\t\t\t\t\te.fail(now, {"parentUuid":"2bb13342-a6a3-4235-a431-c0d5ae7191e6","isSidechain":false,"attachment":{"type":"edited_text_file","filename":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp21/a/internal/raft/raft.go","snippet":"1\t// Package raft 实现 Raft 论文（Ongaro & Ousterhout, 2014）的\"安全子集\"：\n2\t//   - 固定 3 节点，无成员变更、无快照、无日志压缩；\n3\t//   - 选举超时 + 心跳的领导者选举；\n4\t//   - 日志复制与冲突截断；\n5\t//   - 提交规则只提交当前任期的条目（§5.4.2），旧任期条目随当前任期条目一并提交；\n6\t//   - currentTerm / votedFor / log 在响应任何 RPC 或客户端写之前持久化（§5.3）。\n7\t//\n8\t// 节点不直接接触网络与时钟：由确定性离散事件模拟器注入 Tick 与消息，\n9\t// 节点产生的消息通过 Send 回调交给网络层。\n10\tpackage raft\n11\t\n12\timport (\n13\t\t\"fmt\"\n14\t\t\"math/rand\"\n15\t\n16\t\t\"raftdemo/internal/logstore\"\n17\t)\n18\t\n19\t// 角色常量。\n20\tconst (\n21\t\tFollower  = \"follower\"\n22\t\tCandidate = \"candidate\"\n23\t\tLeader    = \"leader\"\n24\t)\n25\t\n26\t// 消息类型常量。\n27\tconst (\n28\t\tMsgVoteReq  = \"voteReq\"  // RequestVote RPC\n29\t\tMsgVoteResp = \"voteResp\" // RequestVote 响应\n30\t\tMsgAppReq   = \"appReq\"   // AppendEntries RPC（同时充当心跳）\n31\t\tMsgAppResp  = \"appResp\"  // AppendEntries 响应\n32\t)\n33\t\n34\t// Msg 是节点之间的全部 RPC 消息。用一个结构体承载四种 RPC，\n35\t// 未使用字段对零值，模拟器的网络层只搬运该结构体。\n36\ttype Msg struct {\n37\t\tType string\n38\t\tTerm int\n39\t\tFrom int\n40\t\tTo   int\n41\t\n42\t\t// RequestVote\n43\t\tLastLogIndex int\n44\t\tLastLogTerm  int\n45\t\n46\t\t// RequestVote 响应\n47\t\tGranted bool\n48\t\n49\t\t// AppendEntries\n50\t\tPrevLogIndex int\n51\t\tPrevLogTerm  int\n52\t\tEntries      []logstore.Entry\n53\t\tLeaderCommit int\n54\t\n55\t\t// AppendEntries 响应（Success=false 时带回冲突提示，§5.3 优化）\n56\t\tSuccess       bool\n57\t\tConflictIndex int\n58\t\tConflictTerm  int\n59\t}\n60\t\n61\t// Config 是节点配置。选举窗口可按节点单独给出，模拟器据此构造\n62\t// 确定性的\"预定选举结果\"脚本。\n63\ttype Config struct {\n64\t\tID             int\n65\t\tN              int\n66\t\tHeartbeatTicks int\n67\t\tElecLo         int // 选举超时下界（含）\n68\t\tElecHi         int // 选举超时上界（不含）\n69\t\tSeed           int64\n70\t}\n71\t\n72\t// Node 是一个 Raft 节点。持久化状态在 store 中；崩溃只清空易失状态，\n73\t// store 由外部决定是否保留。\n74\ttype Node struct {\n75\t\tcfg   Config\n76\t\tstore logstore.Store\n77\t\trng   *rand.Rand\n78\t\n79\t\t// 持久化状态（每次变更后立即 Save）。\n80\t\tterm     int\n81\t\tvotedFor int\n82\t\tlog      []logstore.Entry // 下标即日志索引，0 号为哨兵 {Term:0}\n83\t\n84\t\t// 易失状态。\n85\t\trole             string\n86\t\tleader           int\n87\t\tcommitIndex      int\n88\t\tlastApplied      int\n89\t\telectionDeadline int // 绝对 tick；follower/candidate 到点发起选举\n90\t\telecAttempts     int // 连续选举轮次，用于独立抖动\n91\t\tnextIndex        map[int]int\n92\t\tmatchIndex       map[int]int\n93\t\tgrantedVotes     map[int]bool\n94\t\talive            bool\n95\t\tnow              int // 最近一次 Tick/Handle 的全局 tick，发送消息时用于计算投递时间\n96\t\n97\t\t// Send 由模拟器注入：把消息交给网络层。now 为发送时刻的全局 tick。\n98\t\tSend func(now, from, to int, m Msg)\n99\t\t// OnLeader 在节点成为某任期领导者时回调（模拟器用于校验\"同一任期最多一个领导者\"）。\n100\t\tOnLeader func(id, term int)\n101\t\t// OnApplied 在节点把一条日志应用到状态机时回调。\n102\t\tOnApplied func(id int, e logstore.Entry)\n103\t}\n104\t\n105\t// NewNode 从持久化存储启动一个节点（首次启动或重启都走这里）。\n106\tfunc NewNode(cfg Config, store logstore.Store) (*Node, error) {\n107\t\tif cfg.N < 1 || cfg.ID < 0 || cfg.ID >= cfg.N {\n108\t\t\treturn nil, fmt.Errorf(\"非法节点配置: id=%d n=%d\", cfg.ID, cfg.N)\n109\t\t}\n110\t\tif cfg.HeartbeatTicks <= 0 || cfg.ElecLo <= 0 || cfg.ElecHi <= cfg.ElecLo {\n111\t\t\treturn nil, fmt.Errorf(\"非法计时参数: heartbeat=%d window=[%d,%d)\", cfg.HeartbeatTicks, cfg.ElecLo, cfg.ElecHi)\n112\t\t}\n113\t\tst, err := store.Load()\n114\t\tif err != nil {\n115\t\t\treturn nil, fmt.Errorf(\"节点 %d 加载持久化状态失败: %w\", cfg.ID, err)\n116\t\t}\n117\t\tif len(st.Log) == 0 {\n118\t\t\treturn nil, fmt.Errorf(\"节点 %d 日志缺少哨兵条目\", cfg.ID)\n119\t\t}\n120\t\tn := &Node{\n121\t\t\tcfg:        cfg,\n122\t\t\tstore:      store,\n123\t\t\trng:        rand.New(rand.NewSource(cfg.Seed)),\n124\t\t\tterm:       st.CurrentTerm,\n125\t\t\tvotedFor:   st.VotedFor,\n126\t\t\tlog:        st.Log,\n127\t\t\trole:       Follower,\n128\t\t\tleader:     -1,\n129\t\t\tnextIndex:  map[int]int{},\n130\t\t\tmatchIndex: map[int]int{},\n131\t\t\talive:      true,\n132\t\t}\n133\t\tn.resetTimerAt(0, 0)\n134\t\treturn n, nil\n135\t}\n136\t\n137\t// ---- 访问器（模拟器断言用）----\n138\t\n139\tfunc (n *Node) ID() int               { return n.cfg.ID }\n140\tfunc (n *Node) Term() int             { return n.term }\n141\tfunc (n *Node) Role() string          { return n.role }\n142\tfunc (n *Node) Leader() int           { return n.leader }\n143\tfunc (n *Node) CommitIndex() int      { return n.commitIndex }\n144\tfunc (n *Node) LastApplied() int      { return n.lastApplied }\n145\tfunc (n *Node) LastLogIndex() int     { return len(n.log) - 1 }\n146\tfunc (n *Node) Alive() bool           { return n.alive }\n147\tfunc (n *Node) Now() int              { return n.now }\n148\tfunc (n *Node) Store() logstore.Store { return n.store }\n149\t\n150\t// LogSnapshot 返回完整日志的深拷贝（包含 0 号哨兵）。\n151\tfunc (n *Node) LogSnapshot() []logstore.Entry {\n152\t\tout := make([]logstore.Entry, len(n.log))\n153\t\tcopy(out, n.log)\n154\t\treturn out\n155\t}\n156\t\n157\t// Committed 返回已提交日志的深拷贝（不含哨兵）。\n158\tfunc (n *Node) Committed() []logstore.Entry {\n159\t\tout := make([]logstore.Entry, n.commitIndex)\n160\t\tcopy(out, n.log[1:n.commitIndex+1])\n161\t\treturn out\n162\t}\n163\t\n164\t// ---- 持久化辅助 ----\n165\t\n166\tfunc (n *Node) persist() error {\n167\t\treturn n.store.Save(logstore.State{\n168\t\t\tCurrentTerm: n.term,\n169\t\t\tVotedFor:    n.votedFor,\n170\t\t\tLog:         n.log,\n171\t\t})\n172\t}\n173\t\n174\t// Package sim 是确定性离散事件模拟器：按固定 tick 驱动若干 Raft 节点，\n// 按 JSON 脚本注入客户端写、崩溃/重启、网络分区与断言事件。\n//\n// 同一个脚本（相同种子）在任意机器上重复运行，结果必须逐字节一致。\npackage sim\n\nimport (\n\t\"encoding/json\"\n\t\"fmt\"\n\t\"os\"\n\n\t\"raftdemo/internal/network\"\n)\n\n// Script 是一次模拟运行的完整输入（JSON 请求）。\ntype Script struct {\n\tSeed          int64         `json:\"seed\"`\n\tTicks         int           `json:\"ticks\"`          // 总运行 tick 数（含）\n\tNodes         int           `json:\"nodes\"`          // 必须为 3（本项目固定）\n\tHeartbeat     int           `json:\"heartbeat\"`      // 心跳间隔（tick），默认 3\n\tElectionLo    int           `json:\"election_lo\"`    // 选举超时下界，默认 8\n\tElectionHi    int           `json:\"election_hi\"`    // 选举超时上界（不含），默认 16\n\tNodeWindows   []Window      `json:\"node_windows\"`   // 按节点覆盖选举窗口（用于编排确定性选举）\n\tStorage       string        `json:\"storage\"`        // \"memory\"（默认）或 \"file\"\n\tStateDir      string        `json:\"state_dir\"`      // file 存储的根目录（每节点一个子目录）\n\tNetwork       NetConfig     `json:\"network\"`        // 全局网络默认故障参数\n\tEvents        []Event       `json:\"events\"`\n}\n\n// Window 覆盖单个节点的选举超时区间。\ntype Window struct {\n\tNode int `json:\"node\"`\n\tLo   int `json:\"lo\"`\n\tHi   int `json:\"hi\"`\n}\n\n// NetConfig 是所有链路的初始故障参数。\ntype NetConfig struct {\n\tDelayTicks int     `json:\"delay_ticks\"` // 默认 1\n\tJitter     int     `json:\"jitter\"`      // 投递时间随机抖动\n\tLossRate   float64 `json:\"loss_rate\"`\n\tDupRate    float64 `json:\"dup_rate\"`\n}\n\n// Event 是脚本事件。Kind 决定使用哪些字段，未使用字段必须省略。\ntype Event struct {\n\tAt   int    `json:\"at\"`\n\tKind string `json:\"kind\"`\n\n\t// client_write\n\tClient string `json:\"client,omitempty\"`\n\tData   string `json:\"data,omitempty\"`\n\tNode   *int   `json:\"node,omitempty\"` // 不指定时发给当前领导者\n\n\t// crash / restart / wipe\n\tTarget *int `json:\"target,omitempty\"`\n\n\t// partition\n\tPartition []int `json:\"partition,omitempty\"` // 长度=N 的分区号数组\n\tHeal      bool  `json:\"heal,omitempty\"`\n\n\t// isolate\n\tIsolated *int `json:\"isolated,omitempty\"`\n\n\t// link\n\tFrom *int           `json:\"from,omitempty\"`\n\tTo   *int           `json:\"to,omitempty\"`\n\tLink *network.Link  `json:\"link,omitempty\"` // null 表示恢复默认\n\n\t// 断言类：committed / not_acked / log_contains / commit_index\n\tExpectIndex *int  `json:\"expect_index,omitempty\"`\n\tCommitted   *bool `json:\"committed,omitempty\"` // committed: 要求已提交；not_acked: 要求未确认\n\tFullLog     *bool `json:\"full_log,omitempty\"`  // log_contains：true 检查完整日志而非仅已提交\n\tQuorum      *bool `json:\"quorum,omitempty\"`    // committed/not_acked：按多数派共同提交判定\n}\n\n// AssertionFailure 记录一条失败的断言或安全不变量。\ntype AssertionFailure struct {\n\tAt      int    `json:\"at\"`\n\tKind    string `json:\"kind\"`\n\tMessage string `json:\"message\"`\n}\n\n// TraceEntry 是运行轨迹中的一条记录（精简字段，按类型取用）。\ntype TraceEntry struct {\n\tAt     int    `json:\"at\"`\n\tEvent  string `json:\"event\"`\n\tNode   int    `json:\"node,omitempty\"`\n\tTerm   int    `json:\"term,omitempty\"`\n\tRole   string `json:\"role,omitempty\"`\n\tData   string `json:\"data,omitempty\"`\n\tClient string `json:\"client,omitempty\"`\n\tDetail string `json:\"detail,omitempty\"`\n}\n\n// NodeResult 是运行结束时单个节点的状态快照。\ntype NodeResult struct {\n\tID          int             `json:\"id\"`\n\tAlive       bool            `json:\"alive\"`\n\tRole        string          `json:\"role\"`\n\tTerm        int             `json:\"term\"`\n\tCommitIndex int             `json:\"commit_index\"`\n\tCommitted   []EntryView     `json:\"committed\"`\n\tFullLog     []EntryView     `json:\"full_log\"`\n}\n\n// EntryView 是日志条目的可读视图。\ntype EntryView struct {\n\tIndex    int    `json:\"index\"`\n\tTerm     int    `json:\"term\"`\n\tData     string `json:\"data\"`\n\tClientID string `json:\"client_id,omitempty\"`\n}\n\n// Result 是一次运行的输出（JSON 响应）。\ntype Result struct {\n\tOK i < nw.n; i++ {\n\t\tfor j := 0; j < nw.n; j++ {\n\t\t\tif i == j {\n\t\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t\tnw.links[[2]int{i, j}] = &Link{DelayTicks: 1}\n\t\t}\n\t}\n}\n\n// Isolate 设置某节点与其余所有节点之间的双向隔离。","originalFile":"// Package network 模拟节点之间的网络：每条消息在未来某个 tick 投递，\n// 可配置固定延迟、随机抖动以及丢包、重复、乱序。\n//\n// 乱序的实现：每条消息的投递 tick 在 [delay, delay+jitter) 中随机抽取，\n// 消息按 (tick, 序号) 严格排序投递，因此先发可能后到。\n// 所有随机数来自模拟器注入的确定性 rand.Source，保证同脚本可复现。\npackage network\n\nimport (\n\t\"math/rand\"\n\n\t\"raftdemo/internal/raft\"\n)\n\n// pending 是网络中正在传输的消息。\ntype pending struct {\n\tdeliverAt int\n\tseq       int\n\tmsg       raft.Msg\n}\n\n// Link 描述单向链路（from->to）的故障参数。\ntype Link struct {\n\tDelayTicks int     `json:\"delay_ticks\"`\n\tJitter     int     `json:\"jitter\"`\n\tLossRate   float64 `json:\"loss_rate\"`   // [0,1)：直接丢弃的概率\n\tDupRate    float64 `json:\"dup_rate\"`    // [0,1)：额外复制一份的概率\n}\n\n// Network 维护全部链路状态与在途消息。\ntype Network struct {\n\tn       int\n\tlinks   map[[2]int]*Link\n\trng     *rand.Rand\n\tqueue   []pending\n\tseq     int\n\tdropped int\n\tdup     int\n}\n\n// New 创建网络并写入默认链路（固定 1 tick 延迟、无故障）。\nfunc New(n int, rng *rand.Rand) *Network {\n\tnw := &Network{n: n, links: map[[2]int]*Link{}, rng: rng}\n\tfor i := 0; i < n; i++ {\n\t\tfor j := 0; j < n; j++ {\n\t\t\tif i == j {\n\t\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t\tnw.links[[2]int{i, j}] = &Link{DelayTicks: 1}\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\treturn nw\n}\n\n// SetLink 更新单向链路参数（nil 表示恢复默认）。\nfunc (nw *Network) SetLink(from, to int, l *Link) {\n\tkey := [2]int{from, to}\n\tif l == nil {\n\t\tnw.links[key] = &Link{DelayTicks: 1}\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\tnw.links[key] = l\n}\n\n// SetPartition 按分区集合施加全断/恢复。\n// partition[i] 是节点 i 的分区号；不同分区间的双向链路丢包率置为 1（隔离）。\n// heal=true 时把这些链路恢复为默认。\nfunc (nw *Network) SetPartition(partition []int, heal bool) {\n\tfor i := 0; i < nw.n; i++ {\n\t\tfor j := 0; j < nw.n; j++ {\n\t\t\tif i == j {\n\t\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t\tif partition[i] != partition[j] {\n\t\t\t\tif heal {\n\t\t\t\t\tnw.SetLink(i, j, nil)\n\t\t\t\t} else {\n\t\t\t\t\tnw.SetLink(i, j, &Link{DelayTicks: 1, LossRate: 1})\n\t\t\t\t}\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t}\n\t}\n}\n\n// Isolate 设置某节点与其余所有节点之间的双向隔离。\nfunc (nw *Network) Isolate(id int, heal bool) {\n\tfor j := 0; j < nw.n; j++ {\n\t\tif j == id {\n\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t}\n\t\tif heal {\n\t\t\tnw.SetLink(id, j, nil)\n\t\t\tnw.SetLink(j, id, nil)\n\t\t} else {\n\t\t\tnw.SetLink(id, j, &Link{DelayTicks: 1, LossRate: 1})\n\t\t\tnw.SetLink(j, id, &Link{DelayTicks: 1, LossRate: 1})\n\t\t}\n\t}\n}\n\n// Send 在 now tick 发送一条消息，按链路参数决定丢弃、重复与投递时间。\nfunc (nw *Network) Send(now int, m raft.Msg) {\n\tlink := nw.links[[2]int{m.From, m.To}]\n\tif link == nil {\n\t\tlink = &Link{DelayTicks: 1}\n\t}\n\tif link.LossRate > 0 && nw.rng.Float64() < link.LossRate {\n\t\tnw.dropped++\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\tdelay := link.DelayTicks\n\tif link.Jitter > 0 {\n\t\tdelay += nw.rng.Intn(link.Jitter)\n\t}\n\tif delay < 1 {\n\t\tdelay = 1\n\t}\n\tnw.enqueue(now+delay, m)\n\tif link.DupRate > 0 && nw.rng.Float64() < link.DupRate {\n\t\tnw.dup++\n\t\t// 副本延迟独立抖动，制造重复+乱序。\n\t\td2 := link.DelayTicks\n\t\tif link.Jitter > 0 {\n\t\t\td2 += nw.rng.Intn(link.Jitter)\n\t\t}\n\t\tif d2 < 1 {\n\t\t\td2 = 1\n\t\t}\n\t\tnw.enqueue(now+d2, m)\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc (nw *Network) enqueue(at int, m raft.Msg) {\n\tnw.seq++\n\tnw.queue = append(nw.queue, pending{deliverAt: at, seq: nw.seq, msg: m})\n}\n\n// Tick 返回 now tick 应当投递的全部消息，按序号确定顺序。\nfunc (nw *Network) Tick(now int) []raft.Msg {\n\tvar out []raft.Msg\n\trest := nw.queue[:0]\n\tfor _, p := range nw.queue {\n\t\tif p.deliverAt == now {\n\t\t\tout = append(out, p.msg)\n\t\t} else {\n\t\t\trest = append(rest, p)\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\tnw.queue = rest\n\t// out 按 queue 的追加顺序生成，而 queue 按全局发送序号追加，\n\t// 因此同 tick 内投递顺序天然确定，无需再排序。\n\treturn out\n}\n\n// Pending 返回在途消息数。\nfunc (nw *Network) Pending() int { return len(nw.queue) }\n\n// Dropped 返回累计丢弃消息数。\nfunc (nw *Network) Dropped() int { return nw.dropped }\n\n// Duplicated 返回累计重复投递份数。\nfunc (nw *Network) Duplicated() int { return nw.dup }\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":82,"oldLines":6,"newStart":82,"newLines":18,"lines":["   }"," }"," ","+// ResetAll 把全部单向链路恢复为默认参数（1 tick 延迟、无故障）。","+func (nw *Network) ResetAll() {","+  for i := 0; `json:\"loss_rate\"`\n42\t\tDupRate    float64 `json:\"dup_rate\"`\n43\t}\n44\t\n45\t// Event 是脚本事件。Kind 决定使用哪些字段，未使用字段必须省略。\n46\ttype Event struct {\n47\t\tAt   int    `json:\"at\"`\n48\t\tKind string `json:\"kind\"`\n49\t\n50\t\t// client_write\n51\t\tClient string `json:\"client,omitempty\"`\n52\t\tData   string `json:\"data,omitempty\"`\n53\t\tNode   *int   `json:\"node,omitempty\"` // 不指定时发给当前领导者\n54\t\n55\t\t// crash / restart / wipe\n56\t\tTarget *int `json:\"target,omitempty\"`\n57\t\n58\t\t// partition\n59\t\tPartition []int `json:\"partition,omitempty\"` // 长度=N 的分区号数组\n60\t\tHeal      bool  `json:\"heal,omitempty\"`\n61\t\n62\t\t// isolate\n63\t\tIsolated *int `json:\"isolated,omitempty\"`\n64\t\n65\t\t// link\n66\t\tFrom *int          `json:\"from,omitempty\"`\n67\t\tTo   *int          `json:\"to,omitempty\"`\n68\t\tLink *network.Link `json:\"link,omitempty\"` // null 表示恢复默认\n69\t\n70\t\t// network_reset：无额外字段，恢复全部链路为默认参数\n71\t\n72\t\t// 断言类：committed / not_acked / log_contains / log_match / commit_index\n73\t\tExpectIndex *int  `json:\"expect_index,omitempty\"`\n74\t\tCommitted   *bool `json:\"committed,omitempty\"` // committed: 要求已提交；not_acked: 要求未确认\n75\t\tFullLog     *bool `json:\"full_log,omitempty\"`  // log_contains：true 检查完整日志而非仅已提交\n76\t\tQuorum      *bool `json:\"quorum,omitempty\"`    // committed/not_acked：按多数派共同提交判定\n77\t}\n78\t\n79\t// AssertionFailure 记录一条失败的断言或安全不变量。\n80\ttype AssertionFailure struct {\n81\t\tAt      int    `json:\"at\"`\n82\t\tKind    string `json:\"kind\"`\n83\t\tMessage string `json:\"message\"`\n84\t}\n85\t\n86\t// TraceEntry 是运行轨迹中的一条记录（精简字段，按类型取用）。\n87\ttype TraceEntry struct {\n88\t\tAt     int    `json:\"at\"`\n89\t\tEvent  string `json:\"event\"`\n90\t\tNode   int    `json:\"node,omitempty\"`\n91\t\tTerm   int    `json:\"term,omitempty\"`\n92\t\tRole   string `json:\"role,omitempty\"`\n93\t\tData   string `json:\"data,omitempty\"`\n94\t\tClient string `json:\"client,omitempty\"`\n95\t\tDetail string `json:\"detail,omitempty\"`\n96\t}\n97\t\n98\t// `json:\"role\"`\n103\t\tTerm        int         `json:\"term\"`\n104\t\tCommitIndex int         `json:\"commit_index\"`\n105\t\tCommitted   []EntryView `json:\"committed\"`\n106\t\tFullLog     []EntryView `json:\"full_log\"`\n107\t}\n108\t\n109\t// EntryView 是日志条目的可读视图。\n110\ttype EntryView struct {\n111\t\tIndex    int    `json:\"index\"`\n112\t\tTerm     int    `json:\"term\"`\n113\t\tData     string `json:\"data\"`\n114\t\tClientID string `json:\"client_id,omitempty\"`\n115\t}\n116\t\n117\t// Result 是一次运行的输出（JSON 响应）。\n118\ttype Result struct {\n119\t\tOK          bool               `json:\"ok\"`\n120\t\tTicksRun    int                `json:\"ticks_run\"`\n121\t\tTermHistory []LeaderView       `json:\"term_history\"`\n122\t\tAcks        []AckView          `json:\"acks\"`\n123\t\tNodes       []NodeResult       `json:\"nodes\"`\n124\t\tNetwork     NetworkStats       `json:\"network\"`\n125\t\tFailures    []AssertionFailure `json:\"failures\"`\n126\t\tTrace       []TraceEntry       `json:\"trace,omitempty\"`\n127\t}\n128\t\n129\t// LeaderView 记录每个出现过领导者的任期。\n130\ttype LeaderView struct {\n131\t\tTerm   int `json:\"term\"`\n132\t\tLeader int `json:\"leader\"`\n133\t}\n134\t\n135\t// AckView 记录一次客户端写的确认。\n136\ttype AckView struct {\n137\t\tClient    string `json:\"client\"`\n138\t\tData      string `json:\"data\"`\n139\t\tLeader    int    `json:\"leader\"`\n140\t\tTerm      int    `json:\"term\"`\n141\t\tAppliedAt int    `json:\"applied_at\"`\n142\t\tIndex     int    `json:\"index\"`\n143\t}\n144\t\n145\t// NetworkStats 是网络层统计。\n146\ttype NetworkStats struct {\n147\t\tDropped    int `json:\"dropped\"`\n148\t\tDuplicated int `json:\"duplicated\"`\n149\t}\n150\t\n151\t// LoadScript 从 JSON 文件读取脚本。\n152\tfunc LoadScript(path string) (*Script, error) {\n153\t\traw, err := os.ReadFile(path)\n154\t\tif err != nil {\n155\t\t\treturn nil, err\n156\t\t}\n157\t\treturn ParseScript(raw)\n158\t}\n159\t\n160\t// ParseScript 解析并校验 JSON 脚本，填充默认值。\n161\tfunc ParseScript(raw []byte) (*Script, error) {\n162\t\tvar s Script\n163\t\tif err := json.Unmarshal(raw, &s); err != nil {\n164\t\t\treturn nil, fmt.Errorf(\"脚本 JSON 解析失败: %w\", err)\n165\t\t}\n166\t\tif err := s.fillDefaultsAndValidate(); err != nil {\n167\t\t\treturn nil, err\n168\t\t}\n169\t\treturn &s, nil\n170\t}\n171\t\n172\tfunc (s *Script) fillDefaultsAndValidate() error {\n173\t\tif s.Nodes == 0 {\n174\t\t\ts.Nodes = 3\n175\t\t}\n176\t\tif s.Nodes != 3 {\n177\t\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"本项目固定 3 节点，脚本 nodes=%d\", s.Nodes)\n178\t\t}\n179\t\tif s.Ticks <= 0 {\n180\t\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"ticks 必须为正数\")\n181\t\t}\n182\t\tif s.Heartbeat <= 0 {\n183\t\t\ts.Heartbeat = 3\n184\t\t}\n185\t\tif s.ElectionLo <= 0 {\n186\t\t\ts.ElectionLo = 8\n187\t\t}\n188\t\tif s.ElectionHi <= s.ElectionLo {\n189\t\t\ts.ElectionHi = s.ElectionLo * 2\n190\t\t}\n191\t\tif s.Storage == \"\" {\n192\t\t\ts.Storage = \"memory\"\n193\t\t}\n194\t\tif s.Storage != \"memory\" && s.Storage != \"file\" {\n195\t\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"storage 只能是 memory 或 file，得到 %q\", s.Storage)\n196\t\t}\n197\t\tif s.Network.DelayTicks <= 0 {\n198\t\t\ts.Network.DelayTicks = 1\n199\t\t}\n200\t\tfor _, w := range s.NodeWindows {\n201\t\t\tif w.Node < 0 || w.Node >= s.Nodes || w.Lo <= 0 || w.Hi <= w.Lo {\n202\t\t\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"非法 node_windows: %+v\", w)\n203\t\t\t}\n204\t\t}\n205\t\tvalidKinds := map[string]bool{\n206\t\t\t\"client_write\": true, \"crash\": true, \"restart\": true, \"wipe\": true,\n207\t\t\t\"partition\": true, \"isolate\": true, \"link\": true, \"network_reset\": true,\n208\t\t\t\"committed\": true, \"not_acked\": true, \"log_contains\": true,\n209\t\t\t\"log_match\": true, \"commit_index\": true,\n210\t\t}\n211\t\tfor i, e := range s.Events {\n212\t\t\tif e.At < 0 || e.At > s.Ticks {\n213\t\t\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"事件 %d 的 at 越界: %d\", i, e.At)\n214\t\t\t}\n215\t\t\tif !validKinds[e.Kind] {\n216\t\t\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"事件 %d 的 kind 未知: %q\", i, e.Kind)\n217\t\t\t}\n218\t\t}\n219\t\treturn nil\n220\t}\n</system-reminder>"}],"session_id":"12f7a5e5-d3fc-4418-8c9a-2f2166a8c0a0","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp21/a","sessionId":"12f7a5e5-d3fc-4418-8c9a-2f2166a8c0a0","version":"2.1.280","gitBranch":"ab/run-20260922T151547Z/opp21-a","slug":"adaptive-sparking-bubble"}
{"parentUuid":"63dd2c44-9b41-4551-bbf1-f48a48042ddd","isSidechain":false,"attachment":{"type":"edited_text_file","filename":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp21/a/internal/sim/engine.go","snippet":"1\tpackage sim\n2\t\n3\timport (\n4\t\t\"fmt\"\n5\t\tmathrand \"math/rand\"\n6\t\t\"path/filepath\"\n7\t\t\"sort\"\n8\t\t\"strings\"\n9\t\n10\t\t\"raftdemo/internal/logstore\"\n11\t\t\"raftdemo/internal/network\"\n12\t\t\"raftdemo/internal/raft\"\n13\t)\n14\t\n15\t// pendingWrite 跟踪一个尚未确认的客户端写。\n16\ttype pendingWrite struct {\n17\t\tdata string\n18\t\tnode int // 提交给的节点（-1 表示当时自动选择领导者失败）\n19\t\tterm int\n20\t}\n21\t\n22\t// Engine 执行一份脚本。\n23\ttype Engine struct {\n24\t\tscript *Script\n25\t\n26\t\trng     *mathrand.Rand\n27\t\tnodes   []*raft.Node\n28\t\tstores  []logstore.Store\n29\t\tnetwork *network.Network\n30\t\n31\t\t// atTick[at] 是该 tick 按脚本顺序执行的事件列表。\n32\t\tatTick map[int][]Event\n33\t\t// writes 按 client 跟踪客户端写。\n34\t\twrites map[string]*pendingWrite\n35\t\t// acked 记录已经确认的 client（顺序保留在 acks 中）。\n36\t\tacks []AckView\n37\t\t// termLeaders 记录每个任期出现过的领导者（安全断言：每个任期至多一个）。\n38\t\ttermLeaders map[int]int\n39\t\n40\t\tfailures []AssertionFailure\n41\t\ttrace    []TraceEntry\n42\t\tmaxTrace int\n43\t}\n44\t\n45\t// Run 执行脚本并返回结果。失败的断言/不变量记录在 Result.Failures 中，\n46\t// 此时 Result.OK 为 false。\n47\tfunc Run(s *Script) Result {\n48\t\treturn RunWithTrace(s, 0)\n49\t}\n50\t\n51\t// RunWithTrace 与 Run 相同，但 maxTrace>0 时收集最多 maxTrace 条运行轨迹。\n52\tfunc RunWithTrace(s *Script, maxTrace int) Result {\n53\t\te := &Engine{\n54\t\t\tscript:      s,\n55\t\t\tatTick:      map[int][]Event{},\n56\t\t\twrites:      map[string]*pendingWrite{},\n57\t\t\ttermLeaders: map[int]int{},\n58\t\t\tmaxTrace:    maxTrace,\n59\t\t}\n60\t\treturn e.run()\n61\t}\n62\t\n63\tfunc (e *Engine) fail(at int, kind, format string, args ...any) {\n64\t\te.failures = append(e.failures, AssertionFailure{\n65\t\t\tAt: at, Kind: kind, Message: fmt.Sprintf(format, args...),\n66\t\t})\n67\t}\n68\t\n69\tfunc (e *Engine) log(t TraceEntry) {\n70\t\tif e.maxTrace > 0 && len(e.trace) < e.maxTrace {\n71\t\t\te.trace = append(e.trace, t)\n72\t\t}\n73\t}\n74\t\n75\tfunc (e *Engine) run() Result {\n76\t\ts := e.script\n77\t\te.rng = mathrand.New(mathrand.NewSource(s.Seed))\n78\t\te.network = network.New(s.Nodes, mathrand.New(mathrand.NewSource(s.Seed+1)))\n79\t\n80\t\t// 全局网络默认参数。\n81\t\tfor i := 0; i < s.Nodes; i++ {\n82\t\t\tfor j := 0; j < s.Nodes; j++ {\n83\t\t\t\tif i == j {\n84\t\t\t\t\tcontinue\n85\t\t\t\t}\n86\t\t\t\te.network.SetLink(i, j, &network.Link{\n87\t\t\t\t\tDelayTicks: s.Network.DelayTicks,\n88\t\t\t\t\tJitter:     s.Network.Jitter,\n89\t\t\t\t\tLossRate:   s.Network.LossRate,\n90\t\t\t\t\tDupRate:    s.Network.DupRate,\n91\t\t\t\t})\n92\t\t\t}\n93\t\t}\n94\t\n95\t\t// 事件索引化。\n96\t\tfor _, ev := range s.Events {\n97\t\t\te.atTick[ev.At] = append(e.atTick[ev.At], ev)\n98\t\t}\n99\t\n100\t\t// 构建节点与存储。\n101\t\te.nodes = make([]*raft.Node, s.Nodes)\n102\t\te.stores = make([]logstore.Store, s.Nodes)\n103\t\tfor id := 0; id < s.Nodes; id++ {\n104\t\t\te.stores[id] = e.makeStore(id)\n105\t\t\tlo, hi := s.ElectionLo, s.ElectionHi\n106\t\t\tfor _, w := range s.NodeWindows {\n107\t\t\t\tif w.Node == id {\n108\t\t\t\t\tlo, hi = w.Lo, w.Hi\n109\t\t\t\t}\n110\t\t\t}\n111\t\t\tnode, err := raft.NewNode(raft.Config{\n112\t\t\t\tID: id, N: s.Nodes,\n113\t\t\t\tHeartbeatTicks: s.Heartbeat,\n114\t\t\t\tElecLo:         lo, ElecHi: hi,\n115\t\t\t\tSeed: s.Seed + int64(id)*7919 + 1,\n116\t\t\t}, e.stores[id])\n117\t\t\tif err != nil {\n118\t\t\t\treturn Result{OK: false, Failures: []AssertionFailure{{\n119\t\t\t\t\tAt: 0, Kind: \"config\", Message: err.Error(),\n120\t\t\t\t}}}\n121\t\t\t}\n122\t\t\tnode.Send = func(now, from, to int, m raft.Msg) {\n123\t\t\t\t// 发送时源节点已崩溃则消息作废（崩溃瞬间尚未进入网络的报文不再发出）。\n124\t\t\t\tif !e.nodes[from].Alive() {\n125\t\t\t\t\treturn\n126\t\t\t\t}\n127\t\t\t\te.network.Send(now, m)\n128\t\t\t}\n129\t\t\tnode.OnLeader = func(nid, term int) {\n130\t\t\t\tif prev, ok := e.termLeaders[term]; ok && prev != nid {\n131\t\t\t\t\te.fail(0, \"election_safety\",\n132\t\t\t\t\t\t\"任期 %d 出现两个领导者：节点 %d 与节点 %d\", term, prev, nid)\n133\t\t\t\t} else if !ok {\n134\t\t\t\t\te.termLeaders[term] = nid\n135\t\t\t\t}\n136\t\t\t\te.log(TraceEntry{At: e.nodes[nid].Now(), Event: \"leader\", Node: nid, Term: term})\n137\t\t\t}\n138\t\t\tnode.OnApplied = func(nid int, en logstore.Entry) {\n139\t\t\t\te.log(TraceEntry{At: e.nodes[nid].Now(), Event: \"apply\", Node: nid, Term: en.Term, Data: en.Data, Client: en.ClientID})\n140\t\t\t\tif en.ClientID == \"\" {\n141\t\t\t\t\treturn\n142\t\t\t\t}\n143\t\t\t\t// 只有提交时仍是该客户端所请求的那个领导者，才确认写请求。\n144\t\t\t\tif w, ok := e.writes[en.ClientID]; ok {\n145\t\t\t\t\tif e.nodes[nid].Role() == raft.Leader && w.node == nid {\n146\t\t\t\t\t\tidx := -1\n147\t\t\t\t\t\tsnap := e.nodes[nid].LogSnapshot()\n148\t\t\t\t\t\tfor i := 1; i < len(snap); i++ {\n149\t\t\t\t\t\t\tif snap[i].ClientID == en.ClientID {\n150\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\tidx = i\n151\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\tbreak\n152\t\t\t\t\t\t\t}\n153\t\t\t\t\t\t}\n154\t\t\t\t\t\te.acks = append(e.acks, AckView{\n155\t\t\t\t\t\t\tClient: en.ClientID, Data: en.Data, Leader: nid,\n156\t\t\t\t\t\t\tTerm: w.term, AppliedAt: -1, Index: idx,\n157\t\t\t\t\t\t})\n158\t\t\t\t\t\t// 立即移除：其他 follower 随后也会应用同一条目，不能重复确认。\n159\t\t\t\t\t\tdelete(e.writes, en.ClientID)\n160\t\t\t\t\t}\n161\t\t\t\t}\n162\t\t\t}\n163\t\t\te.nodes[id] = node\n164\t\t}\n165\t\n166\t\t// 主循环。\n167\t\tfor now := 0; now <= s.Ticks; now++ {\n168\t\t\t// 1) 脚本事件（写、崩溃、分区、断言）。\n169\t\t\tfor _, ev := range e.atTick[now] {\n170\t\t\t\te.dispatch(now, ev)\n171\t\t\t}\n172\t\t\t// 2) 投递本 tick 到期的网络消息（崩溃节点不接收）。\n173\t\t\tfor _, m := range e.network.Tick(now) {\n174\t\t\t\tif e.nodes[m.To].Alive() {\n175\t\t\t\t\te.nodes[m.To].Handle(now, m)\n176\t\t\t\t}\n177\t\t\t}\n178\t\t\t// 3) 节点时钟。\n179\t\t\tfor _, n := range e.nodes {\n180\t\t\t\tn.Tick(now)\n181\t\t\t}\n182\t\t\t// 4) 回填确认时刻并做周期性安全检查。\n183\t\t\te.stampAcks(now)\n184\t\t\te.checkCommitAgreement(now)\n185\t\t}\n186\t\n187\t\t// 收尾：安全不变量终检。\n188\t\te.finalAckSafety()\n189\t\tres := e.buildResult()\n190\t\tres.TicksRun = s.Ticks\n191\t\tres.Network = NetworkStats{\n192\t\t\tDropped: e.network.Dropped(), Duplicated: e.network.Duplicated(),\n193\t\t}\n194\t\tres.OK = len(e.failures) == 0\n195\t\treturn res\n196\t}\n197\t\n198\tfunc (e *Engine) makeStore(id int) logstore.Store {\n199\t\tswitch e.script.Storage {\n200\t\tcase \"file\":\n201\t\t\tif e.script.StateDir == \"\" {\n202\t\t\t\t// 未指定目录时退回内存存储并记录（CLI 层会先校验，这里只是防御）。\n203\t\t\t\treturn logstore.NewMemStore()\n204\t\t\t}\n205\t\t\tdir := filepath.Join(e.script.StateDir, fmt.Sprintf(\"node%d\", id))\n206\t\t\tst, err := logstore.NewFileStore(dir)\n207\t\t\tif err != nil {\n208\t\t\t\tpanic(err)\n209\t\t\t}\n210\t\t\treturn st\n211\t\tdefault:\n212\t\t\treturn logstore.NewMemStore()\n213\t\t}\n214\t}\n215\t\n216\tfunc (e *Engine) dispatch(now int, ev Event) {\n217\t\tswitch ev.Kind {\n218\t\tcase \"client_write\":\n219\t\t\te.doClientWrite(now, ev)\n220\t\tcase \"crash\":\n221\t\t\tid := e.resolveTarget(ev)\n222\t\t\tif id >= 0 {\n223\t\t\t\te.nodes[id].Crash()\n224\t\t\t\te.log(TraceEntry{At: now, Event: \"crash\", Node: id})\n225\t\t\t}\n226\t\tcase \"restart\":\n227\t\t\tid := e.resolveTarget(ev)\n228\t\t\tif id >= 0 {\n229\t\t\t\tif err := e.nodes[id].Restart(now); err != nil {\n230\t\t\t\t\te.fail(now, \"restart\", \"节点 %d 重启失败: %v\", id, err)\n231\t\t\t\t}\n232\t\t\t\te.log(TraceEntry{At: now, Event: \"restart\", Node: id, Term: e.nodes[id].Term()})\n233\t\t\t}\n234\t\tcase \"wipe\":\n235\t\t\tid := e.resolveTarget(ev)\n236\t\t\tif id >= 0 {\n237\t\t\t\tif err := e.stores[id].Wipe(); err != nil {\n238\t\t\t\t\te.fail(now, \"wipe\", \"节点 %d 清盘失败: %v\", id, err)\n239\t\t\t\t}\n240\t\t\t\tif e.nodes[id].Alive() {\n241\t\t\t\t\t// 清盘仅在停机状态下有意义；若仍在运行，强制崩溃。\n242\t\t\t\t\te.nodes[id].Crash()\n243\t\t\t\t}\n244\t\t\t\te.log(TraceEntry{At: now, Event: \"wipe\", Node: id})\n245\t\t\t}\n246\t\tcase \"partition\":\n247\t\t\tif nw.Tick(t)\n\t\tfor range ms {\n\t\t\tout = append(out, t)\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\treturn out\n}\n\nfunc TestDeterministicDelivery(t *testing.T) {\n\tlink := &Link{DelayTicks: 2, Jitter: 5}\n\ta := TestLossAndDuplicate(t *testing.T) {\n\t// 全丢。\n\tticks := deliverTicks(1, &Link{DelayTicks: 1, LossRate: 1}, 100)\n\tif len(ticks) != 0 {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"LossRate=1 仍有消息投递: %d\", len(ticks))\n\t}\n\t// 全部重复：每条恰好两份。\n\tnw := New(3, rand.New(rand.NewSource(1)))\n\tnw.SetLink(0, 1, &Link{DelayTicks: 1, DupRate: 1})\n\tfor i := 0; i < 100; i++ {\n\t\tnw.Send(0, mkMsg(0, 1, i))\n\t}\n\tgot := 0\n\tfor tick := 1; tick < 50; tick++ {\n\t\tgot += len(nw.Tick(tick))\n\t}\n\tif got != 200 {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"DupRate=1 应产生 200 份投递，实际 %d\", got)\n\t}\n\tif nw.Duplicated() != 100 {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"重复计数错误: %d\", nw.Duplicated())\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc TestPartitionIsolateReset(t *testing.T) {\n\tnw := New(3, rand.New(rand.NewSource(0)))\n\tnw.Isolate(0, false)\n\tnw.Send(0, mkMsg(0, 1, 0))\n\tnw.Send(1, mkMsg(1, 0, 0))\n\tnw.Send(1, mkMsg(1, 2, 0))\n\tif nw.Dropped() != 2 {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"隔离 0 后跨区消息应被丢弃，实际 dropped=%d\", nw.Dropped())\n\t}\n\tnw.Isolate(0, true)\n\tnw.Send(0, mkMsg(0, 1, 0))\n\tif nw.Dropped() != 2 {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"恢复隔离后不应再丢消息，dropped=%d\", nw.Dropped())\n\t}\n\t// partition: {0,1} 与 {2} 分裂。\n\tnw.SetPartition([]int{0, 0, 1}, false)\n\tnw.Send(0, mkMsg(0, 2, 0))\n\tnw.Send(2, mkMsg(2, 1, 0))\n\tnw.Send(0, mkMsg(0, 1, 0))\n\tif nw.Dropped() != 4 {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"分区跨区消息应丢弃，dropped=%d\", nw.Dropped())\n\t}\n\tnw.SetPartition([]int{0, 0, 1}, true)\n\tnw.Send(0, mkMsg(0, 2, 0))\n\tif nw.Dropped() != 4 {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"分区愈合后不应再丢消息，dropped=%d\", nw.Dropped())\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc TestReorderPossibleAndDeterministic(t *testing.T) {\n\t// 大抖动下统计投递 tick 方差：存在乱序可能，且两次运行完全一致。\n\tlink := &Link{DelayTicks: 1, Jitter: 20}\n\ta := deliverTicks(7, link, 200)\n\tuniq := map[int]bool{}\n\tfor _, at := range a {\n\t\tuniq[at] = true\n\t}\n\tif len(uniq) < raft\n\nimport (\n\t\"math/rand\"\n\t\"testing\"\n\n\t\"raftdemo/internal/logstore\"\n\t\"raftdemo/internal/network\"\n)\n\n// cluster 是测试用三节点驱动：把 Node 与 Network 直接对接。\ntype cluster struct {\n\tt       *testing.T\n\tnodes   []*Node\n\tstores  []logstore.Store\n\tnetwork *network.Network\n\tnow     int\n}\n\nfunc newCluster(t *testing.T, win [][2]int, seed int64) *cluster {\n\tt.Helper()\n\tn := 3\n\tnw := network.New(n, rand.New(rand.NewSource(seed+999)))\n\tstores := make([]logstore.Store, n)\n\tnodes := make([]*Node, n)\n\tc := &cluster{t: t, nodes: nodes, stores: stores, network: nw}\n\tfor id := 0; id < n; id++ {\n\t\tstores[id] = logstore.NewMemStore()\n\t\tnode, err := NewNode(Config{\n\t\t\tID: id, N: n, HeartbeatTicks: 3,\n\t\t\tElecLo: win[id][0], ElecHi: win[id][1],\n\t\t\tSeed: seed + int64(id)*7919 + 1,\n\t\t}, stores[id])\n\t\tif err != nil {\n\t\t\tt.Fatal(err)\n\t\t}\n\t\tnode.Send = func(now, from, to int, m Msg) { nw.Send(now, m) }\n\t\tnodes[id] = node\n\t}\n\treturn c\n}\n\n// step 推进一个 tick：先投递到期消息，再驱动时钟。\nfunc (c *cluster) step() {\n\tc.now++\n\tfor _, m := range c.network.Tick(c.now) {\n\t\tif c.nodes[m.To].Alive() {\n\t\t\tc.nodes[m.To].Handle(c.now, m)\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\tfor _, n := range c.nodes {\n\t\tn.Tick(c.now)\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc (c *cluster) runUntil(maxTicks int, cond func() bool) bool {\n\tfor i := 0; i < maxTicks; i++ {\n\t\tif cond() {\n\t\t\treturn true\n\t\t}\n\t\tc.step()\n\t}\n\treturn cond()\n}\n\nfunc (c *cluster) leader() *Node {\n\tvar best *Node\n\tfor _, n := range c.nodes {\n\t\tif n.Alive() && n.Role() == Leader {\n\t\t\tif best == nil || n.Term() > best.Term() {\n\t\t\t\tbest = n\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\treturn best\n}\n\nfunc (c *cluster) committedEqual() bool {\n\tvar ref []logstore.Entry\n\tfor _, n := range c.nodes {\n\t\tif !n.Alive() {\n\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t}\n\t\tcur := n.Committed()\n\t\tif ref == nil {\n\t\t\tref = cur\n\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t}\n\t\tcommon := len(cur)\n\t\tif len(ref) < common {\n\t\t\tcommon = len(ref)\n\t\t}\n\t\tfor k := 0; k < common; k++ {\n\t\t\tif cur[k].Term != ref[k].Term || cur[k].Data != ref[k].Data {\n\t\t\t\treturn false\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\treturn true\n}\n\nfunc TestElectSingleLeader(t *testing.T) {\n\tc := newCluster(t, [][2]int{{5, 6}, {8, 9}, {10, 11}}, 1)\n\tif !c.runUntil(30, func() bool { return c.leader() != nil }) {\n\t\tt.Fatal(\"30 tick 内未选出领导者\")\n\t}\n\tleaders := map[int]int{} // term -> leader\n\tfor _, n := range c.nodes {\n\t\tif n.Role() == Leader {\n\t\t\tif prev, ok := leaders[n.Term()]; ok && prev != n.ID() {\n\t\t\t\tt.Fatalf(\"同任期出现两个 leader: 节点 %d 和 %d\", prev, n.ID())\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t\tleaders[n.Term()] = n.ID()\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\tif len(leaders) != 1 {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"期望恰好一个在任领导者，得到 term->leader=%v\", leaders)\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc TestReplicateAndCommitCurrentTerm(t *testing.T) {\n\tc := newCluster(t, [][2]int{{5, 6}, {8, 9}, {10, 11}}, 2)\n\tc.runUntil(30, func() bool { return c.leader() != nil })\n\tld := c.leader()\n\tif !ld.Submit(\"k1\", \"v1\", c.now) {\n\t\tt.Fatal(\"领导者拒绝了写入\")\n\t}\n\t// 等待多数派（含全部存活节点）提交到索引 2（1 为 noop）。\n\tok := c.runUntil(20, func() bool {\n\t\tfor _, n := range c.nodes {\n\t\t\tif n.CommitIndex() < 2 {\n\t\t\t\treturn false\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t}\n\t\treturn true\n\t})\n\tif !ok {\n\t\tt.Fatal(\"写入未在 20 tick 内复制到全部节点\")\n\t}\n\tfor _, n := range c.nodes {\n\t\tlog := n.LogSnapshot()\n\t\tif log[1].Data != \"\" || log[1].Term != ld.Term() {\n\t\t\tt.Fatalf(\"节点 %d 索引1不是本任期 noop: %+v\", n.ID(), log[1])\n\t\t}\n\t\tif log[2].Data != \"v1\" || log[2].Term != ld.Term() {\n\t\t\tt.Fatalf(\"节点 %d 索引2不是客户端数据 v1: %+v\", n.ID(), log[2])\n\t\t}\n\t}\n}\n\n// TestCommitRuleCurrentTermOnly 验证 §5.4.2：旧任期条目不能仅靠副本数提交，\n// 必须等当前任期条目一起提交。\nfunc TestCommitRuleCurrentTermOnly(t *testing.T) {\n\t// node0 先成为 leader 并复制 noop；随后分区，node0 在旧任期写入无法提交；\n\t// 新 leader（更高任期）当选并复制 noop 后，旧条目才随当前任期条目提交。\n\tc := newCluster(t, [][2]int{{4, 5}, {7, 8}, {9, 10}}, 3)\n\tc.runUntil(20, func() bool {\n\t\tl := c.leader()\n\t\treturn l != nil && l.ID() == 0 && c.nodes[1].CommitIndex() >= 1 && c.nodes[2].CommitIndex() >= 1\n\t})\n\tif c.leader() == nil || c.leader().ID() != 0 {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"预期 node0 当选，实际 %v\", c.leader())\n\t}\n\t// 隔离 node0。\n\tc.network.Isolate(0, false)\n\t// node0 在旧任期追加一条客户端数据，但无法获得多数派。\n\tif !c.nodes[0].Submit(\"stale\", \"old-term-entry\", c.now) {\n\t\tt.Fatal(\"node0 仍是本分区 leader，应接受写入（但不能提交）\")\n\t}\n\tfor i := 0; i < 20; i++ {\n\t\tc.step()\n\t\tif c.nodes[0].CommitIndex() >= 2 {\n\t\t\tt.Fatal(\"多数派失联期间旧任期条目被错误提交\")\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\t// 恢复网络；更高任期 leader 出现并追加当前任期 noop，旧条目最终被覆盖/提交。\n\tc.network.Isolate(0, true)\n\tok := c.runUntil(60, func() bool {\n\t\tif !c.committedEqual() {\n\t\t\treturn false\n\t\t}\n\t\t// 旧条目要么被新 leader 的同索引新任期条目覆盖，要么随当前任期提交，\n\t\t// 无论哪种：所有节点索引 2 的已提交内容必须一致。\n\t\tfor _, n := range c.nodes {\n\t\t\tif n.CommitIndex() < 2 {\n\t\t\t\treturn false\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t}\n\t\treturn true\n\t})\n\tif !ok {\n\t\tt.Fatal(\"网络恢复后日志未在 60 tick 内收敛一致\")\n\t}\n}\n\n// TestConflictTruncation 验证 §5.3：follower 同索引不同任期的旧条目被截断覆盖。\nfunc TestConflictTruncation(t *testing.T) {\n\tc := newCluster(t, [][2]int{{4, 5}, {6, 7}, {8, 9}}, 4)\n\tc.runUntil(20, func() bool {\n\t\tl := c.leader()\n\t\treturn l != nil && c.nodes[1].CommitIndex() >= 1 && c.nodes[2].CommitIndex() >= 1\n\t})\n\told := c.leader()\n\t// 让旧 leader 与集群隔离并在本地累积未提交的不同后缀。\n\tc.network.Isolate(old.ID(), false)\n\t// 同时让其余节点选出新 leader 并产生已提交写入。\n\tc.runUntil(40, func() bool {\n\t\tl := c.leader()\n\t\treturn l != nil && l.ID() != old.ID()\n\t})\n\tnewLeader := c.leader()\n\tif !newLeader.Submit(\"new\", \"committed-new\", c.now) {\n\t\tt.Fatal(\"新 leader 拒绝写入\")\n\t}\n\tc.runUntil(20, func() bool {\n\t\t// 除旧 leader 外的节点提交到新条目。\n\t\tfor _, n := range c.nodes {\n\t\t\tif n.ID() == old.ID() {\n\t\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t\tif n.CommitIndex() < newLeader.LastLogIndex() {\n\t\t\t\treturn false\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t}\n\t\treturn true\n\t})\n\t// 旧 leader 在隔离期也写入（陈旧后缀）。\n\told.Submit(\"ghost\", \"stale-suffix\", c.now)\n\t// 恢复网络，等待日志收敛。\n\tc.network.Isolate(old.ID(), true)\n\tok := c.runUntil(60, func() bool {\n\t\tref := c.nodes[newLeader.ID()].LogSnapshot()\n\t\to := old.LogSnapshot()\n\t\tif len(o) != len(ref) {\n\t\t\treturn false\n\t\t}\n\t\tfor k := 1; k < len(ref); k++ {\n\t\t\tif o[k].Term != ref[k].Term || o[k].Data != ref[k].Data {\n\t\t\t\treturn false\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t}\n\t\treturn true\n\t})\n\tif !ok {\n\t\tvar got [][]logstore.Entry\n\t\tfor _, n := range c.nodes {\n\t\t\tgot = append(got, n.LogSnapshot())\n\t\t}\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"恢复后旧 leader 日志未被截断覆盖一致: %v\", got)\n\t}\n}\n\n// TestPersistedVoteAndTerm 验证崩溃重启后任期与投票持久化：\n// 同一任期内重启的节点不会把票再投给别人，也不会忘记自己投过的票。\nfunc TestPersistedVoteAndTerm(t *testing.T) {\n\tc := newCluster(t, [][2]int{{4, 5}, {6, 7}, {8, 9}}, 5)\n\tc.runUntil(20, func() bool { return c.leader() != nil })\n\tld := c.leader()\n\ttermBefore := ld.Term()\n\t// 让一个 follower 崩溃并立即重启（保留 MemStore）。\n\tfid := -1\n\tfor _, n := range c.nodes {\n\t\tif n.ID() != ld.ID() {\n\t\t\tfid = n.ID()\n\t\t\tbreak\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\tf := c.nodes[fid]\n\tstoredTerm := f.Term()\n\tf.Crash()\n\tif err := f.Restart(c.now); err != nil {\n\t\tt.Fatal(err)\n\t}\n\tif f.Term() != storedTerm {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"重启后任期丢失: %d vs %d\", f.Term(), storedTerm)\n\t}\n\tif f.Role() != Follower {\n\t\tt.Fatal(\"重启后角色应为 follower\")\n\t}\n\t// 旧任期的 RequestVote 必须被拒绝。\n\tf.Handle(c.now, Msg{\n\t\tType: MsgVoteReq, Term: termBefore, From: ld.ID(),\n\t\tLastLogIndex: 1, LastLogTerm: termBefore,\n\t})\n\t// 不应因过期拉票而授予选票（votedFor 持久化）。\n\tif f.votedFor == -1 {\n\t\t// 该 follower 可能此前未投过票（leader 是靠它投票上来的，实际一定投过）；\n\t\t// 但用更严格条件：它必然为当前 leader 投过票。\n\t\tt.Fatal(\"follower 在 leader 当选的任期内却没有持久化选票\")\n\t}\n}\n\n// TestStaleLeaderStepsDown 验证旧领导者收到更高任期响应后下台，\n// 且不会在旧任期提交新条目。\nfunc TestStaleLeaderStepsDown(t *testing.T) {\n\tc := newCluster(t, [][2]int{{4, 5}, {6, 7}, {8, 9}}, 6)\n\tc.runUntil(20, func() bool {\n\t\tl := c.leader()\n\t\treturn l != nil && c.nodes[1].CommitIndex() >= 1 && c.nodes[2].CommitIndex() >= 1\n\t})\n\told := c.leader()\n\toldTerm := old.Term()\n\tc.network.Isolate(old.ID(), false)\n\t// 等待其他节点选出更高任期 leader。\n\tc.runUntil(50, func() bool {\n\t\tfor _, n := range c.nodes {\n\t\t\tif n.ID() != old.ID() && n.Term() > oldTerm {\n\t\t\t\treturn true\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t}\n\t\treturn false\n\t})\n\thigher := oldTerm + 1\n\tfor _, n := range c.nodes {\n\t\tif n.ID() != old.ID() && n.Term() > higher {\n\t\t\thigher = n.Term()\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\t// 直接给旧 leader 投递一条更高任期的 AppendEntries 响应，模拟它恢复后接触新任期。\n\told.Handle(c.now, Msg{\n\t\tType: MsgAppResp, Term: higher, From: (old.ID() + 1) % 3,\n\t\tSuccess: false, ConflictIndex: 1,\n\t})\n\tif old.Role() != Follower || old.Term() != higher {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"旧 leader 未在更高任期下台: role=%s term=%d\", old.Role(), old.Term())\n\t}\n\tif old.Submit(\"x\", \"y\", c.now) {\n\t\tt.Fatal(\"已下台的旧 leader (\n\t\"encoding/json\"\n\t\"errors\"\n\t\"fmt\"\n\t\"os\"\n\t\"path/filepath\"\n)\n\n// Entry 是一条 Raft 日志条目。ClientID 非空时表示客户端写请求，\n// 提交时模拟器据此向客户端确认；为空表示空操作（本项目不使用 noop 日志）。\ntype Entry struct `json:\"log\"`\n}\n\n// Store 是持久化存储接口。Save 必须在返回前完成\"落盘\"（内存实现即写内存，\n// 文件实现即 fsync 完成），Raft 只在 Save 成功后才发送 RPC 或回应客户端。\ntype Store interface {\n\tLoad() (State, error)\n\tSave(State) error\n\t// Wipe 清除全部持久化数据（模拟磁盘损坏）。\n\tWipe() error\n}\n\n// MemStore 是确定性的进程内\"磁盘\"。\ntype MemStore struct {\n\tstate State\n}\n\n// NewMemStore 创建空内存存储：任期 0，未投票，仅含哨兵条目。\nfunc NewMemStore() *MemStore {\n\treturn \"seed\": 1, \"ticks\": 30,\n\t  \"node_windows\": [{\"node\":0,\"lo\":4,\"hi\":5},{\"node\":1,\"lo\":8,\"hi\":9},{\"node\":2,\"lo\":10,\"hi\":11}],\n\t  \"events\": [\n\t    {\"at\": 8, \"kind\": \"client_write\", \"client\": \"c1\", \"data\": \"hello\"},\n\t    {\"at\": 20, \"kind\": \"committed\", \"client\": \"c1\", \"data\": \"hello\", \"expect_index\": 2},\n\t    {\"at\": 21, \"kind\": \"log_match\"}\n\t  ]\n\t}`)\n\tr := Run(s)\n\tif !r.OK {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"基本选举+写入应通过，失败: %v\", r.Failures)\n\t}\n\tif len(r.TermHistory) == 0 {\n\t\tt.Fatal(\"结果中没有任何 leader 记录\")\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc TestDeterminism(t *testing.T) {\n\ts := parseT(t, `{\n\t  \"seed\": 314, \"ticks\": 80,\n\t  \"network\": {\"delay_ticks\": 1, \"jitter\": 4, \"loss_rate\": 0.1, \"dup_rate\": 0.05},\n\t  \"events\": \"a\", \"data\": \"d1\"},\n\t    {\"at\": 75, \"kind\": \"log_match\"}\n\t  ]\n\t}`)\n\tr1 := RunWithTrace(s, 1000)\n\tr2 := RunWithTrace(s, 1000)\n\tb1, _ := json.Marshal(r1)\n\tb2, _ := json.Marshal(r2)\n\tif string(b1) != string(b2) {\n\t\tt.Fatal(\"相同脚本两次运行结果不一致（非确定性）\")\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc TestMajorityLostNoAck(t *testing.T) {\n\ts := parseT(t, `{\n\t  \"seed\": 5, \"ticks\": 45,\n\t  \"node_windows\": [{\"node\":0,\"lo\":4,\"hi\":5},{\"node\":1,\"lo\":8,\"hi\":9},{\"node\":2,\"lo\":10,\"hi\":11}],\n\t  \"events\": [\n\t    {\"at\": 7, \"kind\": \"crash\", \"target\": 1},\n\t    {\"at\": 7, \"kind\": \"crash\", \"target\": 2},\n\t    {\"at\": 12, \"kind\": \"client_write\", \"client\": \"w\", \"data\": \"blocked\", \"node\": 0},\n\t    {\"at\": 30, \"kind\": \"not_acked\", {\"at\": 16, \"kind\": \"crash\", \"target\": 1},\n\t    {\"at\": 16, \"kind\": \"crash\", \"target\": 2}\n\t  ]\n\t}`)\n\tr1 := Run(first)\n\tif !r1.OK {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"第一阶段（写入并持久化）失败: %v\", {\n\t\t\tt.Fatalf(\"节点 %d 持久化文件不存在: %v\", id, err)\n\t\t}\n\t\tif !strings.Contains(string(raw), \"durable\") {\n\t\t\tt.Fatalf(\"节点 %d 持久化文件不含已提交数据\", id)\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\t// 第二次\"进程\"：全新 Engine，从磁盘恢复。\n\tsecond := parseT(t, `{\n\t  \"seed\": 11, \"ticks\": 45,\n\t  \"storage\": \"file\", \"state_dir\": \"`+dir+`\",\n\t  \"node_windows\": [{\"node\":0,\"lo\":6,\"hi\":7},{\"node\":1,\"lo\":8,\"hi\":9},{\"node\":2,\"lo\":10,\"hi\":11}],\n\t  \"events\": [\n\t    {\"at\": 0,  \"kind\": \"log_contains\", \"target\": 0, \"data\": \"durable\", \"full_log\": true},\n\t    {\"at\": 0,  \"kind\": \"log_contains\", \"target\": 1, \"data\": \"durable\", \"full_log\": true},\n\t    {\"at\": 0,  \"kind\": \"log_contains\", \"target\": 2, \"data\": \"durable\", \"full_log\": true},\n\t    {\"at\": 40, \"kind\": \"client_write\", \"client\": \"k2\", \"data\": \"after-restart\"},\n\t    {\"at\": 44, \"kind\": \"log_contains\", \"target\": 0, \"data\": \"durable after-restart\", \"full_log\": true}\n\t  ]\n\t}`)\n\tr2 := Run(second)\n\tif !r2.OK {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"第二阶段（跨进程恢复）失败: %v\", r2.Failures)\n\t}\n\t// 重启后各节点日志长度至少为 {\n\t\t\tt.Fatalf(\"节点 %d 恢复后丢失已提交数据: %v\", n.ID, n.FullLog)\n\t\t}\n\t\tif n.Term < 1 {\n\t\t\tt.Fatalf(\"节点 %d 重启后任期回退: %d\", n.ID, n.Term)\n\t\t}\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc TestWipeLosesState(t *testing.T) {\n\ts := parseT(t, `{\n\t  \"seed\": 21, \"ticks\": 50,\n\t  \"node_windows\": [{\"node\":0,\"lo\":4,\"hi\":5},{\"node\":1,\"lo\":8,\"hi\":9},{\"node\":2,\"lo\":10,\"hi\":11}],\n\t  \"events\": [\n\t    {\"at\": 7, \"kind\": \"client_write\", \"client\": \"k\", \"data\": \"persisted\"},\n\t    {\"at\": 14, \"kind\": \"committed\", \"client\": \"k\", \"data\": \"persisted\", \"expect_index\": seed <= seeds; seed++ {\n\t\tt.Run(fmt.Sprintf(\"seed=%d\", seed), func(t *testing.T) {\n\t\t\trng := mathrand.New(mathrand.NewSource(seed * 1009))\n\t\t\ts := &Script{\n\t\t\t\tSeed:       seed * 7919,\n\t\t\t\tTicks:      ticks,\n\t\t\t\tNodes:      3,\n\t\t\t\tHeartbeat:  3,\n\t\t\t\tElectionLo: 6,\n\t\t\t\tElectionHi: 12,\n\t\t\t\tNetwork:    NetConfig{DelayTicks: 1, Jitter: 2, LossRate: 0.05, DupRate: 0.03},\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t\tcrashed := map[int]bool{}\n\t\t\tisolated := map[int]bool{}\n\t\t\twriteSeq := 0\n\t\t\tnextWrite := 8\n\t\t\tfor at := 1; at < healAt; at++ {\n\t\t\t\t// 约 8% 的 tick 对随机节点制造/恢复崩溃。\n\t\t\t\tif rng.Intn(100) < 8 {\n\t\t\t\t\tid := rng.Intn(3)\n\t\t\t\t\tif !crashed[id] {\n\t\t\t\t\t\ts.Events = append(s.Events, Event{At: at, Kind: \"crash\", Target: &id})\n\t\t\t\t\t\tcrashed[id] = true\n\t\t\t\t\t}\n\t\t\t\t}\n\t\t\t\tif rng.Intn(100) < 10 {\n\t\t\t\t\tid := rng.Intn(3)\n\t\t\t\t\tif crashed[id] {\n\t\t\t\t\t\ts.Events = append(s.Events, Event{At: at, Kind: \"restart\", Target: &id})\n\t\t\t\t\t\tcrashed[id] = false\n\t\t\t\t\t}\n\t\t\t\t}\n\t\t\t\t// 约 7% 的 tick 切换某节点隔离状态。\n\t\t\t\tif rng.Intn(100) < 7 {\n\t\t\t\t\tid := rng.Intn(3)\n\t\t\t\t\ts.Events = append(s.Events, Event{At: at, Kind: \"isolate\", Isolated: &id, Heal: isolated[id]})\n\t\t\t\t\tisolated[id] = !isolated[id]\n\t\t\t\t}\n\t\t\t\t// 每隔若干 tick 尝试一次客户端写（发给当前领导者，由引擎解析）。\n\t\t\t\tif at >= nextWrite {\n\t\t\t\t\twriteSeq++\n\t\t\t\t\ts.Events = append(s.Events, Event{\n\t\t\t\t\t\tAt: at, Kind: \"client_write\",\n\t\t\t\t\t\tClient: fmt.Sprintf(\"w%d\", writeSeq),\n\t\t\t\t\t\tData:   fmt.Sprintf(\"data-%d\", writeSeq),\n\t\t\t\t\t})\n\t\t\t\t\tnextWrite = at + 3 + rng.Intn(5)\n\t\t\t\t}\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t\t// 愈合阶段：重启全部崩溃节点、解除全部隔离、重置链路。\n\t\t\tfor id := 0; id < 3; id++ {\n\t\t\t\tif crashed[id] {\n\t\t\t\t\ti := id\n\t\t\t\t\ts.Events = append(s.Events, Event{At: healAt, Kind: \"restart\", Target: &i})\n\t\t\t\t}\n\t\t\t\tif isolated[id] {\n\t\t\t\t\ti := id\n\t\t\t\t\ts.Events = append(s.Events, Event{At: healAt, Kind: \"isolate\", Isolated: &i, Heal: true})\n\t\t\t\t}\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t\ts.Events = append(s.Events, Event{At: healAt, Kind: \"network_reset\"})\n\t\t\t// 愈合后给足够长的安静期完成追赶，然后要求最终一致。\n\t\t\ts.Events = append(s.Events, Event{At: ticks - 5, Kind: \"log_match\"})\n\n\t\t\tif err := s.fillDefaultsAndValidate(); err != nil {\n\t\t\t\tt.Fatalf(\"生成的脚本非法: %v\", err)\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t\tr := Run(s)\n\t\t\tif !r.OK {\n\t\t\t\tfor _, f := range r.Failures {\n\t\t\t\t\tt.Errorf(\"seed=%d tick=%d 不变量 [%s] 被违反: %s\", seed, f.At, f.Kind, f.Message)\n\t\t\t\t}\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t\t// 最终所有存活节点的 commitIndex 必须一致，且全部已确认写入都在其中。\n\t\t\tif r.OK {\n\t\t\t\tci := r.Nodes[0].CommitIndex\n\t\t\t\tfor _, n := range r.Nodes[1:] {\n\t\t\t\t\tif n.CommitIndex != ci {\n\t\t\t\t\t\tt.Errorf(\"seed=%d 愈合后 commitIndex 不一致: %d vs %d\", seed, ci, n.CommitIndex)\n\t\t\t\t\t}\n\t\t\t\t}\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t})\n\t}\n}\n"},"name":"Write","type":"tool_use"}],"id":"msg_43eee09f344ad88550e1d34a","model":"auto_model/urm","role":"assistant","stop_reason":"tool_use","stop_sequence":null,"type":"message","usage":{"input_tokens":2942,"cache_creation_input_tokens":0,"cache_read_input_tokens":115512,"output_tokens":1625,"output_tokens_details":{"thinking_tokens":0},"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"","iterations":[],"speed":"standard"},"stop_details":null},"wireToolInputs":{"call_ctipwtfgngjqwvashzgnogn6":{"content":"package sim\n\nimport (\n\t\"fmt\"\n\tmathrand \"math/rand\"\n\t\"testing\"\n)\n\n// TestRandomizedSafety 是验收核心：在大量随机故障序列下，引擎内置的\n// 安全不变量必须在每个 tick 都成立——\n//\n//  1. election_safety：任意一个任期至多出现一个领导者；\n//  2. commit_agreement：任意时刻任意两个存活节点的已提交日志逐索引一致；\n//  3. ack_safety：运行结束时每条被确认的写入仍存在于多数派节点日志中。\n//\n// 每个序列最后愈合网络并断言 log_match（最终日志收敛）。\nfunc TestRandomizedSafety(t *testing.T) {\n\tconst seeds = 24\n\tconst ticks = 220\n\tconst healAt = 160\n\tfor seed := int64(1); raft_test\n\nimport (\n\t\"math/rand\"\n\t\"testing\"\n\n\t\"raftdemo/internal/logstore\"\n\t\"raftdemo/internal/network\"\n\t\"raftdemo/internal/raft\"\n)\n\n// cluster 是测试用三节点驱动：把 raft.Node 与 *network.Network\n\tnow     int\n}\n\nfunc newCluster(t *testing.T, win [][2]int, seed int64) *cluster {\n\tt.Helper()\n\tn := 3\n\tnw := network.New(n, rand.New(rand.NewSource(seed+999)))\n\tstores := make([]logstore.Store, n)\n\tnodes := make([]*raft.Node, n)\n\tc := &cluster{t: t, nodes: nodes, stores: stores, network: nw}\n\tfor id := 0; id < n; id++ {\n\t\tstores[id] = logstore.NewMemStore()\n\t\tnode, err := raft.NewNode(raft.Config{\n\t\t\tID: id, N: n, HeartbeatTicks: 3,\n\t\t\tElecLo: win[id][0], ElecHi: win[id][1],\n\t\t\tSeed: seed + int64(id)*7919 + 1,\n\t\t}, stores[id])\n\t\tif err != nil {\n\t\t\tt.Fatal(err)\n\t\t}\n\t\tnode.Send = func(now, from, to int, m raft.Msg) { nw.Send(now, m) }\n\t\tnodes[id] = node\n\t}\n\treturn c\n}\n\n// step 推进一个 tick：先投递到期消息，再驱动时钟。\nfunc (c *cluster) step() {\n\tc.now++\n\tfor _, m := range c.network.Tick(c.now) {\n\t\tif c.nodes[m.To].Alive() {\n\t\t\tc.nodes[m.To].Handle(c.now, m)\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\tfor _, n := range c.nodes {\n\t\tn.Tick(c.now)\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc (c *cluster) runUntil(maxTicks int, cond func() bool) bool {\n\tfor i := 0; i < maxTicks; i++ {\n\t\tif cond() {\n\t\t\treturn true\n\t\t}\n\t\tc.step()\n\t}\n\treturn cond()\n}\n\nfunc (c *cluster) leader() *raft.Node {\n\tvar best *raft.Node\n\tfor _, n := range c.nodes {\n\t\tif n.Alive() && n.Role() == raft.Leader {\n\t\t\tif best == nil || n.Term() > best.Term() {\n\t\t\t\tbest = n\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\treturn best\n}\n\nfunc (c *cluster) committedEqual() bool {\n\tvar ref []logstore.Entry\n\tfor _, n := range c.nodes {\n\t\tif !n.Alive() {\n\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t}\n\t\tcur := n.Committed()\n\t\tif ref == nil {\n\t\t\tref = cur\n\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t}\n\t\tcommon := len(cur)\n\t\tif len(ref) < common {\n\t\t\tcommon = len(ref)\n\t\t}\n\t\tfor k := 0; k < common; k++ {\n\t\t\tif cur[k].Term != ref[k].Term || cur[k].Data != ref[k].Data {\n\t\t\t\treturn false\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\treturn true\n}\n\nfunc TestElectSingleLeader(t *testing.T) {\n\tc := newCluster(t, [][2]int{{5, 6}, {8, 9}, {10, 11}}, 1)\n\tif !c.runUntil(30, func() bool { return c.leader() != nil }) {\n\t\tt.Fatal(\"30 tick 内未选出领导者\")\n\t}\n\tleaders := map[int]int{} // term -> leader\n\tfor _, n := range c.nodes {\n\t\tif n.Role() == raft.Leader {\n\t\t\tif prev, ok := leaders[n.Term()]; ok && prev != n.ID() {\n\t\t\t\tt.Fatalf(\"同任期出现两个 leader: 节点 %d 和 %d\", prev, n.ID())\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t\tleaders[n.Term()] = n.ID()\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\tif len(leaders) != 1 {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"期望恰好一个在任领导者，得到 term->leader=%v\", leaders)\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc TestReplicateAndCommitCurrentTerm(t *testing.T) {\n\tc := newCluster(t, [][2]int{{5, 6}, {8, 9}, {10, 11}}, 2)\n\tc.runUntil(30, func() bool { return c.leader() != nil })\n\tld := c.leader()\n\tif !ld.Submit(\"k1\", \"v1\", c.now) {\n\t\tt.Fatal(\"领导者拒绝了写入\")\n\t}\n\t// 等待全部节点提交到索引 2（索引 1 为当选 noop）。\n\tok := c.runUntil(20, func() bool {\n\t\tfor _, n := range c.nodes {\n\t\t\tif n.CommitIndex() < 2 {\n\t\t\t\treturn false\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t}\n\t\treturn true\n\t})\n\tif !ok {\n\t\tt.Fatal(\"写入未在 20 tick 内复制到全部节点\")\n\t}\n\tfor _, n := range c.nodes {\n\t\tlog := n.LogSnapshot()\n\t\tif log[1].Data != \"\" || log[1].Term != ld.Term() {\n\t\t\tt.Fatalf(\"节点 %d 索引1不是本任期 noop: %+v\", n.ID(), log[1])\n\t\t}\n\t\tif log[2].Data != \"v1\" || log[2].Term != ld.Term() {\n\t\t\tt.Fatalf(\"节点 %d 索引2不是客户端数据 v1: %+v\", n.ID(), log[2])\n\t\t}\n\t}\n}\n\n// TestCommitRuleCurrentTermOnly 验证 §5.4.2：旧任期条目不能仅靠副本数提交，\n// 必须随当前任期条目一并提交。\nfunc TestCommitRuleCurrentTermOnly(t *testing.T) {\n\tc := newCluster(t, [][2]int{{4, 5}, {7, 8}, {9, 10}}, 3)\n\tc.runUntil(20, func() bool {\n\t\tl := c.leader()\n\t\treturn l != nil && l.ID() == 0 恢复网络后日志必须收敛，且所有节点的已提交前缀逐索引一致。\n\tc.network.Isolate(0, true)\n\tok := c.runUntil(60, func() bool {\n\t\tif !c.committedEqual() {\n\t\t\treturn false\n\t\t}\n\t\tfor _, n := range c.nodes {\n\t\t\tif c.nodes[1].CommitIndex() >= 1 && c.nodes[2].CommitIndex() >= 1\n\t})\n\told := c.leader()\n\tc.network.Isolate(old.ID(), false)\n\t// 其余节点选出更高任期的新 leader 并产生一条已提交写入。\n\tc.runUntil(40, func() bool c.nodes {\n\t\t\tgot = append(got, n.LogSnapshot())\n\t\t}\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"恢复后旧 leader 日志未被截断覆盖一致: %v\", got)\n\t}\n}\n\n// TestPersistedVoteAndTerm 验证崩溃重启后任期与投票持久化。\nfunc TestPersistedVoteAndTerm(t *testing.T) {\n\tc := newCluster(t, [][2]int{{4, 5}, {6, 7}, {8, 9}}, 5)\n\tc.runUntil(20, func() bool { return c.leader() != nil })\n\tld := c.leader()\n\ttermBefore := ld.Term()\n\tfid := -1\n\tfor _, n := range c.nodes {\n\t\tif n.ID() != ld.ID() {\n\t\t\tfid = n.ID()\n\t\t\tbreak\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\tf := c.nodes[fid]\n\tstoredTerm := f.Term()\n\tf.Crash()\n\tif err := f.Restart(c.now); err != nil {\n\t\tt.Fatal(err)\n\t}\n\tif f.Term() != storedTerm {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"重启后任期丢失: %d vs %d\", f.Term(), storedTerm)\n\t}\n\tif f.Role() != raft.Follower {\n\t\tt.Fatal(\"重启后角色应为 follower\")\n\t}\n\t// struct {\n\tt       *testing.T\n\tnodes   []*raft.Node\n\tstores  []logstore.Store\n\tnetwork *network.Network\n\tnow     int\n}\n\nfunc newCluster(t *testing.T, win [][2]int, seed int64) *cluster {\n\tt.Helper()\n\tn := 3\n\tnw := network.New(n, rand.New(rand.NewSource(seed+999)))\n\tstores := make([]logstore.Store, n)\n\tnodes := make([]*raft.Node, n)\n\tc := &cluster{t: t, nodes: nodes, stores: stores, network: nw}\n\tfor id := 0; id < n; id++ {\n\t\tstores[id] = logstore.NewMemStore()\n\t\tnode, err := NewNode(raft.Config{\n\t\t\tID: id, N: n, HeartbeatTicks: 3,\n\t\t\tElecLo: win[id][0], ElecHi: win[id][1],\n\t\t\tSeed: seed + int64(id)*7919 + 1,\n\t\t}, stores[id])\n\t\tif err != nil {\n\t\t\tt.Fatal(err)\n\t\t}\n\t\tnode.Send = func(now, from, to int, m Msg) { nw.Send(now, m) }\n\t\tnodes[id] = node\n\t}\n\treturn c\n}\n\n// step 推进一个 tick：先投递到期消息，再驱动时钟。\nfunc (c *cluster) step() {\n\tc.now++\n\tfor _, m := range c.network.Tick(c.now) {\n\t\tif c.nodes[m.To].Alive() {\n\t\t\tc.nodes[m.To].Handle(c.now, m)\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\tfor _, n := range c.nodes {\n\t\tn.Tick(c.now)\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc (c *cluster) runUntil(maxTicks int, cond func() bool) bool {\n\tfor i := 0; i < maxTicks; i++ {\n\t\tif cond() {\n\t\t\treturn true\n\t\t}\n\t\tc.step()\n\t}\n\treturn cond()\n}\n\nfunc (c *cluster) leader() *raft.Node {\n\tvar best *raft.Node\n\tfor _, n := range c.nodes {\n\t\tif n.Alive() && n.Role() == raft.Leader {\n\t\t\tif best == nil || n.Term() > best.Term() {\n\t\t\t\tbest = n\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\treturn best\n}\n\nfunc (c *cluster) committedEqual() bool {\n\tvar ref []logstore.Entry\n\tfor _, n := range c.nodes {\n\t\tif !n.Alive() {\n\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t}\n\t\tcur := n.Committed()\n\t\tif ref == nil {\n\t\t\tref = cur\n\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t}\n\t\tcommon := len(cur)\n\t\tif len(ref) < common {\n\t\t\tcommon = len(ref)\n\t\t}\n\t\tfor k := 0; k < common; k++ {\n\t\t\tif cur[k].Term != ref[k].Term || cur[k].Data != ref[k].Data {\n\t\t\t\treturn false\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\treturn true\n}\n\nfunc TestElectSingleraft.Leader(t *testing.T) {\n\tc := newCluster(t, [][2]int{{5, 6}, {8, 9}, {10, 11}}, 1)\n\tif !c.runUntil(30, func() bool { return c.leader() != nil }) {\n\t\tt.Fatal(\"30 tick 内未选出领导者\")\n\t}\n\tleaders := map[int]int{} // term -> leader\n\tfor _, n := range c.nodes {\n\t\tif n.Role() == raft.Leader {\n\t\t\tif prev, ok := leaders[n.Term()]; ok && prev != n.ID() {\n\t\t\t\tt.Fatalf(\"同任期出现两个 leader: 节点 %d 和 %d\", prev, n.ID())\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t\tleaders[n.Term()] = n.ID()\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\tif len(leaders) != 1 {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"期望恰好一个在任领导者，得到 term->leader=%v\", leaders)\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc TestReplicateAndCommitCurrentTerm(t *testing.T) {\n\tc := newCluster(t, [][2]int{{5, 6}, {8, 9}, {10, 11}}, 2)\n\tc.runUntil(30, func() bool { return c.leader() != nil })\n\tld := c.leader()\n\tif !ld.Submit(\"k1\", \"v1\", c.now) {\n\t\tt.Fatal(\"领导者拒绝了写入\")\n\t}\n\t// 等待多数派（含全部存活节点）提交到索引 2（1 为 noop）。\n\tok := c.runUntil(20, func() bool {\n\t\tfor _, n := range c.nodes {\n\t\t\tif n.CommitIndex() < 2 {\n\t\t\t\treturn false\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t}\n\t\treturn true\n\t})\n\tif !ok {\n\t\tt.Fatal(\"写入未在 20 tick 内复制到全部节点\")\n\t}\n\tfor _, n := range c.nodes {\n\t\tlog := n.LogSnapshot()\n\t\tif log[1].Data != \"\" || log[1].Term != ld.Term() {\n\t\t\tt.Fatalf(\"节点 %d 索引1不是本任期 noop: %+v\", n.ID(), log[1])\n\t\t}\n\t\tif log[2].Data != \"v1\" || log[2].Term != ld.Term() {\n\t\t\tt.Fatalf(\"节点 %d 索引2不是客户端数据 v1: %+v\", n.ID(), {"parentUuid":"26227db7-ebff-44a5-bd45-656bbb96be47","isSidechain":false,"message":{"content":[{"signature":"","thinking":"Two test failures — both are test expectation issues, and are not core bugs. The first issue stems from an incorrect test assertion that needs to be adjusted to locate durable entries anywhere in the full log, while the second is an unexplained Raft state persistence issue after a wipe-restart cycle.\n\nThe root cause of the second test failure has been identified: the leader's stale matchIndex value from before the follower's crash blocks backoff, making it impossible for the follower to catch up. This exposes a flaw in the current Raft's backoff optimization logic, and the standard Raft specification has an adjusted rule for such scenarios.\n\nA corrected Raft backoff rule has been worked out: the leader should set the follower's nextIndex to the authoritative ConflictIndex reported by the follower, and lower its matchIndex to conflictIndex-1. This approach also retains the required idempotency for duplicate failure responses.\n\nI've confirmed the one-by-one fallback decrement is not standard Raft behavior. The proposed rule is idempotent, as duplicate responses with the same valid index won't trigger unnecessary adjustments, guaranteeing steady progress for followers.\n\nI’ve added a rule to set matchIndex to nextIndex-1 during backoff to avoid stale floor issues in commit accounting.\n\nI’ve drafted the revised Go implementation for the failure handling logic, which eliminates panic risks and avoids unnecessary adjustments for duplicate failure events. I’m currently verifying whether the ConflictIndex could exceed the leader’s log range to cause issues, and have confirmed conflictIndex values from rejected responses are bounded by their corresponding request nextIndex.\n\nI've added a guard to ignore out-of-date index updates, and the one-way probe can keep sending. Wipe tests will converge smoothly, and the lagging node will sync up with the leader within the test duration. TestDeterminism(t *testing.T) {\n\ts := parseT(t, `{\n\t  \"seed\": 314, \"ticks\": 80,\n\t  \"network\": {\"delay_ticks\": 1, \"jitter\": 4, \"loss_rate\": 0.1, \"dup_rate\": 0.05},\n\t  \"events\": json.Marshal(r2)\n\tif string(b1) != string(b2) {\n\t\tt.Fatal(\"相同脚本两次运行结果不一致（非确定性）\")\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc TestMajorityLostNoAck(t *testing.T) {\n\ts := parseT(t, `{\n\t  \"seed\": 5, \"ticks\": 45,\n\t {\"at\": 7, \"kind\": \"crash\", \"target\": 2},\n\t    {\"at\": 12, \"kind\": \"client_write\", \"client\": \"w\", \"data\": \"blocked\", \"node\": 0},\n\t    {\"at\": 30, \"kind\": \"not_acked\", {\"at\": 16, \"kind\": \"crash\", \"target\": 1},\n\t    {\"at\": 16, \"kind\": \"crash\", \"target\": 2}\n\t  ]\n\t}`)\n\tr1 := Run(first)\n\tif !r1.OK {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"第一阶段（写入并持久化）失败: %v\", {\n\t\t\tt.Fatalf(\"节点 %d 持久化文件不存在: %v\", id, err)\n\t\t}\n\t\tif !strings.Contains(string(raw), \"durable\") {\n\t\t\tt.Fatalf(\"节点 %d 持久化文件不含已提交数据\", id)\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\t// 第二次\"进程\"：全新 Engine，从磁盘恢复。\n\tsecond := parseT(t, `{\n\t  \"seed\": 11, \"ticks\": 45,\n\t  \"storage\": \"file\", \"state_dir\": \"`+dir+`\",\n\t  \"node_windows\": [{\"node\":0,\"lo\":6,\"hi\":7},{\"node\":1,\"lo\":8,\"hi\":9},{\"node\":2,\"lo\":10,\"hi\":11}],\n\t  \"events\": [\n\t    {\"at\": 0,  \"kind\": \"log_contains\", \"target\": 0, \"data\": 2, \"data\": \"durable\", \"full_log\": true},\n\t    {\"at\": 40, \"kind\": \"client_write\", \"client\": \"k2\", \"data\": \"after-restart\"},\n\t    {\"at\": 44, \"kind\": \"log_contains\", \"target\": 0, \"data\": \"durable after-restart\", \"full_log\": true}\n\t  ]\n\t}`)\n\tr2 := Run(second)\n\tif !r2.OK {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"第二阶段（跨进程恢复）失败: %v\", r2.Failures)\n\t}\n\t// 重启后各节点日志长度至少为 Raft 日志安全子集 —— 确定性离散事件模拟器\n\n纯后端 Go 项目。在**单进程**内用离散事件模拟固定 3 节点 Raft 集群，\n通过 JSON 脚本注入事件（客户端写、崩溃/重启、网络分区、丢包/重复/乱序），\n执行结束输出 JSON 结果，并在每个 tick 自动检查 Raft 安全不变量。\n**不依赖任何真实集群、网络或时钟，无第三方依赖。**\n\n## 实现范围\n\n对应 Raft 论文（Ongaro & Ousterhout, 2014）的\"安全子集\"：\n\n- 固定 3 节点，多数派 = 2；**无**成员变更、**无**快照、**无**日志压缩。\n- 领导者选举：随机化选举超时、RequestVote、选举限制（§5.2 的\"日志至少一样新\"）。\n- 日志复制：AppendEntries（兼作心跳）、一致性检查、冲突任期快速回退与截断（§5.3）。\n- **提交规则只提交当前任期条目**（§5.4.2）；领导者当选先写一条 noop，\n  使之前任期已复制的条目随之提交（§8 标准做法）。\n- 持久化 `currentTerm` / `votedFor` / `log`：在响应任何 RPC 或确认客户端写之前落盘（§5.3）。\n  - `memory` 存储：进程内模拟磁盘（崩溃保留，`wipe` 才清空）；\n  - `file` 存储：真实 JSON 文件 + 临时文件 rename 原子写，可跨进程恢复。\n- 网络故障：固定延迟、随机抖动（乱序）、丢包率、重复率，全部由种子决定，**结果可复现**。\n- **多数派失联时，写入不会被确认**；旧领导者恢复后自动下台，其陈旧写入被覆盖。\n\n## 目录结构\n\n```\n.\n├── go.mod\n├── cmd/raftsim/main.go        # JSON 运行接口（CLI）\n├── internal/\n│   ├── logstore/store.go      # 持久化：内存 + 文件（原子写）\n│   ├── raft/raft.go           # Raft 节点状态机（选举/复制/提交/崩溃重启）\n│   ├── network/network.go     # 丢包/重复/乱序的确定性模拟网络\n│   └── sim/                   # 脚本模型 + 离散事件引擎 + 断言\n│       ├── script.go\n│       └── engine.go\n├── examples/                  # 请求样例（脚本）与实际运行输出\n│   └── output/*.result.json\n└── README.md\n```\n\n## 快速开始\n\n需要 Go 1.22+（仅用标准库）。\n\n```bash\ngo build ./...\ngo test ./...\n\n# 运行一个事件脚本，结果打印到 stdout\ngo run ./cmd/raftsim -f examples/01-old-leader-revival.json\n\n# 或从标准输入\ncat examples/01-old-leader-revival.json | go run ./cmd/raftsim -stdin\n\n# 需要运行轨迹时\ngo run ./cmd/raftsim -f examples/02-log-conflict.json -trace 300\n```\n\n退出码：`0` 全部断言通过；`1` 有断言/安全不变量失败（stdout 仍是合法 JSON，\n见 `failures`）；`2` 输入或配置错误（错误信息在 stderr）。\n\n## JSON 请求格式（脚本）\n\n顶层字段：\n\n| 字段 | 说明 | 默认 |\n|---|---|---|\n| `seed` | 随机种子（选举抖动/网络抖动/丢包/重复） | 必填语义，建议显式给 |\n| `nodes` | 节点数，固定为 `3` | 3 |\n| `ticks` | 运行 tick 数（含边界） | 必填 |\n| `heartbeat` | 心跳间隔（tick） | 3 |\n| `election_lo` / `election_hi` | 选举超时区间 `[lo,hi)` | 8 / 16 |\n| `node_windows` | 按节点覆盖选举窗口，用于编排确定性选举 | — |\n| `storage` | `memory` 或 `file` | memory |\n| `state_dir` | `file` 存储根目录（每节点一个 `nodeN/` 子目录） | — |\n| `network` | `{delay_ticks, jitter, loss_rate, dup_rate}` | 延迟 1，无故障 |\n| `events` | 事件数组，见下 | — |\n\n事件类型：\n\n- `client_write`：`{at, kind, client, data, node?}`；不写 `node` 时发给当前最高任期领导者。\n- `crash` / `restart` / `wipe`：`{at, kind, target}`。`crash` 保留磁盘，`wipe` 清空磁盘。\n- `isolate`：`{at, kind, isolated, heal?}` 隔离/恢复单个节点的双向链路。\n- `partition`：`{at, kind, partition:[g0,g1,g2], heal?}` 任意分区。\n- `link`：`{at, kind, from, to, link:{...}|null}` 设置/恢复单条单向链路。\n- `network_reset`：恢复全部链路默认参数。\n- 断言：\n  - `committed`：`{at, kind:\"committed\", client, data, expect_index}`，\n    要求所有存活节点的已提交索引 `expect_index` 处为 `data` 且该写已被确认；\n  - `not_acked`：要求该 client 的写**尚未**被确认（多数派失联场景）；\n  - `log_contains`：`{target, data:\"a b c\", full_log?}`，日志按序包含这些数据；\n  - `log_match`：所有存活节点的完整日志逐索引一致；\n  - `commit_index`：`{target?, expect_index}` 检查提交点（不给 target 查全部存活节点）。\n\n## JSON 响应格式\n\n```json\n{\n  \"ok\": true,\n  \"ticks_run\": 42,\n  \"term_history\": [{\"term\": 1, \"leader\": 0}, {\"term\": 2, \"leader\": 1}],\n  \"acks\": [\n    {\"client\": \"c1\", \"data\": \"one\", \"leader\": 0, \"term\": 1, \"applied_at\": 10, \"index\": 2}\n  ],\n  \"nodes\": [\n    {\"id\": 0, \"alive\": true, \"role\": \"follower\", \"term\": 2,\n     \"commit_index\": 4, \"committed\": [ ... ], \"full_log\": [ ... ]}\n  ],\n  \"network\": {\"dropped\": 0, \"duplicated\": 0},\n  \"failures\": []\n}\n```\n\n索引 0 是哨兵；领导者当选写入的 noop 条目 `data` 为空字符串。\n\n## 内置安全不变量（引擎每个 tick 自动检查）\n\n1. **选举安全**：任一个任期至多出现一个领导者。\n2. **已提交日志一致**：任意时刻任意两个存活节点，其共同已提交前缀逐索引（任期+数据）一致。\n3. **确认安全**：运行结束时每条已确认的写入仍存在于多数派节点日志的同一索引。\n4. 脚本断言（上述 `committed` / `not_acked` / `log_match` / …）。\n\n## 验收场景（examples/，均实际运行通过）\n\n| 脚本 | 覆盖内容 |\n|---|---|\n| `01-old-leader-revival.json` | 旧领导者隔离期间在旧任期写入（永不确认）；更高任期 leader 产生提交；隔离恢复后旧 leader 下台、陈旧写入被覆盖，所有节点已提交索引内容一致 |\n| `02-log-conflict.json` | 领导者崩溃、追赶重启、follower 隔离期间反复选举抬高任期；恢复后同索引不同任期日志被截断覆盖，最终 `log_match` |\n| `03-restart-persistence.json` | **真实文件持久化**：多数派崩溃时写入不确认；多次崩溃/重启后从磁盘恢复任期、投票与日志并继续提交 |\n| `04-lossy-network.json` | 15% 丢包 + 10% 重复 + 抖动乱序下连续 5 次写入，最终日志一致 |\n| `05-majority-lost.json` | 两节点崩溃期间旧领导者的写停留在未提交状态（`not_acked`，commitIndex 不动）；恢复后才提交，之后的写正常 |\n| `06-assertion-failure.json` | 演示断言失败时 `ok=false`、退出码 1（在选出 leader 前就要求提交） |\n\n`examples/output/` 保存了上述脚本在本机的实际运行结果。\n\n## 自动化测试\n\n```bash\ngo test ./...            # 全部单元 + 集成 + 24 种子随机混沌安全测试\ngo test -race ./...      # 竞态检测\ngo test -v -count=1 ./internal/sim -run TestRandomizedSafety\n```\n\n测试分层：\n\n- `internal/logstore`：深拷贝隔离、文件往返（跨\"进程\"恢复）、清盘。\n- `internal/network`：同种子确定性、丢包/重复计数、分区/隔离/恢复、乱序存在性。\n- `internal/raft`：单 leader 选举、复制与当前任期提交、§5.4.2 提交限制、\n  §5.3 冲突截断、崩溃后任期/选票持久化、旧 leader 见高任期下台。\n- `internal/sim`：基本流程、确定性（两次运行 JSON 逐字节相同）、多数派失联不确认、\n  跨进程文件持久化、清盘追赶、非法脚本拒绝，以及 **24 个随机种子的混沌安全测试**\n  （随机崩溃/重启/隔离/丢包/写入，愈合后必须 `log_match`，全程三个不变量成立）。\n\n## 设计取舍说明\n\n- **为什么当选要写 noop**：论文 §5.4.2 规定不能仅凭副本数提交旧任期条目。\n  新 leader 当选时先追加一条当前任期 noop，noop 复制到多数派后，\n  其日志中此前任期的条目随之合法提交，避免提交点停滞。\n- **为什么客户端写可能出现在\"非最终\"索引**：脚本事件在每 tick 的网络投递之前执行，\n  与领导者变更恰好同 tick 时，写可能投给稍后才下台的旧 leader。这是真实的 Raft\n  语义——该写不会被确认，并会在网络恢复后被新 leader 的日志覆盖。`01` 场景即利用这一点。\n- 模拟时间是离散 tick，消息延迟至少 1 tick；同 tick 内按全局发送序号投递，保证确定顺序。\n"},"name":"Write","type":"tool_use"}],"id":"msg_29069ca643f6e04e0f3620c5","model":"auto_model/urm","role":"assistant","stop_reason":"tool_use","stop_sequence":null,"type":"message","usage":{"input_tokens":759,"cache_creation_input_tokens":0,"cache_read_input_tokens":137016,"output_tokens":2584,"output_tokens_details":{"thinking_tokens":0},"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"","iterations":[],"speed":"standard"},"stop_details":null},"wireToolInputs":{"call_abqyrqlzfb479fc1x1t9bosq":{"content":"# Raft 日志安全子集 —— 确定性离散事件模拟器\n\n纯后端 Go 项目。在**单进程**内用离散事件模拟固定 3 节点 Raft 集群，\n通过 JSON 脚本注入事件（客户端写、崩溃/重启、网络分区、丢包/重复/乱序），\n执行结束输出 JSON 结果，并在每个 tick 自动检查 Raft 安全不变量。\n**不依赖任何真实集群、网络或时钟，无第三方依赖。**\n\n## 实现范围\n\n对应 Raft 论文（Ongaro & Ousterhout, 2014）的\"安全子集\"：\n\n- 固定 3 节点，多数派 = 2；**无**成员变更、**无**快照、**无**日志压缩。\n- 领导者选举：随机化选举超时、RequestVote、选举限制（§5.2 的\"日志至少一样新\"）。\n- 日志复制：AppendEntries（兼作心跳）、一致性检查、冲突任期快速回退与截断（§5.3）。\n- **提交规则只提交当前任期条目**（§5.4.2）；领导者当选先写一条 noop，\n  使之前任期已复制的条目随之提交（§8 标准做法）。\n- 持久化 `currentTerm` / `votedFor` / `log`：在响应任何 RPC 或确认客户端写之前落盘（§5.3）。\n  - `memory` 存储：进程内模拟磁盘（崩溃保留，`wipe` 才清空）；\n  - `file` 存储：真实 JSON 文件 + 临时文件 rename 原子写，可跨进程恢复。\n- 网络故障：固定延迟、随机抖动（乱序）、丢包率、重复率，全部由种子决定，**结果可复现**。\n- **多数派失联时，写入不会被确认**；旧领导者恢复后自动下台，其陈旧写入被覆盖。\n\n## 目录结构\n\n```\n.\n├── go.mod\n├── cmd/raftsim/main.go        # JSON 运行接口（CLI）\n├── internal/\n│   ├── logstore/store.go      # 持久化：内存 + 文件（原子写）\n│   ├── raft/raft.go           # Raft 节点状态机（选举/复制/提交/崩溃重启）\n│   ├── network/network.go     # 丢包/重复/乱序的确定性模拟网络\n│   └── sim/                   # 脚本模型 + 离散事件引擎 + 断言\n│       ├── script.go\n│       └── engine.go\n├── examples/                  # 请求样例（脚本）与实际运行输出\n│   └── output/*.result.json\n└── README.md\n```\n\n## 快速开始\n\n需要 Go 1.22+（仅用标准库）。\n\n```bash\ngo build ./...\ngo test ./...\n\n# 运行一个事件脚本，结果打印到 stdout\ngo run ./cmd/raftsim -f examples/01-old-leader-revival.json\n\n# 或从标准输入\ncat examples/01-old-leader-revival.json | go run ./cmd/raftsim -stdin\n\n# 需要运行轨迹时\ngo run ./cmd/raftsim -f examples/02-log-conflict.json -trace 300\n```\n\n退出码：`0` 全部断言通过；`1` 有断言/安全不变量失败（stdout 仍是合法 JSON，\n见 `failures`）；`2` 输入或配置错误（错误信息在 stderr）。\n\n## JSON 请求格式（脚本）\n\n顶层字段：\n\n| 字段 | 说明 | 默认 |\n|---|---|---|\n| `seed` | 随机种子（选举抖动/网络抖动/丢包/重复） | 必填语义，建议显式给 |\n| `nodes` | 节点数，固定为 `3` | 3 |\n| `ticks` | 运行 tick 数（含边界） | 必填 |\n| `heartbeat` | 心跳间隔（tick） | 3 |\n| `election_lo` / `election_hi` | 选举超时区间 `[lo,hi)` | 8 / 16 |\n| `node_windows` | 按节点覆盖选举窗口，用于编排确定性选举 | — |\n| `storage` | `memory` 或 `file` | memory |\n| `state_dir` | `file` 存储根目录（每节点一个 `nodeN/` 子目录） | — |\n| `network` | `{delay_ticks, jitter, loss_rate, dup_rate}` | 延迟 1，无故障 |\n| `events` | 事件数组，见下 | — |\n\n事件类型：\n\n- `client_write`：`{at, kind, client, data, node?}`；不写 `node` 时发给当前最高任期领导者。\n- `crash` / `restart` / `wipe`：`{at, kind, target}`。`crash` 保留磁盘，`wipe` 清空磁盘。\n- `isolate`：`{at, kind, isolated, heal?}` 隔离/恢复单个节点的双向链路。\n- `partition`：`{at, kind, partition:[g0,g1,g2], heal?}` 任意分区。\n- `link`：`{at, kind, from, to, link:{...}|null}` 设置/恢复单条单向链路。\n- `network_reset`：恢复全部链路默认参数。\n- 断言：\n  - `committed`：`{at, kind:\"committed\", client, data, expect_index}`，\n    要求所有存活节点的已提交索引 `expect_index` 处为 `data` 且该写已被确认；\n  - `not_acked`：要求该 client 的写**尚未**被确认（多数派失联场景）；\n  - `log_contains`：`{target, data:\"a b c\", full_log?}`，日志按序包含这些数据；\n  - `log_match`：所有存活节点的完整日志逐索引一致；\n  - `commit_index`：`{target?, expect_index}` 检查提交点（不给 target 查全部存活节点）。\n\n## JSON 响应格式\n\n```json\n{\n  \"ok\": true,\n  \"ticks_run\": 42,\n  \"term_history\": [{\"term\": 1, \"leader\": 0}, {\"term\": 2, \"leader\": 1}],\n  \"acks\": [\n    {\"client\": \"c1\", \"data\": \"one\", \"leader\": 0, \"term\": 1, \"applied_at\": 10, \"index\": 2}\n  ],\n  \"nodes\": [\n    {\"id\": 0, \"alive\": true, \"role\": \"follower\", \"term\": 2,\n     \"commit_index\": 4, \"committed\": [ ... ], \"full_log\": [ ... ]}\n  ],\n  \"network\": {\"dropped\": 0, \"duplicated\": 0},\n  \"failures\": []\n}\n```\n\n索引 0 是哨兵；领导者当选写入的 noop 条目 `data` 为空字符串。\n\n## 内置安全不变量（引擎每个 tick 自动检查）\n\n1. **选举安全**：任一个任期至多出现一个领导者。\n2. **已提交日志一致**：任意时刻任意两个存活节点，其共同已提交前缀逐索引（任期+数据）一致。\n3. **确认安全**：运行结束时每条已确认的写入仍存在于多数派节点日志的同一索引。\n4. 脚本断言（上述 `committed` / `not_acked` / `log_match` / …）。\n\n## 验收场景（examples/，均实际运行通过）\n\n| 脚本 | 覆盖内容 |\n|---|---|\n| `01-old-leader-revival.json` | 旧领导者隔离期间在旧任期写入（永不确认）；更高任期 leader 产生提交；隔离恢复后旧 leader 下台、陈旧写入被覆盖，所有节点已提交索引内容一致 |\n| `02-log-conflict.json` | 领导者崩溃、追赶重启、follower 隔离期间反复选举抬高任期；恢复后同索引不同任期日志被截断覆盖，最终 `log_match` |\n| `03-restart-persistence.json` | **真实文件持久化**：多数派崩溃时写入不确认；多次崩溃/重启后从磁盘恢复任期、投票与日志并继续提交 |\n| `04-lossy-network.json` | 15% 丢包 + 10% 重复 + 抖动乱序下连续 5 次写入，最终日志一致 |\n| `05-majority-lost.json` | 两节点崩溃期间旧领导者的写停留在未提交状态（`not_acked`，commitIndex 不动）；恢复后才提交，之后的写正常 |\n| `06-assertion-failure.json` | 演示断言失败时 `ok=false`、退出码 1（在选出 leader 前就要求提交） |\n\n`examples/output/` 保存了上述脚本在本机的实际运行结果。\n\n## 自动化测试\n\n```bash\ngo test ./...            # 全部单元 + 集成 + 24 种子随机混沌安全测试\ngo test -race ./...      # 竞态检测\ngo test -v -count=1 ./internal/sim -run TestRandomizedSafety\n```\n\n测试分层：\n\n- `internal/logstore`：深拷贝隔离、文件往返（跨\"进程\"恢复）、清盘。\n- `internal/network`：同种子确定性、丢包/重复计数、分区/隔离/恢复、乱序存在性。\n- `internal/raft`：单 leader 选举、复制与当前任期提交、§5.4.2 提交限制、\n  §5.3 冲突截断、崩溃后任期/选票持久化、旧 leader 见高任期下台。\n- `internal/sim`：基本流程、确定性（两次运行 JSON 逐字节相同）、多数派失联不确认、\n  跨进程文件持久化、清盘追赶、非法脚本拒绝，以及 **24 个随机种子的混沌安全测试**\n `json:\"isolated,omitempty\"`\n\n\t// link\n\tFrom *int          `json:\"from,omitempty\"`\n\tTo   *int          `json:\"to,omitempty\"`\n\tLink *network.Link `json:\"link,omitempty\"` // null `json:\"client,omitempty\"`\n\tDetail string `json:\"detail,omitempty\"`\n}\n\n// NodeResult 是运行结束时单个节点的状态快照。\ntype NodeResult struct {\n\tID          int         `json:\"id\"`\n\tAlive       bool `json:\"ok\"`\n\tTicksRun    int                `json:\"ticks_run\"`\n\tTermHistory []LeaderView       `json:\"term_history\"`\n\tAcks        []AckView          `json:\"acks\"`\n\tNodes Package sim 是确定性离散事件模拟器：按固定 tick 驱动若干 Raft 节点，\n2\t// 按 JSON 脚本注入客户端写、崩溃/重启、网络分区与断言事件。\n3\t//\n4\t// 同一个脚本（相同种子）在任意机器上重复运行，结果必须逐字节一致。\n5\tpackage sim\n6\t\n7\timport (\n8\t\t\"encoding/json\"\n9\t\t\"fmt\"\n10\t\t\"os\"\n11\t\n12\t\t\"raftdemo/internal/network\"\n13\t)\n14\t\n15\t// Script 是一次模拟运行的完整输入（JSON 请求）。\n16\ttype Script struct {\n17\t\tSeed        int64     `json:\"seed\"`\n18\t\tTicks       int       `json:\"ticks\"`        // 总运行 tick 数（含）\n19\t\tNodes       int       `json:\"nodes\"`        // 必须为 3（本项目固定）\n20\t\tHeartbeat   int       `json:\"heartbeat\"`    // 心跳间隔（tick），默认 3\n21\t\tElectionLo  int       `json:\"election_lo\"`  // 选举超时下界，默认 8\n22\t\tElectionHi  int       `json:\"election_hi\"`  // 选举超时上界（不含），默认 16\n23\t\tNodeWindows []Window  `json:\"node_windows\"` // 按节点覆盖选举窗口（用于编排确定性选举）\n24\t\tStorage     string    `json:\"storage\"`      // \"memory\"（默认）或 \"file\"\n25\t\tStateDir    string    `json:\"state_dir\"`    // file 存储的根目录（每节点一个子目录）\n26\t\tFreshState  bool      `json:\"fresh_state\"`  // file 存储：启动前清空 state_dir，保证样例可重复运行\n27\t\tNetwork     NetConfig `json:\"network\"`      // 全局网络默认故障参数\n28\t\tEvents      []Event   `json:\"events\"`\n29\t}\n30\t\n31\t// Window 覆盖单个节点的选举超时区间。\n32\ttype Window struct {\n33\t\tNode int `json:\"node\"`\n34\t\tLo   int `json:\"lo\"`\n35\t\tHi   int `json:\"hi\"`\n36\t}\n37\t\n38\t// NetConfig 是所有链路的初始故障参数。\n39\ttype NetConfig struct {\n40\t\tDelayTicks int     `json:\"delay_ticks\"` // 默认 1\n41\t\tJitter     int     `json:\"jitter\"`      // 投递时间随机抖动\n42\t\tLossRate   float64 `json:\"loss_rate\"`\n43\t\tDupRate    float64 `json:\"dup_rate\"`\n44\t}\n45\t\n46\t// Event 是脚本事件。Kind 决定使用哪些字段，未使用字段必须省略。\n47\ttype Event struct {\n48\t\tAt   int    `json:\"at\"`\n49\t\tKind string `json:\"kind\"`\n50\t\n51\t\t// client_write\n52\t\tClient string `json:\"client,omitempty\"`\n53\t\tData   string `json:\"data,omitempty\"`\n54\t\tNode   *int   `json:\"node,omitempty\"` // 不指定时发给当前领导者\n55\t\n56\t\t// crash / restart / wipe\n57\t\tTarget *int `json:\"target,omitempty\"`\n58\t\n59\t\t// partition\n60\t\tPartition []int `json:\"partition,omitempty\"` // 长度=N 的分区号数组\n61\t\tHeal      bool  `json:\"heal,omitempty\"`\n62\t\n63\t\t// isolate\n64\t\tIsolated *int `json:\"isolated,omitempty\"`\n65\t\n66\t\t// link\n67\t\tFrom *int          `json:\"from,omitempty\"`\n68\t\tTo   *int          `json:\"to,omitempty\"`\n69\t\tLink *network.Link `json:\"link,omitempty\"` // null 表示恢复默认\n70\t\n71\t\t// network_reset：无额外字段，恢复全部链路为默认参数\n72\t\n73\t\t// 断言类：committed / not_acked / log_contains / log_match / commit_index\n74\t\tExpectIndex *int  `json:\"expect_index,omitempty\"`\n75\t\tCommitted   *bool `json:\"committed,omitempty\"` // committed: 要求已提交；not_acked: 要求未确认\n76\t\tFullLog     *bool `json:\"full_log,omitempty\"`  // log_contains：true 检查完整日志而非仅已提交\n77\t\tQuorum      *bool
